jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Software Developer

(.NET / Azure)

Shape the Future of Global Maritime Operations

Every day, ships, terminals, traders and surveyors juggle paperwork, email and phone calls just to get a vessel loaded safely. UAB-Online replaces that chaos with one platform, connecting maritime stakeholders to make liquid and dry bulk operations safer, more efficient and more sustainable.
It's working: 10,000+ users across 100+ terminals have already handled more than 1,000,000 vessel visits on UAB-Online. Now we're scaling internationally, and we're looking for developers who want to own meaningful work and help build the new industry standard.

The Opportunity

This is more than a development role.
You'll play a key part in scaling a business-critical platform used by leading maritime organizations around the world. Working within a modern Microsoft ecosystem, you'll influence architecture, improve engineering practices, help drive our modernization initiatives, and explore how AI can enhance software development and product capabilities.
If you're someone who enjoys ownership, continuous improvement, and solving complex technical challenges, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

Design, build, and enhance enterprise SaaS applications using C# and .NET
Drive platform modernization and help evolve our architecture
Lead code reviews and promote engineering best practices
Identify opportunities to leverage AI across engineering workflows and product development
Introduce, evaluate, and improve AI-assisted development practices, coding agents, and automation tools
Build reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions using Clean Architecture and SOLID principles
Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes
Implement automated testing strategies across the development lifecycle
Work with Azure cloud services and modern DevOps tooling
Collaborate closely with Product, UX, QA, Cloud, and Frontend teams
Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve delivery efficiency
Take ownership of features from concept through production.

What You'll Bring

Strong experience with C#, .NET, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework
Experience building and maintaining enterprise-scale applications
Knowledge of Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, and design patterns
Experience modernizing legacy systems and improving existing platforms
Hands-on experience with Azure and modern CI/CD practices
Experience with automated testing and software quality practices
Interest in AI-assisted development or AI-powered applications
Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset
A proactive, ownership-driven approach to software engineering.

Nice to Have

Experience in maritime, logistics, or supply chain environments
Microsoft SQL Server, Vue.js, or Kubernetes experience
Advanced Azure expertise
Experience working closely with Product Owners or Agile teams

Why Join UAB-Online?

You'll build software that powers critical maritime operations around the world, where the code you ship has real operational impact for terminals and crews, not just another internal dashboard.
We're a scale-up, and it shows: we move fast, get things done, and give you the freedom to own features end-to-end, introduce new ideas, and shape both our platform and our engineering culture. Everyone here has a voice.
We also invest in you. As we grow, you grow, with room to deepen your expertise, raise the bar for the team, and take on more ownership over time. What defines us: we're genuine, collaborative, and we aim for excellence in everything we build.

If you're excited about building great software and helping shape the future of a rapidly growing platform, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: C# Software Developer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you a Software Developer with a passion for smart home batteries? Join us at NextEnergy!

At NextEnergy, we’re accelerating the energy transition with smart, innovative solutions that make a real impact. As a Software Developer, you play a key role in building technology that helps thousands of households use energy in a smarter, greener and more affordable way.

You’ll join a growing, ambitious team that works every day on the energy of tomorrow. We give you the space to contribute ideas, experiment with new solutions, and build features that deliver immediate results.

Who are we?

More and more of our electricity comes from the sun and wind, which means prices move along with it. Yet many households in the Netherlands are still tied to outdated fixed rates and miss out on the benefits of flexible pricing. We believe there’s a better way. We make dynamic energy accessible to everyone, so you can easily take advantage of cheaper, and sometimes even free, moments.

With smart technology and a fair, transparent approach, we ensure that the energy transition is not only good for the planet, but also for your wallet.

At NextEnergy, you join a fast-growing company where innovation is at the core. A place where we build the future of energy together and grow as a team. We give you the space to make an impact, take initiative and share ideas. Because at NextEnergy, we’re not working around the energy transition, we’re working right in the middle of it.

What will you do?

As a Software Developer, you’ll work within our Smart Home DevOps team, where you get the freedom and autonomy to shape the design, development, and maintenance of our applications together with your colleagues.

When it comes to building our applications, you’ll be involved in the following areas:

Back end: Develop and manage integrations with various home batteries and smart devices within household energy systems
Algorithms: Improve the algorithms that control customer home batteries and other smart devices
Back office: Build internal systems that help streamline and optimize our processes
Customer interfaces: Enhance our customer app that shows users their energy savings and battery performance

In Addition, You Will

Collaborate closely with experienced developers, with plenty of freedom to take initiative and shape the products you work on
Be part of a mature, fast-growing startup focused on innovations that accelerate the energy transition
Work on smart home solutions: dive into the integration and control of home batteries and smart devices, an essential and rapidly growing field
Contribute to a product that helps thousands of end users save energy through intelligent control of home batteries and other major household devices. The impact of your work is visible immediately
Develop applications that process large volumes of data quickly and efficiently

Job Requirements

What do you bring?

Experience developing (cloud) web applications, preferably also mobile applications
At least 5 years of experience with backend development in C#
Experience with low-code development (OutSystems is a plus) or the willingness to learn this technology
Knowledge of HTML/CSS/JavaScript
Experience building robust, testable software
Knowledge of technical design and architecture
Interest in smart home batteries and other devices and their role in sustainable energy solutions
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
A motivated mindset: you enjoy taking responsibility and can work both independently and as part of a team
You feel at home in a dynamic start-up environment

What do we offer?

Join a young, dynamic and experienced team where your ideas matter
Competitive salary
Pension plan: 1% employer contribution with DoenPensioen + optional personal contribution
Travel allowance (>10km): OV Business Card or mileage reimbursement, depending on your commute
25 vacation days (based on full-time employment)
Bucketlist Day: one extra day off per year to fulfill a dream
Working abroad: up to 20 workdays a year from anywhere in the world
Free lunch: fresh and delicious every day in our cozy canteen
Sports membership: free classes via Urban Sports Club
Corporate Benefits: discounts on a wide range of brands and activities
Fun & connection: monthly drinks and awesome team events
Referral bonus: refer a great colleague and earn up to €2.000

Ready to make a difference?

Apply now, we’re excited to hear from you!

Engineering Manager – SaaS | Utrecht (Hybrid) | 120k

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager for a growing SaaS organization in Utrecht. The company develops an innovative SaaS platform for the real estate sector, enabling real estate professionals to digitally manage and optimize their processes. The scalable product is used daily by more than 350 customers (In private & public sectors) in the real estate industry.

The international engineering team currently consists of 11 professionals and is entering an important next phase: transitioning from one team into two, and potentially three autonomous, cross-functional teams. You will work closely with the tech lead, who owns the technical direction, while you focusing on building high-performing teams!

We are looking for someone who has successfully guided this type of change before, someone who understands the challenges, has seen what can fail, and knows how to build high performing teams. As Engineering Manager, you will help shape the future engineering organization by creating more ownership, improving delivery and enabling teams to work more autonomously.

You will focus on:

Coaching and developing a team of 4-6 engineers.
Improving delivery processes and collaboration with Product.
Establishing clear ownership and effective ways of working.
Supporting organizational change and continuous improvement.

Who we are looking for

8+ years of experience in software engineering.
3+ years of experience managing engineering teams.
Experience scaling, restructuring or splitting engineering teams.
A hands-on mindset (approximately 50% management / 50% technical).
Strong communication skills in English and the ability to connect technology, product and business.
A background in C#/.NET and Azure is preferred. Experience with DevOps, Docker and Kubernetes is a plus, but other technical backgrounds are welcome.

What we offer

Hybrid working environment in Utrecht.
Salary up to 120k (Including Holiday Allowance)
Bonus opportunity and pension scheme.
Initial 12-month contract, after that permanent one.
A key role in shaping the next phase of a growing SaaS organization.

Apply or contact me via g.geefshuijsen@doghouse.nl

jobs.title: DevOps Cloud Engineer (Azure & Databricks)
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy creating secure, scalable cloud environments that enable innovation at enterprise scale?

As a DevOps Cloud Engineer (Azure & Databricks)
, you will help operate and develop the platforms that support Vattenfall’s data, analytics and AI ambitions. Your expertise in Azure, automation and cloud governance will contribute directly to our purpose: enabling fossil-free living through digital innovation and smarter use of data.

Your role

Within our Digital Platform Operations team, you will work with colleagues across cloud engineering
, architecture
, operations
and data platforms
to ensure that our Azure and Databricks
environments remain secure, reliable and future-ready.

You will play a key role in advancing a modern enterprise data platform that enables data-driven decision-making across Vattenfall while continuously improving automation, governance and user experience.

Your Key Responsibilities

Designing, implementing and operating Azure-based cloud platform solutions
Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Git and automation tools
Developing and managing Infrastructure as Code solutions using ARM, Bicep and scripting technologies
Automate provisioning, deployment and lifecycle management of cloud resources
Maintaining and improving self-service platform capabilities based on .NET Core and Angular
Ensuring platform reliability, availability and operational stability
Supporting administration and continuous improvement of Azure Databricks and Snowflake environments
Implementing security controls in alignment with enterprise policies and governance requirements
Collaborating with architects, developers and operations specialists to deliver secure and scalable cloud services

Azure Databricks Platform Operations & Governance

Operating and further developing Vattenfall’s Azure Databricks platform for analytics, data and AI workloads
Managing identity and access controls through Azure AD integration and RBAC principles
Supporting secure networking concepts including private endpoints and secure cluster connectivity
Implementing and maintaining data governance capabilities using Unity Catalog and related Databricks services
Managing platform resources using Infrastructure as Code approaches such as Terraform and ARM templates
Establishing compute standards, governance controls and cost optimisation practices
Enabling integrations with Azure Data Lake, Power BI, Snowflake and other enterprise services
Supporting onboarding and adoption of platform capabilities across teams
Contributing to monitoring, logging and security improvements throughout the platform landscape

Platform Improvement & FinOps

Identifying opportunities to improve performance, cost efficiency and sustainability of cloud services
Enhancing automation and self-service capabilities for platform users
Supporting the introduction of new cloud, AI and analytics capabilities
Helping to create a seamless developer and data practitioner experience across the platform ecosystem

Location

Amsterdam, Berlin, Stockholm and Katowice

Qualifications

Who are you?

You bring solid experience from cloud engineering environments and enjoy combining technology, security and automation to create reliable services for users. You are communicative, collaborative and enjoy working together with colleagues from different disciplines to solve complex challenges.

We believe you have

Several years of experience as a Cloud Engineer, DevOps Engineer or similar role in Azure environments
Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, preferably within operations, governance or platform engineering
Strong understanding of Azure services including Networking, Storage, App Services, Virtual Machines and Entra ID (Azure AD)
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD practices
Experience working with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as ARM, Bicep, Terraform and PowerShell
Knowledge of analytics and data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Spark or modern data lake architectures
Understanding of cloud governance, security and access management principles
Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python or similar technologies
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities
Professional communication skills in English (local language skills are a plus but not mandatory)

It is an advantage if you also have

Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost optimisation
Experience supporting enterprise AI or machine learning platforms

Additional Information

Our offer

A challenging and independent job in an informal, dynamic working environment. You can play a part in shaping the future of a company where the only constant is change. Besides being a challenging and inspiring place to work, we value a great work atmosphere!

At Vattenfall, we are convinced that striving for diversity helps building a more profitable efficient and attractive company. Therefore we seek a harmonious balance of employees in terms of gender, age, and ethnic and cultural backgrounds. We believe in work life balance and the flexibility to work from home.

More Information

We welcome your application in English, no later than,
24th of September 2026
. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the role, please contact the Hiring Manager Mansi Shamsingh Raghuwanshi
: mansishamsingh.raghuwanshi@vattenfall.de
for more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our Recruiter Marius Gläßge (marius.glaessge@vattenfall.de)
.

Trade union representatives in Sweden (IT)
are Sofi Wadström (Akademikerna), Patricia Ek (Unionen), Christer Gustafsson (Ledarna), Juha Siipilehto (SEKO). To get in contact with the representatives, please call Vattenfall´s switchboard +46 8 739 50 00.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall. The screening will be performed by a third party, DISA.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

Business Area IT

We design and build the digital backbone that moves Vattenfall forward — from modern infrastructure to large-scale digital transformation initiatives. We connect people, processes and technology while enabling automation, innovation and an intuitive user experience. By doing so, we create a smart and connected organisation that is ready for tomorrow's energy transition.

jobs.title: Senior Delphi Developer
jobs.description:
Location:
Amsterdam, Netherlands (on-site / hybrid - candidates based in the Netherlands or elsewhere in the EU with ability to work from Amsterdam)
Engagement Type:
Contract / Time & Materials, via staffing partner - initial term through 31 Aug 2027 (annually renewable)
Work Mode:
Agile / SAFe - organized in Planning Intervals (6 weeks / 3 sprints), embedded in customer scrum team
About the Role
Customer’s platform is a total engine management solution that gives lessors and operators visibility into engine health, risk exposure, and lifecycle financials. We are hiring a hands-on Senior Delphi Developer to join the engineering team as an embedded team member, working directly within customer’s Azure DevOps backlog, sprint ceremonies, and release process. This is an application maintenance and enhancement role on a mature, mission-critical Delphi/VCL codebase - not a greenfield build - so strong debugging, root-cause-analysis, and legacy-code comprehension skills matter as much as new feature development.
Key Responsibilities
Design, code, and unit test new features and enhancements to the Customer Delphi application (VCL/DevExpress-based desktop application).
Debug and resolve production issues and customer-reported bugs; perform root-cause analysis and document findings.
Write and optimize MS SQL Server stored procedures, functions, and queries supporting EFPAC's data layer.
Refactor existing code for maintainability and performance; participate in peer code reviews.
Build and maintain automated unit tests; help sustain the program's 90%+ automated test coverage target.
Automate recurring engineering tasks via scripting and tooling integrated with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, PI planning, and sprint retrospectives as an active Scrum team member.
Collaborate with Boeing's Product Owner, Product Manager, and QA team to translate requirements and defects into technical designs.
Produce supporting documentation: software design notes, algorithms, test evidence, and review checklists.
Support ad hoc initiatives on request - recreating customer scenarios, feasibility studies, and DevOps-related tasks.

Must-Have Skills
5+ years professional Delphi development (Delphi 11 or later strongly preferred; Delphi 10.x acceptable).
Solid grasp of Delphi/VCL fundamentals: packages, DLLs, and the Parallel Programming Library.
Hands-on experience with DevExpress VCL components (grids, ribbons, docking, reporting) for building/maintaining Delphi UIs.
Database connectivity frameworks: ADO and FireDAC.
Strong MS SQL Server skills: writing and optimizing stored procedures, functions, and queries.
Working knowledge of Azure DevOps - backlog/work item management, Git-based source control, and CI/CD pipelines.
Practical experience with Agile/Scrum delivery; SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) exposure is a plus.
Comfortable owning tasks end-to-end: design, code, unit test, and defend the fix in review with a demanding enterprise client.
Professional English proficiency - direct daily interaction with customer stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have
Prior experience in aviation, engineering asset management, or other regulated/mission-critical industrial software.
Exposure to legacy application modernization or migration-to-cloud initiatives.
Experience with Microsoft Azure beyond DevOps (hosting, data services) given customer’s cloud migration roadmap.
Prior experience working as an embedded vendor resource inside a large enterprise client's Agile team.

Sourcing Notes for Recruiters
Delphi is a shrinking, senior-skewed talent pool in both the Netherlands/EU and India; expect a longer search cycle than for mainstream stacks (Java/.NET/Python). Prioritize candidates with the Delphi + DevExpress VCL + SQL Server combination specifically, sourced from industrial, financial, logistics, or engineering-tools companies still running legacy Delphi systems in production, rather than generalist Delphi-only profiles.
Note on Role Scope
This is a single, generalist developer position covering Delphi coding, SQL Server work, and Azure DevOps tooling.

jobs.title: Integratie Engineer
jobs.description:
Wil jij aan de slag gaan met innovatieve en state-of-the-art technologieën op het gebied van API’s, cloud integratie, data en systemen, en mensen en processen? Bij ilionx kan dit!

Jouw Functie Als Integratie Engineer

Onder het label Integratie zit een breed pallet aan werkzaamheden. In het ene traject ben je samen met je collega’s bezig om het nieuwe integratie landschap vorm te geven, terwijl je bij de andere klant je tanden zet in het omzetten van een niet-gedocumenteerd stuk oude software naar moderne integraties. Het fijne is dat je bij ilionx veel invloed hebt op de trajecten waar je in zit. Sommige collega’s werken graag op meerdere opdrachten tegelijk, terwijl anderen al jaren met veel plezier één en dezelfde klant bedienen. Wat vast staat is dat je werkt aan uitdagende en uiteenlopende projecten. Dit doe je in house, vanuit huis of gezellig bij de klant. Als Integratie/API Specialist loop je voorop in de technische ontwikkelingen die je toepast in nieuwe en bestaande software. Zo werk je veelal met de technologie van Red Hat, TIBCO of MuleSoft op het gebied van integratie, API’s, events, microservices en cloud. Je bent echter zeker niet beperkt tot deze technologieën. Andere specifieke kennis of ideeën zijn bij ons van harte welkom!

Wat Bieden Wij Jou

Een salaris van tussen de €4.000,- en €6.000,- o.b.v. 40 uur met bonussysteem
Een omgeving waarin het hybride werken compleet omarmd wordt
Duik in moderne projecten en opdrachten die jouw expertise en creativiteit uitdagen
Werken in een team waar jouw ideeën en initiatieven worden gewaardeerd en gestimuleerd
Technische trainingen op maat met certificaten die jouw expertise onderstrepen
Persoonlijk loopbaantraject, met alle ruimte om je eigen carrière pad te bewandelen
Samenwerking met ervaren collega’s in data, cloud en security

Wat Vragen Wij Van Jou

Een scherpe, analytische en creatieve blik
Een nieuwsgierige, vernieuwende mentaliteit
Vasthoudendheid bij het omzetten van vragen naar werkende oplossingen
Dat je een leuke, slimme, hardwerkende collega bent
Je bent klant- en resultaatgericht
Je schrijft en spreekt de Nederlandse taal vloeiend

Verder Heb Je

Een afgeronde hbo of wo opleiding, of autodidact met de juiste werkervaring
Goede zelfkennis, weten wat je kunt en vooral ook wat je niet kunt
Sterke affiniteit met techniek
Analytisch denkvermogen
Kritisch op kwaliteit, maar waar nodig pragmatisch
Goede communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden, we praten graag

Bovenstaande criteria zijn een indicatie van het profiel dat we zoeken. We beseffen dat elk individu een unieke set aan vaardigheden, expertise, skills en denkwijzen met zich meebrengt. Tegelijkertijd blijkt uit onderzoek dat sommigen pas solliciteren als er een 100% match is. Hierbij nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren als je je herkent in het profiel, óók als je niet aan alle eisen voldoet!

Het team

Je werkt in toffe teams, met een mix van skills en senioriteit. We zijn goed in ons vak omdat we doen waar we van houden. En (werk)geluk groeit als je deelt waar je van houdt. Daarom organiseren we regelmatig interactieve kennissessies en webinars, promoten we innovatie & productontwikkeling, en zijn er gilde bijeenkomsten, etc.

We vinden het ook belangrijk dat je sturing geeft aan je eigen ontwikkeling, je kan daarom volop trainingen volgen. Daarnaast krijg je een coach die je helpt op inhoud en persoonlijke effectiviteit. En – teamwork moet ook leuk blijven – we hebben veel sportieve en gezellige uitjes en voor wie wil een jaarlijkse ski trip naar de Alpen!

Ons kennisarsenaal is onderverdeeld in drie elkaar overlappende disciplines: Integratie & API, Applicatie Modernisatie en Data Driven. Binnen deze specialismen wordt er voortdurend verkennend gekeken naar de nieuwste en natuurlijk coolste technologieën. Directe en nauwe samenwerking onderling is ook hierin ‘a way of life’.

Lees hier ervaringen van collega’s.

Wat krijg je er voor terug

Contract voor onbepaalde tijd
Goede pensioenregeling
Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden
Aantrekkelijke bonus
Lease auto of mobiliteitsvergoeding
Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen
Uitdagende werkomgeving
Werk hybride, thuis of op kantoor
Thuiswerkvergoeding
Agenda vol evenementen en borrels
Tijd voor ontspanning
Flexibele feestdagen
Leasefietsregeling

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Over de vacature

In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen, implementeren en optimaliseren van automatiseringsoplossingen binnen onze engineeringprogramma’s. Je richt je op het efficiënter maken van ontwerp- en engineeringprocessen door Autodesk Inventor en Autodesk Vault optimaal te benutten. Met jouw technische kennis zorg je ervoor dat repetitieve werkzaamheden worden geautomatiseerd, systemen naadloos samenwerken en onze engineers efficiënter kunnen werken. Daarnaast ondersteun je collega’s bij technische vraagstukken en draag je actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze automatiseringsstrategie. Na jouw inwerkperiode word je o.a. verantwoordelijk voor de volgende taken:

Het beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande engineering- en automatiseringssystemen, zoals Autodesk Vault, Autodesk Inventor en het ERP-systeem Ridder iQ.
Het signaleren van verbeterkansen en actief meedenken over het optimaliseren van processen en werkmethoden.
Het ontwikkelen, testen en implementeren van nieuwe automatiseringsoplossingen en maatwerkfunctionaliteiten, bijvoorbeeld met behulp van API’s en programmeertalen zoals Python, C# en .NET.
Het realiseren en onderhouden van koppelingen tussen verschillende bedrijfssystemen voor een betrouwbare en efficiënte gegevensuitwisseling.
Het automatiseren van terugkerende werkzaamheden en het optimaliseren van data-, document- en versiebeheer.
Het ondersteunen van gebruikers bij technische vraagstukken en het oplossen van verstoringen binnen de systemen.
Het opstellen en onderhouden van technische documentatie en werkinstructies.
Het delen van kennis, begeleiden van gebruikers en ondersteunen bij de implementatie van nieuwe functionaliteiten.
Het volgen van technologische ontwikkelingen en deze waar mogelijk vertalen naar praktische toepassingen binnen de organisatie.

Jouw achtergrond

Je bent analytisch en communicatief sterk en vindt het fijn om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken. Je hebt kennis van engineeringdatabeheer en hebt ervaring met het automatiseren van technische processen. Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in de volgende zaken:
Minimaal HBO werk- en denkniveau;
Een afgeronde technische opleiding, bijvoorbeeld werktuigbouwkundige of informatica;
Ervaring met RidderIQ, Autodesk Inventor, Autodesk Vault en/of machinebouw is een pré;
Beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Waarom je bij ons wilt werken..

Werken bij Innovatec betekent werken met plezier en passie. Door de ruimte te krijgen om zelf met ideeën te komen en ze uit te voeren, halen we het beste naar boven in onze mensen.

Daarom voelt ons team zich betrokken bij de organisatie en zijn wij trots op ons werk. Deze trots leidt tot betere processen en tevreden klanten. En daar staan we voor! Uiteraard is dit nog niet alles en bieden wij je de volgende arbeidsvoorwaarden:
Een veelzijdige functie voor 40 uur per week (32 of 36 uur is bespreekbaar);
Een salaris dat past bij je werkervaring en functie. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je een marktconform salaris ontvangt;
27 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV- dagen (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband);
De keuze om je ADV om te zetten in extra salaris;
Pensioen ondergebracht bij het PME;
Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,25 per kilometer (boven de 10 kilometer woon/werkafstand), zonder gemaximeerd bedrag;

As part of a fast-growing product and technology organization, you will have the opportunity to influence the development of new teams and contribute to the creation of revolutionary products that shape the future of FinTech.

You will be integrated into one of our product teams, collaborating closely with cross-functional members to design, develop, test, and deploy robust software applications, APIs, and workflows. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer / Architect (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir sind die byteAgenten. Seit 2008 lösen wir gewachsene Altsysteme ab und bauen datensouveräne Individualsoftware – performant, wartbar und mit herausragender Usability. Aber die Welt der Software-Entwicklung dreht sich weiter – und wir drehen uns mit.

Wir suchen erfahrene Entwickler mit tiefer technischer Expertise, die auf der neuen Abstraktionsebene arbeiten wollen: über das Ergebnis entscheiden Anforderungen und Architektur, die Implementierung beschleunigt KI. Unser Fokus ist die Ablösung von Altsystemen in Industrie und Mittelstand: KI-gestützte Rekonstruktion der Fachlogik, moderne Architekturen, Datenmigration und Betrieb in der EU oder on-premises. Dazu gehört für uns auch die Beratung des Kunden, nicht nur die Umsetzung.

Bist du bereit, nicht nur User Stories umzusetzen, sondern Projekte aktiv zu gestalten? Bei uns arbeitest du in Projekten an der Schnittstelle von High-Performance-Architektur, KI-gestützter Effizienz mit eigenem AI-Dev Harness und echter Kundenberatung. Als Teil unseres festen Teams in Deutschland oder Österreich genießt du große Freiheiten, kombiniert mit dem Rückhalt aller byteAgenten.

Deine Mission

Du gestaltest nicht nur Software, sondern wirkst im gesamten Entstehungsprozess mit, vom Legacy-Check und ersten Requirements-Workshop bis zur Abschaltung des Altsystems.
Du nutzt deine Erfahrung, KI und moderne Tools nicht nur als Mittel zum Zweck, sondern als Multiplikator für Kundenprojekte und steigerst damit die Qualität deiner Lösungen. Unser AI-Dev Harness gibt dir dafür den Rahmen: definierte Arbeitsschritte, wiederholte Prüfschleifen gegen Code, Daten und Tests sowie feste Kontrollpunkte mit deiner Freigabe.
Du berätst unsere Kunden auf Augenhöhe, verstehst deren Business-Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in eine solide Systemarchitektur.
Du bist Teamplayer. Du weißt, welche Aufgaben du an Junior-Developer delegieren kannst, was du automatisiert löst und wo dein Deep-Dive als Experte gefragt ist.
Du evaluierst neue Technologien und prägst die technologische Roadmap der byteAgenten aktiv mit.

Dein Agenten-Leben

Wir bieten dir große persönliche Flexibilität im Rahmen einer Festanstellung. Abhängig vom Projekt genießt du Autonomie bei Arbeitsort und Zeiteinteilung – bei uns zählt das Ergebnis und die Qualität. Wir vertrauen darauf, dass du weißt, wie du dich am besten organisierst.
Im Grunde wählst du deine Werkzeuge selbst (z. B. Mac/Win), je nach Kunde nutzt du die Tools, welche für die Rahmenbedingungen am besten passen.
Neben Schulungen und Zertifizierungen bieten wir dir den Freiraum, dich zum Tech-Consultant oder Leader weiterzuentwickeln. Dein jährliches „Build your own Company“-Gespräch ist dein Hebel für Veränderungen.
Wir leben flache Hierarchien und ein familiäres Miteinander. Bei uns gibt es kein Micromanagement – Vertrauen ist unser wichtigstes Asset.
Unsere Benefits: Fitness Studio im Bürogebäude, Job-Rad oder Firmenwagen, Deutschlandticket und eine Spendit Card.

Deine Must-haves:

Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Informatik, Ingenieurwesen) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Viel wichtiger ist uns jedoch deine mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Realisierung komplexer Enterprise-Software-Projekte und in der Arbeit mit gewachsenen Bestandssystemen sowie dein sicheres Gespür für Machbarkeit und den damit verbundenen Aufwand.
Du beherrschst moderne Technologien wie Java / Spring Boot, .NET / C# oder TypeScript / Node im Backend sowie Angular, React oder Vue.js im Frontend. Clean Code, Architektur- und Designpatterns nutzt du instinktiv, um wartbaren und skalierbaren Code zu produzieren.
Du nimmst Anforderungen nicht nur entgegen, sondern hinterfragst sie kritisch. Du erkennst Feature Creep frühzeitig und kannst technische Entscheidungen souverän moderieren sowie in verständlichen Roadmaps für das Management aufbereiten.

Deine Nice-to und Want-to-haves:

Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude Code, GitHub Copilot oder andere Modelle, um Entwicklungszeiten zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig die Code-Qualität durch automatisierte Reviews und Tests zu steigern.
Du entwirfst skalierbare Software-Architekturen und bist sicher im Umgang mit Cloud-Ökosystemen (AWS, Azure oder GCP) ebenso wie mit On-Premises-Betrieb, Containerisierung (Docker, Kubernetes) und modernen CI/CD-Pipelines.
Du verstehst Application Security als Kernanforderung. Du kennst die OWASP Top 10, implementierst sichere Authentifizierung (OAuth2, OIDC) und achtest auf Schwachstellenprävention.
Du handelst wie ein „Unternehmer im Unternehmen“. Du hast den Blick für die Wirtschaftlichkeit technischer Entscheidungen, erkennst Potenziale für Prozessoptimierungen und treibst Themen proaktiv voran.
Du liebst es, Verantwortung für Ergebnisse zu tragen. Du strukturierst Aufgaben effizient und delegierst sie gezielt an Junior-Developer oder KI-Assistenten, während du die technologischen Leitplanken sicherstellst.
Du berätst unsere Kunden sicher auf Deutsch (C1/C2) und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

Jahresgehalt 70K€ bis 90K€

Wir wissen, dass du den einen oder anderen Skill nicht mitbringst. Aber wenn dich die Rolle reizt, und du dich weiterentwickeln möchtest, schick uns deinen LinkedIn-Link oder einen Lebenslauf. Wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich für ein erstes Online-Kennenlernen. In einem zweiten Gespräch testen wir dein fachliches Know-how und entscheiden ob und wie es weiter geht. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Description

Amazon Web Services has enabled large enterprises and growing startups to move quickly by increasing developer productivity. Security, auditability and governance in the cloud has moved from being a top concern to top reason for adopting Cloud services. AWS Config and Config Rules have been leading this transition by providing insights into user activity, change tracking and automated security and compliance tools.

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer to join a highly respected team building one of the largest configuration audit platforms in the world. We are building agentic AI solutions that automate the end-to-end lifecycle of resource type onboarding - from research and schema authoring through testing, validation, and deployment. You'll work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and AI-driven automation, designing agents that can reason about AWS service APIs, author configuration schemas, and validate correctness with minimal human intervention.

Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

AWS Config is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Own solutions across the full lifecycle: design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and support.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

to join the Tech

Everyone has an idea of what a water company does. But for us, it’s so much more than this. We look after communities, protect the environment, and plan to look after Yorkshire’s water, today, tomorrow 24/7, 365 days a year. We provide essential water and wastewater services to every corner of the Yorkshire region, and play a key role in the region’s health, wellbeing, and prosperity. New environmental legislation, unprecedented levels of investment and changing expectations from customers means that this is an exciting time to discover opportunities within the water industry. The Tech team are a key part of how we plan to meet the changing expectations of customers and regulators.  

Join us as a Senior Software Developer and help shape the future of our cloud-based platforms. Working with .NET (C#) and Azure, you'll design and deliver scalable microservice APIs that power customer-facing applications. Collaborating with architects and cross-functional Agile teams, you'll have the opportunity to influence technical direction, champion best practices, and build innovative solutions that make a real impact across the business.

Where you fit in:

Input into the design and lead development of global APIs, and the associated integration whilst maintaining and supporting the IT Programme of work. 
Contribute to the software development standards and governance whilst ensuring that deliverables by you and the wider team adherence to them.
Contribute to the technical procurement and adoption standards for commercial services and systems.

jobs.title: Senior Integration and Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Location: Bristol or Manchester hybrid (regular travel to partner sites across the UK and Ireland as needed)

Role Type: Permanent (full-time preferred, flexible working considered)

About PACT Solutions:

PACT Solutions is a specialist management and digital transformation consultancy working exclusively with higher education institutions across the UK. 

We help universities solve complex challenges across strategy, student records, data, change and delivery. Our work often sits at the heart of major institutional transformation, helping partners improve the student journey, modernise operations and deliver change more effectively. 

PACT has grown quickly and is now entering its next phase. We are moving from a founder-led boutique consultancy into a more scaled and structured business, while protecting the quality, culture and partner focus that have made us successful. 

Our culture is crucial to our success. Each day, our team significantly contributes to our business and that of our partners.  

We combine the agility and collaborative spirit of a close-knit consultancy with the credibility, structure, and professionalism needed to deliver meaningful digital transformation. 

Our values sit at the heart of everything we do and are core to our business. 

Partnership: We work with you, not for you. 

Integrity: We do the right thing, even when it requires difficult conversations.  

Curiosity: We dig deeper to uncover what will truly deliver value.  

Transformation: We focus on outcomes that create lasting, measurable improvement.  

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Integration and Solution Architect to own the architecture of data integration solutions across our higher education partners. You will define the integration framework: the principles, patterns, standards and technical decisions that determine what is built and how it is built.

This is an architecture role, not a day-to-day delivery management role. Working alongside colleagues who lead programme and technical delivery, you will provide the architectural direction and assurance that enable secure, resilient and maintainable integrations across complex transformation programmes.

You will combine strong consulting skills with practical experience of Azure Integration Services and software engineering. You will shape target-state architectures, guide solution design and support teams to apply consistent, reusable approaches.

Purpose of the role

To support the delivery of effective, practical and people-centred change activity that helps PACT's partners adopt new systems, processes and ways of working successfully.

Key Responsibilities

Integration and solution architecture
Own the integration architecture for assigned partner programmes and shape the target-state integration landscape.
Define and evolve integration principles, reference architectures, patterns, standards and reusable components.
Translate business, data and operational requirements into clear solution architectures, design decisions and technical roadmaps.
Set the approach to API design, data contracts, message design, asynchronous processing, error handling, security, observability and resilience.
Assess architectural options and technical trade-offs, providing clear recommendations to partners and delivery teams.
Solution design and technical assurance
Design practical, scalable and maintainable integrations using Azure Integration Services, including Azure Service Bus, APIs and related Azure services.
Provide architectural assurance at key design, build, test and deployment points, ensuring solutions conform to agreed standards.
Review technical designs, code and documentation to improve consistency, quality and long-term supportability.
Support the resolution of complex integration issues and design risks, focusing on root cause and sustainable architectural outcomes.
Stakeholder and consulting leadership
Lead architecture workshops, discovery sessions and design forums with senior business and technical stakeholders.
Build trusted relationships with stakeholders up to Head of Service and senior manager level.
Explain complex technical concepts in clear business language and challenge constructively where decisions create avoidable risk or compromise.
Work closely with programme, product, data and technical delivery colleagues so architectural decisions are understood and actionable.
Capability development
Develop PACT's integration framework, methodologies, standards, reusable assets and propositions.
Coach consultants and engineers in sound integration design and engineering practice.
Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and the continued development of PACT's Data Integration capability.

What we offer

The opportunity to shape integration architecture across major higher education transformation programmes.
Work with Azure Integration Services, Azure Service Bus, Python and .NET in complex enterprise environments.
Development of consulting, architecture and technical capability.
A clear progression path through PACT's consulting career pathway, including Principal-level opportunities.
The opportunity to shape PACT's Data Integration capability.

This role sits at the Senior Consultant within PACT's consulting career pathway (Analyst → Consultant → Senior Consultant → Lead → Principal), providing a strong foundation to develop core consulting and delivery skills.

Requirements

Essential experience

Significant experience as an Integration Architect, Solution Architect or similar senior architecture role in complex enterprise environments.
Strong integration architecture capability, including API design, messaging patterns, asynchronous processing, event-driven integration and data contracts.
Ability to define architectural principles, standards, patterns and reusable components, and apply them across multiple systems and teams.
Hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services, particularly Azure Service Bus, APIs and related Azure services.
Strong Python and/or .NET development capability, with experience building or assuring production-grade integration services.
Ability to design secure, scalable and maintainable integrations, including observability, error handling, resilience and supportability.
Experience facilitating architecture workshops, communicating technical trade-offs and influencing senior stakeholders.
Experience reviewing and assuring technical designs, documentation and engineering outputs.

Desirable

Experience within higher education.
Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as SIS, ERP, CRM and VLE systems.
Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, source control and automated testing.
Experience in consultancy or transformation environments.

Benefits

PACT offers a flexible and supportive approach to work, including hybrid and flexible working arrangements. Our benefits package includes enhanced pension contributions, an annual bonus and enhanced parental leave, helping our people balance a rewarding career with the commitments that matter to them.

If you’re passionate about building smart, scalable, game changing solutions, this is your moment. We’re searching for Microsoft Dynamics Engineers to join our innovative and ambitious Customer Engagement Platform team at our Head Office in Skipton — officially named the happiest place to live in Great Britain for 2025/2026 by Rightmove’s annual Happy at Home survey. There’s no better place to grow your career and make an impact.

Who Are We?

Not just another building society. Not just another job.

We're the fourth biggest building society in the UK and what makes us a bit different is that we're a mutual organisation. We don't have shareholders; we're owned by our members.

Our colleagues say Skipton's a great place to work, and you could be one of them, bringing with you new ideas on how we can keep customers at the heart of what we do.

Whatever your background, and whatever your goals, we'll help you take the next step towards a better future.

Why This Role Matters

As a Dynamics Engineer, you’ll be at the heart of our digital evolution. You’ll develop, innovate, and maintain Dynamics solutions that streamline processes, empower colleagues, and enhance the experience of our members. You’ll collaborate with stakeholders across the business, turning ideas into powerful, automated products that make a real difference.

What’s In It For You?

Skipton values work/life balance and we are proud to support hybrid and flexible working, where possible. We have a newly refurbished head office which offers a vibrant and collaborative working space.

We have a range of other benefits available to you including

Annual discretionary bonus scheme

25 days standard annual leave + bank holidays + rising 1 day per year of service to a maximum of 30 days

Holiday trading scheme allowing the ability to buy and sell additional annual leave days

Matching employer pension contribution (up to 10% per annum)

Colleague mortgage (conditions apply)

Salary sacrifice scheme for hybrid & electric car

A commitment to training and development

3 paid volunteering days per annum

Diverse and inclusive colleague networks available for you to join including our Carers and Pride Alliance groups

We care about your health and wellbeing – we provide a range of benefits that support this including cycle to work initiative and discounted gym membership

What Will You Be Doing?

You will lead end-to-end technical delivery of solutions for our Customer Engagement Platform built on Microsoft Dynamics 365. Ensure solutions are designed and engineered using appropriate methods and tools, aligned to organisational strategy, security, and standards. Drive adoption of best practices in solution architecture and ALM to meet business goals, deliver value to stakeholders, and manage technical risk. What Do We Need From You?

Lead and take ownership across all stages and iterations of Dynamics delivery.
Plan, drive, and evaluate Dataverse solution construction (tables, relationships, forms, views, model-driven apps) aligning with engineering and security standards
Design and implement server-side extensions (C# plug-ins, custom workflow activities) and client-side behaviours (TypeScript/JavaScript, form/context APIs)
Define and execute robust integration patterns using Azure Functions, Service Bus, Webhooks, virtual tables and API Management; ensure observability with Application Insights
Automate business processes with Power Automate (cloud flows) with error handling
Establish ALM practices: solution layering, environment strategies, CI/CD using Power Platform Build Tools and Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions.
Assure security-by-design (environment roles, security roles, field security, DLP policies) and compliance (auditing, GDPR)
Set quality standards via reviews, Solution Checker, static analysis and test automation
Optimise performance and scalability (plugin pipeline optimisation, batching, concurrency controls, index strategy)
Provide production support leadership, troubleshooting complex incidents and driving root-cause remediation via controlled releases.
Evaluate emerging platform capabilities and their organisational impact. Champion continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for someone who blends technical expertise with curiosity, creativity, and a passion for improvement.

Ideally, You’ll Have

Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant Associate (PL-200)
Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Service Functional Consultant Associate (MB-230)
Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)

If you’re excited by the potential of automation and want to help shape the future of how we work, we’d love to hear from you.

Ready to Make an Impact?

Jo in us and help build the next generation of digital solutions at Skipton, the happiest place to live in Great Britain. This is your chance to innovate, collaborate, and create technology that truly matters.

Company Profile

Thermoteknix Systems Ltd, founded in 1982 and based in Cambridge, is a world leader in thermal imaging, night vision, and augmented reality systems. Our award-winning technologies are trusted by defence, security, and industrial customers in over 70 countries. With in-house R&D, cutting-edge innovation, and a global reputation for quality, we design and manufacture solutions that perform in the toughest environments.

Due to increasing market opportunities and an ever-growing product range, Thermoteknix is expanding its engineering capacity by expanding the New Product Introduction (NPI) team within R&D.

We are looking for an exceptionally motivated graduate software engineer who is passionate about software and enjoys solving difficult engineering problems. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to apply strong software engineering skills to real products, working at the intersection of software, electronics, firmware, automation, and manufacturing.

About You

As a member of the NPI team, you will be responsible for developing and supporting the software-driven automation and test systems used to transition products from development into scalable, repeatable manufacturing.

You will work closely with R&D, manufacturing, and quality teams, applying strong software engineering principles to implement comprehensive automated testing and validation processes.

Additionally, you will contribute to the enhancement of existing software to improve production test speed, reliability, and capability, ensuring that products are thoroughly tested and validated before reaching customers.

This is an opportunity for a graduate who wants to become an outstanding software engineer while working on real-world products and complex hardware/software systems.

Key Responsibilities

Support software and test design processes, ensuring DFT principles are applied throughout the product development lifecycle.
Support software and test workstreams within NPI projects, ensuring readiness for build and scale, and supporting the transition of products through to customer delivery.
Define and implement robust processes for firmware programming, product configuration, calibration data handling, and version control in production builds.
Define, develop, and document automated test processes during product development for new products and assemblies.
Work with mechanical and electronics engineers within the NPI team to design automated electromechanical test systems that optimise production throughput and ensure product quality.
Drive improvements in manufacturing readiness by identifying and implementing opportunities to streamline production test and build times.
Provide hands-on support during NPI builds, troubleshooting software, automation, and hardware-integrated system issues within the ECN framework.
Work with the quality department to support non-conformance investigations and product quality improvements during NPI phases.
Contribute to the development of the new NPI team's standards and processes.
Continuously look for opportunities to improve software quality, automation, test coverage, reliability, and development processes.

Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and solve complex technical problems.
Strong experience developing software in C#, with knowledge of WPF and MVVM methodologies.
Experience developing software tools, applications, or automation projects, ideally involving interaction with hardware or real-world systems, through academic, personal, or professional projects.
Understanding of software development practices including source control, testing, debugging, release processes, and configuration control.
Ability to troubleshoot software issues and communicate effectively with embedded hardware-integrated systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
Ability to create technical documentation and work within controlled software development and change management processes.
Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Commercial industry experience is not required. We are more interested in strong software engineering ability, technical curiosity, and the drive to learn than years of industry experience. Academic, personal, placement, and internship projects are all relevant.

Desirable Skills & Experience

Familiarity with embedded firmware programming tools.
Knowledge of manufacturing test systems, calibration workflows, and automation frameworks.
Knowledge of additional programming languages such as LabVIEW and C/C++.
Experience or academic/personal project exposure developing software that communicates with hardware, instruments, sensors, or embedded systems.
Understanding of engineering change control, ISO 9001 environments, and traceability requirements.
Exposure to thermal imaging products, or real-time embedded systems.
Exposure to the design or use of jigs, fixtures, tooling, or electronic test equipment through academic, personal, or project-based work.

Personal Attributes

Passionate about software and genuinely enjoys writing code.
Naturally curious and keen to understand how things work, from software through to electronics and hardware.
Hands-on, proactive, and solution-focused.
Enjoys tackling difficult technical problems and finding practical solutions.
Strong communication skills with engineering and production stakeholders.
Comfortable working across both software development and physical engineering environments.
Driven to improve processes and software quality and deliver manufacturing excellence.
Self-motivated and keen to learn from experienced engineers while contributing ideas of your own.

This role would suit a graduate who has gone beyond simply completing their degree and has demonstrated a genuine passion for software engineering.

Perhaps you have built software projects during university or in your own time, contributed to open-source projects, developed tools for yourself or others, competed in programming or engineering challenges, or simply spend your free time learning new technologies and understanding how things work.

You do not need to have years of manufacturing experience. What matters is that you have strong software fundamentals, intellectual curiosity, a high level of technical ability, and a desire to become an exceptional engineer.

jobs.description:
The Role:

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 
The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system. 

What This Role Is Not: 

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title. 

What You Will Work On:

Technical Leadership 

Define and own the technical roadmap for autonomous constellation operations
Set the architectural direction for the data platform, reliability systems, and automation infrastructure
Stay hands-on: review code, prototype solutions, and get into the details when it matters
Establish engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing, and observability, and hold the team to them
Be the person engineers come to when the problem is genuinely hard

Team Building & Culture 

Recruit, develop, and retain a team of 6 to 10 world-class reliability and platform engineers
Set the pace, tone, and ambition for the team and make being on it feel like a privilege
Create an environment where engineers grow fast, own their work, and ship things they are proud of
Identify gaps and level up engineers through mentorship and not just management

Operational Transformation 

Lead the shift from manual, operator-driven processes to fully automated and self-healing operations
Define and drive toward SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets for the constellation
Partner with satellite operations and mission teams to translate pain into software solutions

Cross-Functional Influence 

Be the technical voice of the team in company-wide conversations about architecture, infrastructure, and platform strategy
Influence how Spire thinks about automation, data, and AI/ML across the broader engineering organization

Basic Qualifications: 

7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 in a technical leadership or staff-level individual contributor role
Demonstrated track record building and shipping reliable production systems at scale. You have owned things that could not go down.
Deep technical credibility. Engineers on your teams have respected your judgment and not just your title.
Experience with SRE principles, reliability engineering, or large-scale automation. You have reduced toil systematically and not just complained about it.
Strong foundation in Python, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
Experience hiring and developing engineers. You know what great looks like and how to find it.
The communication and influence skills to drive technical decisions across teams you do not directly control

Preferred Qualifications: 

Experience applying AI/ML or advanced analytics to operational or monitoring problems
Experience writing performance software in Rust
Background in space systems, aerospace, or highly constrained real-time environments
Experience building data lakes, telemetry platforms, or observability infrastructure at scale
A history of leading teams through technical transformations and not just maintaining the status quo

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.
Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying.

The role

Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.

Experiencing the full-stack of software development opportunities as a valued team member.

Good problem-solving skills.

Your work will directly contribute to the development of next-generation cybersecurity solutions aimed at combating sophisticated AI-driven cyber threats. As part of our highly talented and diverse team, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate ideas from rapid prototypes into robust, production-ready systems. Contribute to continuous integration and deployment pipelines to streamline development workflows.
Stay updated with the latest industry trends, tools, and technologies to enhance product offerings.
Take ownership of technical tasks and contribute to the innovation of cybersecurity solutions.

Equal Opportunity

jobs.description:
Senior SQA Engineer – Test Automation / Manual Testing

Job Title:

Senior SQA Engineer – Test Automation / Manual Testing

About us:

Accuris launched in May 2023 as a standalone company and was formerly known as S&P Global’s Engineering Solutions division. Accuris has been an integral part of the engineering ecosystem for more than 60 years and is valued for standards content and workflow solutions including Engineering Workbench, Goldfire, Haystack, and Parts Management Solutions.

The Team:

The Engineering Workbench team builds and evolves a flagship Accuris product used globally by engineering professionals. The team focuses on delivering robust, scalable, and secure cloud-based solutions in AWS, supported by strong software quality practices across manual testing, automation, defect management, and CI/CD validation.

You will collaborate closely with software developers, QA specialists, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders. The team values ownership, practical test automation, clear communication, continuous improvement, and proactive collaboration across disciplines.

The Impact:

As a Senior SQA Engineer, you will design software testing plans, create and execute manual and automated tests, and help ensure the quality of web applications and services throughout the full product lifecycle, including Production.

You will guide the team on when and how to automate effectively, influence testability during design and development phases, coordinate defect management, and provide clear test results, regression feedback, and quality insights to development teams.

Responsibilities:

Design software testing plans and create and execute both manual and automated tests using test automation tools including, but not limited to Selenium and Playwright.
Understand the concepts behind automation, know when automation is appropriate, and guide the team on how to create the right tests.
Coordinate team members to solve issues assigned to the team and support timely resolution of quality risks.
Monitor Production quality and coordinate resolution of issues assigned to teams.
Ensure compliance of team testing activities with project rules, quality standards, and agreed processes.
Participate in functional testing during CI/CD processes and support reliable product releases.
Organize and monitor defect management processes within teams.
Influence the inclusion of testability during design, grooming, and development phases.
Test the product in all phases of its lifecycle, including Production.
Interface with developers in the project by providing clear test results and identifying regression areas.

What We’re Looking For:

Key qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years of automation engineering experience with Selenium WebDriver and/or Playwright using C#/.NET and xUnit frameworks.
Experience testing web applications built with .NET Core, microservices, and AngularJS, including cross-browser and cross-device validation using automated tools.
Solid knowledge of databases, including the ability to write CRUD operations, work with JOINs, and validate data-driven application behavior.

Key soft skills:

Strong collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate testing activities, defect management, and issue resolution across development teams.
Clear, structured communication with developers, including the ability to provide test results, regression areas, and actionable defect information.
Proactive approach to quality, testability, production monitoring, and continuous improvement throughout the software development lifecycle.
Good spoken and written English.

Required Knowledge / Technologies:

Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, C#/.NET, xUnit frameworks, manual testing, automated testing, functional testing, and test case/script design and execution.
Testing of web applications in .NET Core, microservices, AngularJS, client-server application architecture, RESTful APIs, and CI/CD processes.
Databases and SQL, including CRUD operations, JOINs, data validation, and practical understanding of application data flows.
Docker containerization basics, AWS cloud services such as EC2, S3, RDS, or similar, and development tools such as Visual Studio, VS Code, or Rider.
Agile software development, Azure DevOps / ADOPS bug tracking, defect management, and exposure to performance and load testing tools such as CloudTest, Cloud Testing using ADOPS, or K6 are considered a plus.

What’s in it for you:

Opportunity to shape testing strategy and improve automation practices for a flagship product used globally.
Hands-on work across manual testing, automation, API testing, CI/CD validation, production quality monitoring, and defect management.
Close collaboration with experienced developers, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders in an Agile environment.
Corporate support for personal growth and career development, provision of all necessary equipment, and benefits including medical package, Multisport, life insurance, and the internal Wellbeing program.

The Location:

Poland.

Budget:

PLN 20,000–24,000 gross per month, with flexibility depending on seniority and experience, plus 5% bonus.

Compensation/Benefits Information

Accuris states that the anticipated base salary / budget for this position is PLN 20,000–24,000 gross per month, with flexibility depending on seniority and experience. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographical location as well as experience and qualifications for the role. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for a 5% bonus as well as comprehensive benefits. For more information on benefits, please reach out to the recruiter assigned to the role.

Benefits include a medical package, Multisport, life insurance, internal Wellbeing program, corporate support for personal growth and career development, and provision of all necessary equipment.

About Company Statement:

Accuris delivers essential intelligence that powers decision making. We provide the world’s leading organizations with the right data, connected technologies, and expertise they need to move ahead. We think differently, combining the knowledge and resources of an established company with the unapologetic boldness of a startup. https://accuristech.com/https://accuristech.com/

Our mission: build an evolvable knowledge and data platform that enables STEM professionals to unlock and deliver innovation to the world’s most complex problems.

jobs.title: Director, Global WMS Software Engineering and Product Design
jobs.description:
Join our R&D Tech Hub in Warsaw

We’re building a new R&D Tech Hub in Poland and are looking for people who want to make a real impact from day one. You’ll be part of a globally connected team, helping to shape the culture and ways of working at our new location. This is a hands-on role in a supportive environment, where collaboration, learning, and adaptability are key.

We value practical problem-solving, diverse perspectives, and people who take ownership. If you're ready to contribute to meaningful projects and help lay the foundation for a growing team, we’d like to hear from you.

About the role: What's in the Box

HelloFresh is searching for an action-oriented servant leader for our warehouse management system (WMS) Software Engineering and Product functions. This leader owns the full software delivery lifecycle for HelloFresh's global warehouse fulfillment and inventory control domain — from architecture and product design through engineering execution, quality assurance, and operational reliability. You will drive a culture of product & engineering excellence, leveraging modern agentic tooling and AI-assisted workflows to increase team velocity, reduce defect escape rates, and accelerate deployment confidence.

You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across technology, operations, automation/production technology, procurement, and finance to deliver innovative solutions on our strategic WMS platform — Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) — while balancing competing priorities and technical resource demand.

The Director of WMS Engineering and Product will
work with key technology and product leaders across HelloFresh to enable the inventory management and control domain strategy, evaluate technology-related priorities, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines impeccable management and communication skills with a practitioner's instinct for modern software delivery — knowing how to build high-performing teams, establish engineering health metrics, and integrate AI-assisted tooling that meaningfully accelerates quality and velocity.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

WMS Solution Ownership: Provide technical direction, development oversight, and performance accountability for HelloFresh's deployment of Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform across all global locations
Integration Architecture & Reliability: Drive WMS application layer Integration architecture to upstream tooling and host systems via CI/CD pipelines [Debezium/Kafka to Snowflake/Databricks]
Platform Architecture: Partner/ support as needed the Hosting Architecture team in the optimal sizing and performance of WMS Architecture in AWS
Agentic Engineering & Developer Productivity: Champion and drive adoption of agentic engineering practices across the team: automated code review tooling (e.g., AI-assisted PR analysis, static analysis agents, LLM-powered code quality gates), AI-augmented test generation and execution, and intelligent deployment pipelines. Measure and report the impact of these practices on delivery velocity and defect escape rate
CI/CD & Deployment Automation: Own the maturity roadmap for CI/CD pipelines. Establish automated deployment workflows with robust rollback strategies, feature flagging, environment-specific gate checks, and infrastructure-as-code practices — enabling high-confidence, low-friction releases across all WMS environments
Quality Engineering & Test Automation: Partner with WMS Services and Support leadership to build a world-class QA function. Drive adoption of automated regression suites, AI-assisted edge case generation, and contract testing for integrations. Push teams beyond happy-path coverage toward comprehensive scenario validation, including automated performance and load testing for peak fulfillment periods
Engineering Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Establish DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore) as the foundation of engineering health reporting for the WMS organization. Set baselines, publish improvement targets, and use metric trends to identify bottlenecks, prioritize tooling and process investments, and communicate engineering performance to senior leadership
Technical Roadmap & Architecture Governance: Partner with peers and senior leadership on architectural decision-making for WMS platform evolution, integration patterns, and technology transitions. Champion the use of structured design reviews to maintain coherent, scalable technical direction. Lead evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including risk mitigation and transition planning
Vendor & Capacity Management: Work with department leadership to source and partner with 3rd-party vendors to augment internal engineering capacity and expertise. Maintain vendor performance accountability and ensure structured knowledge transfer to build durable internal capability
People Leadership & Talent Development: Coach, develop, and retain high-performing engineers, product managers, and team leads. Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to build organizational depth — playing an active role in recruiting, onboarding, and career development
International Standardization/ Release Consolidation. Partner with departmental leadership, peer domains, and executive leadership to own the long term roadmap for product consolidation to a single application release version administered globally
Cross-functional Leadership. Serve on both the Fulfillment Technology and overall Automation & Technology leadership teams, reinforcing HelloFresh DNA values, establishing KPIs, and prioritizing strategic initiatives at a departmental level

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

Technical/Engineering Experience

10+ years of warehouse management system (WMS) software engineering and implementation experience with a tier-one WMS in an RF-based distribution, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfillment environment
3+ years of direct hands-on experience with Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform with SQL Server
3+ years managing application integrations via microservices and associated toolsets, including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ETL pipelines
Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing gates, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices across multi-environment WMS or fulfillment technology stacks
Hands-on familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted engineering tools — including automated code review platforms, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeRabbit, SonarQube AI, or equivalent) — with a track record of driving meaningful team-wide adoption and measurable impact
Experience defining and tracking engineering delivery and quality metrics (DORA metrics or equivalent) and using data to drive process improvement and leadership reporting
Experience leading evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including developing and executing technology transition plans with appropriate risk mitigation strategies

Product Experience

Experience leading a design and product process that scales a digital technology operations ecosystem across volume growth, multiple brands, and new digital properties
Strategic thinker with the ability to build and execute innovative digital product strategy while executing tactically against multiple competing priorities simultaneously
Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, roadmaps, and delivery plans — and to communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to build leadership support for proactive technology investments, making the business case for engineering quality, automation, and platform modernization

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh Group better.
We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Health - You’re covered from your first day with private health insurance.
Flexible Working - We work in-office 3 days a week to align on goals, with flexible hours to support work-life balance and personal needs
Time Off - You receive 26 days of paid vacation each year, providing you time to rest and recharge.
Learning and Development - An annual Learning & Development budget and a Mentoring Program to support your ongoing professional growth.
Employee Referral Program - Our team members can take part in our internal employee referral program and receive a bonus for recommending successful candidates to open roles.
Daily Comforts - Free coffee, drinks, and fresh fruit are available to keep you refreshed throughout the day.
