jobs.description:
Who We Are

Sandbox Interactive is the ambitious game development studio behind the award-winning game Albion Online. The game is the first true cross-platform MMO, and is playable on Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS and Android with more than 350.000 daily players and over 2 million monthly visitors on our website. We started as a small independent group of experienced gaming professionals in 2012, and now employ an international team of more than 100 people. Since 2020, Sandbox Interactive has been part of the Stillfront Group. Our team is passionate about making Albion Online the best game it can be, and we’re constantly on the lookout for talented individuals to join our growing team in the heart of Berlin.

Your Game

As a Senior Server Developer, you will help design, develop, and maintain the systems that keep Albion Online world running smoothly. You’ll work on backend features and services that support millions of players, ensuring stability, scalability and performance across a continuously evolving live environment.

This role requires deep technical expertise, a proactive mindset and a passion for large-scale online systems. You’ll collaborate closely with game developers and designers to deliver reliable tools, features and infrastructure that enhance the gameplay experience and support ongoing content updates.

Architect and maintain high-throughput backend systems that power Albion Online’s large-scale, persistent world
Develop and optimize server-side gameplay features, live tools and real-time networking systems using C#
Work with our Release Operations team to ensure smooth deployment of patches and content updates
Ensure system reliability, performance and scalability across global regions and large player populations
Implement monitoring and observability tools to improve issue detection and system resilience
Collaborate with client engineers and game designers to integrate gameplay logic and backend functionality
Participate in architectural discussions and technical planning for feature growth and long-term system health
Support and mentor other engineers, fostering a culture of technical pragmatism and performance

Your Talent

Minimum Qualifications:

5+ years of experience in backend or network programming for online or multiplayer games.
Strong proficiency in C# and experience with the Unity engine
Proven experience with client-server architecture, game server logic and live game maintenance
Solid understanding of database systems (SQL/NoSQL), cloud environments and distributed server infrastructure
Experience with performance optimization, debugging, and profiling in large-scale systems
Excellent communication skills (presentation, verbal and written) in English

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience working on MMORPGs or sandbox games
Familiarity with Albion Online or similar persistent-world systems
Understanding of live operations workflows, including event management, hotfixing and content rollout
Knowledge of DevOps practices, monitoring tools and CI/CD pipelines
Passion for games and player-driven online experiences

Our Offer

BVG corporate ticket:
Receive a free company ticket for Germany's public transportation system

Personal Development:
Have a high degree of autonomy and ownership from the start
Develop your skills through company-sponsored training and language courses
Enjoy company-sponsored tickets for Gamescom Dev & other game conferences

Hybrid Work model:
Combine the best of both worlds, and enjoy the freedom to switch between working in the office and working remotely

Health & Wellbeing:
Discounted membership to Urban Sport Club for fitness and wellness
Access to nilo health for confidential mental health support, coaching, and wellbeing resources
Extra vacation days awarded based on years of service, up to a maximum of 30 days annually

Modern & Well-Equipped Office:
Work in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, a central, vibrant neighborhood in Berlin with many dining and entertainment options
Enjoy height-adjustable tables, ergonomic chair options, dimmable lighting, and acoustic panels

Start-up perks:
Benefit from free drinks and snacks in the office
Participate in team events, breakfast weeks, summer and winter parties

Sustainable business:
Be part of a successful, profitable company on a continued growth path

Gaming-driven culture:
Work alongside a supportive team of gaming enthusiasts who are deeply committed to their craft

Global reach:
Join a team of industry experts shaping a game enjoyed by hundreds of thousands worldwide

jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Architectural Leadership: Du entwirfst zukunftssichere Softwarearchitekturen im .NET-Umfeld und trägst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung in komplexen Projekten.
Klassische & moderne Welten: Du bewegst dich sicher sowohl in klassischen Enterprise-Architekturen (z. B. Monolithen, Client-Server-Systeme, On-Prem) als auch in modernen cloud-nativen Szenarien (Microservices, Container, Event-Driven).
Tech Strategy & Guidance: Du definierst Architektur- und Technologie-Standards (Cloud-native, API-First, Security by Design, Domain-Driven Design) und unterstützt Teams bei der Umsetzung.
Consulting & Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams zusammen – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Architektur bis zur produktiven Einführung.
Innovation Driver: Du bringst Trends wie AI-Integration, Serverless, Observability, Zero-Trust-Security und DevSecOps aktiv in die Projekte ein.

DEIN PROFIL

Background: Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Architektur-Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Design und in der Dokumentation komplexer Software-Architekturen, sowohl im klassischen On-Prem-Umfeld als auch in der Cloud.
Engineering Skills: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in moderner Softwareentwicklung mit .NET Core, C#, Cloud-Services (Azure/AWS/GCP), Container-Orchestrierung (Kubernetes) und IaC (Terraform, Bicep) sowie Erfahrung mit der Modernisierung bestehender Systeme zu Microservices, Cloud & SaaS.
Strategie & Delivery: Know-how in Anforderungsanalyse, Betriebskonzepten, Security-Architekturen und in der Transformation von Legacy-Systemen zu skalierbaren Plattformen.
Kommunikation & Leadership: Du bist sicher in der Moderation von Architektur-Workshops, agierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Business und Tech und coachst Entwicklerteams.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso.
Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Bielefeld

Werde Teil des DFT-Teams!

DFT ist ein Bielefelder Unternehmen mit ca. 550+ Mitarbeitern, gegründet 1954. Der Maschinenbauer gehört seit 2010 zur österreichischen KNAPP AG mit Sitz in Graz, Steiermark. DFT entwickelt, produziert und liefert Sortier- und Sequenzieranlagen zur effizienten Bearbeitung von eCommerce-Aufträgen und zur Filialversorgung. Die Spezialität von DFT ist Hängefördertechnik in verschiedenen Ausprägungen für die Bekleidungsindustrie, den Elektronik(groß)handel, Arzneimittelgroßhandel, die Automobil-Produktionslogistik und allgemein für den eCommerce-Handel. Seit 2021 konnten wegweisende Vertriebserfolge in den USA in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Mutterkonzern KNAPP erreicht werden.

Deine Aufgaben

Du möchtest Teil eines innovativen Projektteams sein und die Zukunft der Intralogistik aktiv mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Als Mitglied unseres Project Engineer Software Teams entwickelst du Lösungen für namhafte nationale und internationale Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass komplexe Materialflüsse in automatisierten Lagern reibungslos funktionieren. In deiner Rolle als (Junior) Project Engineer Software C++ / C# (m/w/d) arbeitest du an unserem Standort in Bielefeld oder Gronau
und passt unsere Warehouse-Control-Systeme (WCS) an individuelle Kundenanforderungen an. So trägst du maßgeblich dazu bei, den Warenfluss in hochautomatisierten Logistikzentren effizient und zuverlässig zu steuern. Deine Aufgaben im Projektverlauf

We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come.

Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

Senior Unity Developer - Core Game Tech (f/m/d)

We are looking for a Senior Unity Developer to join our Core Game Tech (CGT) Team — the small, senior team behind the technology that every Kolibri game runs on.

Our work spans consulting game teams on technical decisions, investigating problems where nobody has defined the requirements yet, and building the systems and integrations that the games depend on. That ranges from compliance features and third-party SDKs to shared systems, standardization and keeping our engine and tooling current.

You'll work in a small specialized team alongside technical decision makers to have strong impact on all the games across our portfolio.

If you like being the person who takes on the technical problems other teams can't, and you don't shy away from constantly diving into new unknowns, learning new skills and driving topics forward, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Design and build the shared systems multiple live games with dynamic events and scheduled content for millions of users run on
Drive third-party integrations and keep the portfolio current: evaluate and integrate SDKs, drive SDK and Unity version upgrades, and understand the impact across every game before it lands
Advise game teams as their technical counterpart, driving standardization and winning adoption of shared solutions on the strength of the work and the argument
Deliver compliance and privacy features across the portfolio, such as age assurance APIs, CMP implementations and GDPR data deletion flows
Investigate open-ended technical problems and turn regulations, vendor changes and internal needs into concrete technical requirements

Required Skills

(Ideally 5+ years of professional) Software development experience in C# and Unity3D. Experience in non-gaming contexts is also relevant; we value your expertise, so do not hesitate to apply
You have a wide understanding of how Unity works, you are familiar with native implementations, understand backend interactions, and performance investigations are your bread and butter. The most important skill is to be able to jump into the unknown and get familiar
Strong written and spoken communication, and the credibility to make teams you don't sit with want to adopt your solutions
Experience building libraries, packages, APIs or tooling that other developers consume, and an instinct for what makes them adoptable
Ability to plan, communicate, and execute technical solutions in a way that is both understandable for other developers as well as non technical stakeholders
Ability to derive requirements yourself from ambiguous or external sources — regulation, platform policy, vendor documentation — rather than working from a written spec
A genuine appetite for constantly learning new areas of the stack

Desirable Skills

jobs.title: Application Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Für unser Büro im Herzen Frankfurts suchen wir Talente, die etwas bewegen wollen – mit Begeisterung, frischen Ideen und dem Wunsch, sich weiterzuentwickeln. Du schätzt ein offenes Miteinander und möchtest die Versicherungswelt aktiv mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

AUFGABEN

Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung bestehender Anwendungen und Automatisierungslösungen zur Unterstützung interner Geschäftsprozesse
Konzeption, Implementierung und Dokumentation von Integrationen und Schnittstellen zwischen internen und externen Systemen
Umsetzung von Änderungen und neuen Funktionalitäten im Rahmen strukturierter Entwicklungs- und Release-Prozesse
Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen
Durchführung von Softwaretests und Qualitätssicherungsmaßnahmen
Verantwortung für Deployment und Bereitstellung entwickelter Anwendungen und Automatisierungslösungen
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachabteilungen sowie externen Partnern
Anbindung und Integration von SaaS-Lösungen sowie externen APIs

PROFIL

Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Fachinformatik / Anwendungsentwicklung, Studium mit IT-Bezug oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
Mindestens 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Anwendungsentwicklung, Prozessautomatisierung oder Systemintegration
Praktische Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Automatisierungs- und Integrationslösungen
Sehr gute SQL-Kenntnisse und sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken
Erfahrung mit APIs, Schnittstellen und der Integration externer SaaS-Lösungen
Programmierkenntnisse in mindestens einer objektorientierten bzw. für Automatisierung geeigneten Programmiersprache, z. B. Python, Java oder C#
Erfahrung mit Git als Teil eines strukturierten Entwicklungs- oder DevOps-Workflows, insbesondere für die Versionierung von Automatisierungs- und Integrationslogiken
Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für effiziente Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge
Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachabteilungen
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

Wünschenswert:

Erfahrung mit Dokumentenmanagementsystemen (DMS)
Kenntnisse im Bereich OCR bzw. automatisierter Dokumentenverarbeitung

Warum wir?

Wir bieten ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld in der Frankfurter Innenstadt in unmittelbarer Nähe zur Alten Oper sowie eine familiäre Atmosphäre. Unsere Teams zeichnen sich durch Innovation, Motivation, Professionalität und Spaß an der Arbeit aus. Die Teilnahme am JP-Morgan-Lauf, gemeinsame Feste und Stadionbesuche sowie die Teilnahme an kulturellen Ereignissen sind ebenso üblich wie regelmäßige Mitarbeiterversammlungen und Betriebsfeiern. Flache Hierarchien ermöglichen einen unkomplizierten Umgang miteinander und schaffen Raum, um eigene Ideen einzubringen.

jobs.title: Platform & Data Engineering Director
jobs.description:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

Role

As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will lead the design, build, and evolution of Visium's client-facing AI and Data platform capabilities. You are the technical authority and delivery lead for our most complex data & platform programs, the person who ensures that what we build is not only technically excellent but also adoptable, scalable, and genuinely transformative.

You will directly manage forward-deployed platform engineering teams, drive data & platform strategy across engagements, and act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders. You bring hands-on depth in the modern data and AI platform stack, from infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD to cloud architecture and building data products, combined with the leadership presence and commercial instinct to grow accounts and inspire teams.

As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will work on

Architect and lead the delivery of complex AI and Data platform programs, spanning cloud infrastructure design, automation, CI/CD pipelines, data product design and data engineering, from initial scoping through to production deployment. Our focus is on Azure and AWS
Define and drive platform engineering standards and best practices across engagements, ensuring repeatability, reliability, and long-term client value
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including C-Level and VP Engineering personas, acting as a hands-on technical advisor who earns trust through delivery
Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers and engagement managers, cultivating a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and ownership
Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, partnering with the commercial team to expand Visium's platform footprint
Champion an inspiring, outward-facing engineering culture, one that attracts strong talent and energises clients with a clear and compelling vision for what great platform and data engineering looks like

Requirements

To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of expertise, experience, and skills including:

Proven, hands-on experience leading large-scale platform engineering programs in AI and Data, you have built, shipped and operated production-grade platforms and data products, not just designed them
Mastered the consulting business - you know exactly how the business works and have a proven track record in delivering successful large projects
Deep technical expertise across the modern platform stack: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, cloud platform design (focus Azure,), data engineering and automation at scale
Demonstrated experience delivering AI and Data use cases end-to-end on enterprise platforms
Proven people leadership: you have hired, grown, and retained high-performing platform engineering teams in fast-paced consulting or product environments
Commercial acumen and a track record of contributing to account growth, whether through identifying upsell opportunities, leading presales technical conversations, or building long-term client partnerships
Outstanding communication and presence: you can translate complex platform concepts into compelling narratives for both technical and executive audiences, and you do so with energy and conviction
An inspiring, outgoing personality: you lead from the front, bring others with you, and make the work feel meaningful
Fluent in English; French and/or German are a plus

Benefits

What we offer

A competitive compensation package
A yearly education budget to steep your learning curve
A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind
A flexible working culture because your work-life balance matters to us
A position that enables you to have an impact on 1'000s of people, and the whole company's growth
An international, knowledgeable, and passionate team with a strong collaborative mindset

Check our LinkedIn and website to learn more about us & don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions.

jobs.title: Software-Architect .NET (all genders)
jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Architectural Leadership: Du entwirfst zukunftssichere Softwarearchitekturen im .NET-Umfeld und trägst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung in komplexen Projekten.
Klassische & moderne Welten: Du bewegst dich sicher sowohl in klassischen Enterprise-Architekturen (z. B. Monolithen, Client-Server-Systeme, On-Prem) als auch in modernen cloud-nativen Szenarien (Microservices, Container, Event-Driven).
Tech Strategy & Guidance: Du definierst Architektur- und Technologie-Standards (Cloud-native, API-First, Security by Design, Domain-Driven Design) und unterstützt Teams bei der Umsetzung.
Consulting & Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams zusammen – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Architektur bis zur produktiven Einführung.
Innovation Driver: Du bringst Trends wie AI-Integration, Serverless, Observability, Zero-Trust-Security und DevSecOps aktiv in die Projekte ein.

DEIN PROFIL

Background: Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Architektur-Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Design und in der Dokumentation komplexer Software-Architekturen, sowohl im klassischen On-Prem-Umfeld als auch in der Cloud.
Engineering Skills: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in moderner Softwareentwicklung mit .NET Core, C#, Cloud-Services (Azure/AWS/GCP), Container-Orchestrierung (Kubernetes) und IaC (Terraform, Bicep) sowie Erfahrung mit der Modernisierung bestehender Systeme zu Microservices, Cloud & SaaS.
Strategie & Delivery: Know-how in Anforderungsanalyse, Betriebskonzepten, Security-Architekturen und in der Transformation von Legacy-Systemen zu skalierbaren Plattformen.
Kommunikation & Leadership: Du bist sicher in der Moderation von Architektur-Workshops, agierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Business und Tech und coachst Entwicklerteams.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso.
Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Mit diesen Systemen werden die Verkaufs- und Marktbearbeitungsprozesse im Handel durchgeführt werden. Die Systeme haben Anbindungen an alle relevanten Konzernsysteme sowie Schnittstellen zu vielen im Handel relevanten Fahrzeugsystemen.

Als TAM stellst du die Stabilität, Sicherheit und Compliance der Anwendung sicher und steuerst Kosten sowie Budget der Anwendung
Du steuerst den externen Dienstleister, der die Anwendungen operativ entwickelt und supported
Du entwickelst auch zusammen mit dem Dienstleister strategisch die Anwendungen hinsichtlich nachhaltiger technischer Stabilität, Sicherheit, Compliance und Architektur weiter
Du löst Störungen der Anwendungen nachhaltig in Zusammenarbeit mit den notwendigen Bereichen und dem externen Dienstleister. Dabei stellst Du sicher, dass dies auch die für die Anwendungen notwendigen, nachgelagerten Services tun.
Du vertrittst die technische Sicht der Anwendungen bei Projekten, gegenüber des Managements und bei steuernden Funktionen
Du treibst und begleitest die Etablierung der agilen Softwareentwicklung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Business Cluster (ART AVK) und den Prozesspartnern nach Scrum und SAFe.

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Fach- oder Hochschulstudium im Bereich Informatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Du überzeugst mit sicherem Auftreten sowie der Fähigkeit technische Sachverhalte adressatengerecht darzustellen

Agile Vorgehensmodelle wie Scrum oder SAFe sind dir nicht fremd
Du punktest mit analytischen Fähigkeiten sowie deinem technischen und organisatorischen Wissen bei der Entwicklung von webbasierten mehrschichtigen Anwendungen auf Basis von Microsoft Azure und .NET.

Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Entwirf intelligente Agentic-AI-Lösungen für Kundenprozesse: Du konzipierst und realisierst Azure-native agentische Lösungen zur Automatisierung, Unterstützung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen auf Basis von Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Agent Service, Semantic Kernel und weiteren Azure-KI-Services – von der ersten Idee bis zum stabilen Betrieb in der Produktion.
Agenten- und Prozessarchitekturen: Du entwirfst agentenbasierte Architekturen inklusive Tool-Integration, Memory-Persistenz, Multi-Agent-Orchestrierung, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Guardrails und Evaluationsmechanismen. Dabei integrierst du KI-Agenten als digitale Prozessassistenten, Entscheidungsunterstützer oder autonome Teilprozess-Akteure in bestehende Kundenprozesse.
Gestalte Prozessflows & Systemintegrationen: Du gestaltest intelligente Prozessabläufe, Agenten-Workflows und Toolchains, bindest Wissensquellen, RAG-Pipelines, Fachanwendungen und Analytik-Komponenten ein und integrierst externe Systeme über Azure-Services wie Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Azure Storage, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure AI Search oder API Management.
DevOps & Delivery für KI-Agenten: Du verankerst CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, automatisiertes Testing sowie Logging und Tracing, z. B. Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics und OpenTelemetry, in deinen Architekturen und sorgst für sichere, reproduzierbare Deployments agentischer Anwendungen in produktionsnahen und produktiven Kundenumgebungen.
Übernimm End-to-End-Projektverantwortung: Du begleitest Kunden über den gesamten Lifecycle – von Prozessanalysen, Potenzialbewertungen, Assessments und Zielbild-Workshops über Architektur- und Designphasen bis zur Implementierung – und übernimmst Verantwortung für Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit der entwickelten agentischen Prozesslösungen.
Begleite Kunden umfassend: Du übersetzt Konzepte wie Tool-Use, RAG-Pipelines, Session-Memory, Multi-Agent-Delegation, Grounding, Guardrails und Evaluation in verständliche Entscheidungsgrundlagen, erstellst Architektur-Roadmaps und unterstützt Teams durch Reviews, Coaching und Wissenstransfer. Dabei berätst du Kunden insbesondere dazu, welche Prozesse sich für agentische Automatisierung eignen, wie Agenten sicher in bestehende Arbeitsabläufe eingebettet werden und wie Fachbereiche, IT und Betrieb gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen entwickeln.

DEIN PROFIL

Azure-Expertise und Architekturverständnis: Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, kennst die Eigenheiten und Limits zentraler Services, z. B. Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, Entra ID, Key Vault und Virtual Network, und entwickelst skalierbare, sichere Cloud-Architekturen für produktionsreife KI-, Agenten- und Prozessautomatisierungslösungen.
Azure AI, OpenAI & LLM-Agenten: Du hast mit Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service oder Azure AI Agent Service gearbeitet und weißt, was produktionsreifer Betrieb von LLM- und Agentenlösungen bedeutet. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit Tool-Calling, Function Calling, Agents, Knowledge Sources, Vector Search, Guardrails, Prompt-Evaluation und Content Safety mit. Kenntnisse in Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen oder CrewAI sind ein Plus. Du verstehst, wie agentische Systeme Tools nutzen, Kontext verwalten, Aufgaben delegieren und sicher in bestehende Prozess- und Systemlandschaften eingebettet werden.
Prozessverständnis und agentische Automatisierung: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Analyse, Modellierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen mit und verstehst, wie agentische Tools Prozesse unterstützen, automatisieren oder teilweise autonom ausführen können. Du erkennst geeignete Anwendungsfälle für Agentic AI, bewertest Nutzen, Machbarkeit und Risiken und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare technische Lösungsansätze.
DevOps-, IaC- und Container-Skills: Du verfügst über Projekterfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, CI/CD-Pipelines, z. B. Azure DevOps oder GitHub Actions, und Container-Plattformen wie AKS oder Azure Container Apps. Du verankerst Testing, Observability und Security-Guardrails in deinen Delivery-Prozessen. Kenntnisse zu Compliance, z. B. DSGVO, BSI, ISO 27001, sowie Microsoft-Azure-Zertifizierungen sind wünschenswert. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung darin, KI- und Agentenlösungen reproduzierbar, überwacht und sicher in produktive Kundenumgebungen zu überführen.
Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte adressatengerecht erklären und überzeugst in Workshops, Reviews und Management-Präsentationen. Du berätst Kunden souverän bei der Identifikation geeigneter Prozesse, der Bewertung von Automatisierungspotenzialen sowie der Einführung agentischer Lösungen an der Schnittstelle von Fachbereich, IT und Betrieb.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso. Dabei bringst du ein gutes Verständnis für Responsible AI, Guardrails, Evaluation, Monitoring, Prompt- und Tool-Design, RAG-Architekturen sowie den sicheren Umgang mit Unternehmensdaten mit.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Agenten- und Prozessarchitekturen: Du entwirfst agentenbasierte Architekturen inklusive Tool-Integration, Memory-Persistenz, Multi-Agent-Orchestrierung, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Guardrails und Evaluationsmechanismen. Dabei integrierst du KI-Agenten als digitale Prozessassistenten, Entscheidungsunterstützer oder autonome Teilprozess-Akteure in bestehende Kundenprozesse.
Gestalte Prozessflows & Systemintegrationen: Du gestaltest intelligente Prozessabläufe, Agenten-Workflows und Toolchains, bindest Wissensquellen, RAG-Pipelines, Fachanwendungen und Analytik-Komponenten ein und integrierst externe Systeme über Azure-Services wie Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Azure Storage, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure AI Search oder API Management.
DevOps & Delivery für KI-Agenten: Du verankerst CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, automatisiertes Testing sowie Logging und Tracing, z. B. Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics und OpenTelemetry, in deinen Architekturen und sorgst für sichere, reproduzierbare Deployments agentischer Anwendungen in produktionsnahen und produktiven Kundenumgebungen.
Übernimm End-to-End-Projektverantwortung: Du begleitest Kunden über den gesamten Lifecycle – von Prozessanalysen, Potenzialbewertungen, Assessments und Zielbild-Workshops über Architektur- und Designphasen bis zur Implementierung – und übernimmst Verantwortung für Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit der entwickelten agentischen Prozesslösungen.
Begleite Kunden umfassend: Du übersetzt Konzepte wie Tool-Use, RAG-Pipelines, Session-Memory, Multi-Agent-Delegation, Grounding, Guardrails und Evaluation in verständliche Entscheidungsgrundlagen, erstellst Architektur-Roadmaps und unterstützt Teams durch Reviews, Coaching und Wissenstransfer. Dabei berätst du Kunden insbesondere dazu, welche Prozesse sich für agentische Automatisierung eignen, wie Agenten sicher in bestehende Arbeitsabläufe eingebettet werden und wie Fachbereiche, IT und Betrieb gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen entwickeln.

DEIN PROFIL

Azure-Expertise und Architekturverständnis: Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, kennst die Eigenheiten und Limits zentraler Services, z. B. Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, Entra ID, Key Vault und Virtual Network, und entwickelst skalierbare, sichere Cloud-Architekturen für produktionsreife KI-, Agenten- und Prozessautomatisierungslösungen.
Azure AI, OpenAI & LLM-Agenten: Du hast mit Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service oder Azure AI Agent Service gearbeitet und weißt, was produktionsreifer Betrieb von LLM- und Agentenlösungen bedeutet. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit Tool-Calling, Function Calling, Agents, Knowledge Sources, Vector Search, Guardrails, Prompt-Evaluation und Content Safety mit. Kenntnisse in Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen oder CrewAI sind ein Plus. Du verstehst, wie agentische Systeme Tools nutzen, Kontext verwalten, Aufgaben delegieren und sicher in bestehende Prozess- und Systemlandschaften eingebettet werden.
Prozessverständnis und agentische Automatisierung: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Analyse, Modellierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen mit und verstehst, wie agentische Tools Prozesse unterstützen, automatisieren oder teilweise autonom ausführen können. Du erkennst geeignete Anwendungsfälle für Agentic AI, bewertest Nutzen, Machbarkeit und Risiken und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare technische Lösungsansätze.
DevOps-, IaC- und Container-Skills: Du verfügst über Projekterfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, CI/CD-Pipelines, z. B. Azure DevOps oder GitHub Actions, und Container-Plattformen wie AKS oder Azure Container Apps. Du verankerst Testing, Observability und Security-Guardrails in deinen Delivery-Prozessen. Kenntnisse zu Compliance, z. B. DSGVO, BSI, ISO 27001, sowie Microsoft-Azure-Zertifizierungen sind wünschenswert. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung darin, KI- und Agentenlösungen reproduzierbar, überwacht und sicher in produktive Kundenumgebungen zu überführen.
Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte adressatengerecht erklären und überzeugst in Workshops, Reviews und Management-Präsentationen. Du berätst Kunden souverän bei der Identifikation geeigneter Prozesse, der Bewertung von Automatisierungspotenzialen sowie der Einführung agentischer Lösungen an der Schnittstelle von Fachbereich, IT und Betrieb.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso. Dabei bringst du ein gutes Verständnis für Responsible AI, Guardrails, Evaluation, Monitoring, Prompt- und Tool-Design, RAG-Architekturen sowie den sicheren Umgang mit Unternehmensdaten mit.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Agenten- und Prozessarchitekturen: Du entwirfst agentenbasierte Architekturen inklusive Tool-Integration, Memory-Persistenz, Multi-Agent-Orchestrierung, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Guardrails und Evaluationsmechanismen. Dabei integrierst du KI-Agenten als digitale Prozessassistenten, Entscheidungsunterstützer oder autonome Teilprozess-Akteure in bestehende Kundenprozesse.
Gestalte Prozessflows & Systemintegrationen: Du gestaltest intelligente Prozessabläufe, Agenten-Workflows und Toolchains, bindest Wissensquellen, RAG-Pipelines, Fachanwendungen und Analytik-Komponenten ein und integrierst externe Systeme über Azure-Services wie Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Azure Storage, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure AI Search oder API Management.
DevOps & Delivery für KI-Agenten: Du verankerst CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, automatisiertes Testing sowie Logging und Tracing, z. B. Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics und OpenTelemetry, in deinen Architekturen und sorgst für sichere, reproduzierbare Deployments agentischer Anwendungen in produktionsnahen und produktiven Kundenumgebungen.
Übernimm End-to-End-Projektverantwortung: Du begleitest Kunden über den gesamten Lifecycle – von Prozessanalysen, Potenzialbewertungen, Assessments und Zielbild-Workshops über Architektur- und Designphasen bis zur Implementierung – und übernimmst Verantwortung für Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit der entwickelten agentischen Prozesslösungen.
Begleite Kunden umfassend: Du übersetzt Konzepte wie Tool-Use, RAG-Pipelines, Session-Memory, Multi-Agent-Delegation, Grounding, Guardrails und Evaluation in verständliche Entscheidungsgrundlagen, erstellst Architektur-Roadmaps und unterstützt Teams durch Reviews, Coaching und Wissenstransfer. Dabei berätst du Kunden insbesondere dazu, welche Prozesse sich für agentische Automatisierung eignen, wie Agenten sicher in bestehende Arbeitsabläufe eingebettet werden und wie Fachbereiche, IT und Betrieb gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen entwickeln.

DEIN PROFIL

Azure-Expertise und Architekturverständnis: Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, kennst die Eigenheiten und Limits zentraler Services, z. B. Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, Entra ID, Key Vault und Virtual Network, und entwickelst skalierbare, sichere Cloud-Architekturen für produktionsreife KI-, Agenten- und Prozessautomatisierungslösungen.
Azure AI, OpenAI & LLM-Agenten: Du hast mit Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service oder Azure AI Agent Service gearbeitet und weißt, was produktionsreifer Betrieb von LLM- und Agentenlösungen bedeutet. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit Tool-Calling, Function Calling, Agents, Knowledge Sources, Vector Search, Guardrails, Prompt-Evaluation und Content Safety mit. Kenntnisse in Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen oder CrewAI sind ein Plus. Du verstehst, wie agentische Systeme Tools nutzen, Kontext verwalten, Aufgaben delegieren und sicher in bestehende Prozess- und Systemlandschaften eingebettet werden.
Prozessverständnis und agentische Automatisierung: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Analyse, Modellierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen mit und verstehst, wie agentische Tools Prozesse unterstützen, automatisieren oder teilweise autonom ausführen können. Du erkennst geeignete Anwendungsfälle für Agentic AI, bewertest Nutzen, Machbarkeit und Risiken und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare technische Lösungsansätze.
DevOps-, IaC- und Container-Skills: Du verfügst über Projekterfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, CI/CD-Pipelines, z. B. Azure DevOps oder GitHub Actions, und Container-Plattformen wie AKS oder Azure Container Apps. Du verankerst Testing, Observability und Security-Guardrails in deinen Delivery-Prozessen. Kenntnisse zu Compliance, z. B. DSGVO, BSI, ISO 27001, sowie Microsoft-Azure-Zertifizierungen sind wünschenswert. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung darin, KI- und Agentenlösungen reproduzierbar, überwacht und sicher in produktive Kundenumgebungen zu überführen.
Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte adressatengerecht erklären und überzeugst in Workshops, Reviews und Management-Präsentationen. Du berätst Kunden souverän bei der Identifikation geeigneter Prozesse, der Bewertung von Automatisierungspotenzialen sowie der Einführung agentischer Lösungen an der Schnittstelle von Fachbereich, IT und Betrieb.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso. Dabei bringst du ein gutes Verständnis für Responsible AI, Guardrails, Evaluation, Monitoring, Prompt- und Tool-Design, RAG-Architekturen sowie den sicheren Umgang mit Unternehmensdaten mit.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer - C#/.NET - Solihull, Hybrid or remote
jobs.description:
Hybrid Working:
We take a flexible approach to hybrid/ remote working, recognising that office attendance may vary depending on your location, role and team needs. Don’t let office attendance put you off applying. The expected working pattern will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Pinewood.AI is looking for experienced hands-on Senior Developers to play a key role in our software development teams. Working closely with Lead Developers, Engineering colleagues, Product, testers, and other colleagues across the wider business, you will support the delivery and ongoing development of our Automotive Intelligence Platform.

As a senior member of the team, you will contribute to the design, development, and delivery of high-quality, scalable solutions for the Pinewood Automotive Intelligence Platform, our enterprise-scale SaaS product used by automotive retailers and OEMs worldwide.

This role is ideal for a strong, hands-on developer who enjoys building new product features, developing integrations with third-party systems, and working across the full software development lifecycle while supporting high engineering standards within a collaborative team environment.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and enhance enterprise-level software solutions using C#, .NET / .NET Core, Razor, Web API, SQL Server, HTML, and JavaScript.
Work closely with Product Owners, testers, UI/UX specialists, and Engineering colleagues to deliver new functionality, improvements, and integrations with third-party systems.
Remain hands-on in coding, solution design, and development across the full .NET stack.
Develop and maintain integrations with third-party platforms using APIs and other integration methods.
Support best practices across development, testing, and deployment to ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, development tooling, and engineering practices alongside the wider Engineering team.
Participate in technical discussions and contribute ideas that support product improvement and delivery effectiveness.
Diagnose complex technical issues, including integration challenges, data consistency issues, and performance improvements.
Support knowledge sharing and code quality through peer reviews and collaboration.
Contribute to a collaborative engineering culture focused on clean, efficient code and practical delivery.

Requirements

Proven experience as a Senior Developer within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
Strong hands-on expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, and SQL / T-SQL.
Solid understanding of database design, performance optimisation, and query tuning.
Experience delivering front-end functionality using HTML, JavaScript, and Razor.
Experience building and supporting integrations with third-party systems using REST APIs or similar technologies.
Practical experience working with Azure Cloud Services and Azure DevOps, or equivalent CI/CD tooling.
Proficiency with Visual Studio or VS Code.
Strong understanding of software development practices and agile delivery methods.
Experience working across the full software development lifecycle, from concept through to production support.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a passion for clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
Experience in enterprise SaaS industries, or with complex, high-availability platforms, would be beneficial.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to join a well-established engineering team working on a global SaaS platform used by automotive retailers and OEMs around the world.

You will be hands-on in the development of new product features, integrations, improvements, and bespoke customer solutions, with the chance to work within a complex enterprise environment.

Working closely with Product, UI/UX, testing colleagues, and the wider business, you will help deliver practical, high-quality solutions that make a real difference to our customers.

Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience
Bonus scheme
Share scheme
Hybrid working (flexibility depending on your base location).
25 days holiday plus all UK bank holidays
4x life assurance
Enhanced family-friendly leave, supporting employees with 5 months’ full pay for maternity or adoption leave, 2 weeks’ fully paid paternity or adoption leave, plus an additional 2 weeks of paid annual leave to use within 24 months of the birth or adoption.
Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - free, confidential 24/7 support for you and your immediate family (including counselling, legal & financial advice, and wellbeing resources)
Ongoing training & professional development
Cycle to Work scheme - save up to 40% on bikes and accessories through salary sacrifice
Eyecare vouchers - free eye test and contribution towards prescription glasses
Regular social events
Employee recognition and awards
Exclusive Gym (Virgin Active) membership scheme

About Us

Our story began more than 20 years ago, but right from the start, it has been rooted in the specific needs of the automotive industry. As automotive professionals as well as technologists, we wanted to build practical technology solutions that were designed around how automotive businesses work, recognising what makes them different. Pinewood.AI is an unparalleled Automotive Intelligence Platform that enables automotive retail customers and OEMs to drive growth and profitability throughout every aspect of their business.

Pinewood’s cloud-based secure end-to-end ecosystem unlocks the value of every customer. Our vision is to be the full-service technology partner that helps automotive retailers and OEMs run more efficiently and increase revenue by making better commercial and business decisions more easily.

jobs.description:
.NET Developer - Global Phenomenon – London

(Tech stack: .NET Developer, .NET 10.0, ASP.NET Core, C# 14, .NET Aspire, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, EF Core 10.0, Agile, HTML Living Standard, CSS Living Standard, Programmer, Full Stack Engineer, Architect, .NET Developer)

Our client has created a global phenomenon, connecting people online to unique travel experiences, in more than 60,000 cities and 180 countries. As they approach their 10th anniversary they are looking to produce a revolutionary set of products and services that will transform the travel industry beyond recognition.

For our client, engineering is not just a job but a practice that they want to perfect. Are you the kind of developer who sees something that's not quite right and just…owns it, rather than waiting to be told to fix it?

We're working with an established public sector-facing transport technology business, fully remote, with a small, close-knit engineering team building consumer-facing apps (built on .NET MAUI, so a single C#/.NET codebase across platforms) backed by a .NET Core API. The business is growing - new regional contracts are coming online that will substantially increase revenue over the next few years - but it's stayed a genuinely low-pressure, low-turnover place to work. People who join tend to still be there years later.

What you'll be doing:

Taking real ownership of features across the app and API - not just building to spec, but deciding what "right" looks like and pushing back when something isn't
Picking up pieces of work and seeing them through to completion without needing to be pointed in the right direction at every step
Stepping back from the code to look at the holistic picture - is this UI pattern actually good, is this the right way to solve the problem, not just "does it technically work"
Working alongside 4-5 other developers of mixed experience, helping steer decisions rather than just adding to the pile of individually-reasonable-but-inconsistent choices
Working across a MAUI-based app and its .NET Core / C# API - genuine full-stack ownership within the .NET ecosystem

What they're looking for:

Strong, proven C#/.NET development experience - this is the core skill the role is built around, not a secondary strength
A genuine ownership mentality - comfortable making the call and living with it, rather than waiting to be told
Enough experience to see the bigger picture across a codebase or feature, not just execute the ticket in front of you
Someone who's past chasing the next big salary bump or the next big title - this is a steady, long-term role for someone who knows what matters to them (good work-life balance, 100% remote, flexibility, no overtime or weekend work)

Advantageous, not essential:

Experience with .NET MAUI, Xamarin, or another cross-platform C#/.NET mobile framework
Comfortable with SQL Server (though there's already dedicated support for this, so it's not a core requirement)
Experience working in a small team where you're one of a handful of developers, not one of fifty

The kind of person who'll do well here:

You'd rather have a stable, sustainable working life than chase pace or cutting-edge tech for its own sake - this team finishes at 5.00pm, and means it
You're happy being trusted to own things without needing a bigger title to justify it
You care enough about the detail - a clunky bit of UI, a pattern being copied without being questioned - to fix it even when nobody's asked
You want to still be here in years, not months - this business is known for keeping people, and they're looking for someone who wants that too

Why this is worth a look:

This is a genuinely stable, well-funded business - revenue is set to rise significantly over the next few years as new contracts land - that has never had a problem keeping hold of good people. It's fully remote, properly low-pressure, and offers the kind of ownership that's usually reserved for a "lead" title, without the politics that title normally comes with.

who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, building scalable systems, and helping engineering teams deliver high-quality software in production environments.

Develop cloud-native applications across AWS, Azure, or GCP
Provide technical leadership on complex projects and programmes of work

Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and improve engineering workflows
Leverage AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows to improve productivity and software quality
Identify opportunities to automate engineering tasks through intelligent tooling and AI
Mentor engineers and support technical growth across teams
Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver production-ready software
Help establish and promote engineering standards, best practices, and ways of working

Required

Extensive experience building production systems using Java, Python, C#/.NET or TypeScript
Significant experience working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, Azure or GCP also considered)
Strong understanding of system design, distributed systems, and scalable architectures
Experience building and consuming APIs (REST and event-based systems)
Experience making architectural decisions and providing technical guidance on complex projects
Comfortable working across the full software delivery lifecycle (build, deploy, operate)
Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals and best practices
Ability to take ownership and drive technical solutions from concept through to delivery
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
Experience mentoring engineers and supporting team development
Interest in modern AI-enabled engineering practices and continuous improvement

Experience with React, Angular, or Vue
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation
Exposure to containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes

Experience with serverless architectures
Experience integrating AI services, LLMs, or agent-based systems into software products
Experience working across multiple teams, projects, or customer engagements
Interest in improving engineering standards, tooling, and ways of working through automation and AI-assisted development

We offer flexible hybrid working, but candidates should be based in Northern Ireland and able to attend our Belfast office when required.

For more than 25 years, TRG Screen has enabled businesses who rely on market data to monitor and strategically manage spending and usage of data and information services, including market data, research, software licenses, consulting and other necessary corporate expenses. TRG Screen solutions give decisionmakers full transparency into subscription spend and usage, enabling them to proactively manage subscription costs at scale, conduct more informed vendor negotiations, improve governance, and avoid unnecessary spending on these mission-critical business services. TRG Screen is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Europe and Asia, as well as a 24x7 client support center in Bangalore, India.

TRG Screen is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s largest and most respected private equity firms.

The Role

Location: Belfast, Northern Ireland

Reporting to the Director of Software Engineering, the Manager of Software Engineering will lead globally distributed engineering teams at TRG Screen, building a high-performance culture of operational excellence while scaling engineering operations to meet evolving business goals.

This role is responsible for translating engineering strategy into execution—optimizing development processes, providing technical leadership to guide platform modernization, and delivering secure, reliable, scalable solutions. The Manager will own team-level KPI tracking, champion AI-powered code-generation tools to elevate productivity and fuel continuous improvement, and serve as a key connector between engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

This is a people-first leadership role for someone who has grown beyond hands-on delivery but remains technically credible—capable of conducting meaningful code reviews, mentoring engineers at every level, and shaping a culture of engineering excellence across distributed teams.

Responsibilities

People leadership – Coach and develop direct reports through 1:1s, timely feedback, and career planning. Own performance management end-to-end, contribute to hiring, and enable Technical Leads to focus on their highest-leverage technical work.
Delivery – Set clear direction and realistic timelines, manage the roadmap with Product and Design, and proactively handle risks, blockers, and dependencies and escalate as needed to DOE. Own team delivery health metrics (print velocity, bug metrics) and provide visibility to DOE.
Process – Champion Agile practices, ceremonies, and ensure the team has space to act on improvements. Lead incident management and champion a blameless culture.
Technology – Engage in technical discussions at team level, ensure designs are properly evaluated, and keep team decisions consistent with TRG Screen’s architectural principles and engineering strategy.
AI governance – Actively drive AI adoption within the team, build capability and measure uptake. Hold the team accountable for AI code quality and own AI feature delivery. Ensure AI is used responsibly and in line with TRG Screen’s AI governance standards.
Security & communication – Treat secure coding and supply-chain hygiene as standard work. Foster a culture of clear communication, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback across the team and stakeholders.

Required

Skills and Qualifications

5 years of relevant industry experience building production-grade software solutions using an enterprise-grade stack. C# / .NET experience is preferred, though candidates with a strong background in comparable languages such as Java or Go are welcome to apply.
2+ years of people-management experience, with a proven ability to coach and develop engineers at varying levels.
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Continuous Delivery, developer velocity, and DevOps concepts.
Demonstrable experience managing team performance – setting expectations, conducting reviews, and supporting career growth.
Track record of managing delivery – planning, tracking, and communicating progress clearly to stakeholders at multiple levels.
Comfortable engaging in technical discussions at team level; able to represent and be accountable for the team’s technical output.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to tailor communication to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working in cross-functional environments alongside Product Management, Design, and Client Success.

Preferred

Background in financial services, market data, or a regulated technology environment.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tooling.
Familiarity with AI developer tooling (e.g. Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and experience driving adoption responsibly within an engineering team.
Exposure to cloud platforms, with AWS preferred.
Experience participating in security reviews, DDQs, or ISO 27001 audit processes.
Experience leading or contributing to technology modernisation programmes – including legacy migration, re-platforming, or the introduction of modern engineering practices into established codebases.

Leadership Qualities

People-first mindset – genuine investment in the growth and wellbeing of the team.
Clear decision-maker who takes ownership and learns from mistakes without defensiveness.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity; able to act responsibly without the full picture.
Economic thinker – able to frame trade-offs clearly and make pragmatic, business-aligned decisions.
Proactive problem solver who anticipates issues before they escalate.
Builds trust quickly across functions and levels; communicates with candour and respect.

Graduate Developer, IT

The role

Our IT Team deliver reliable, secure, and innovative technology solutions across the firm. From providing day to day technical support to driving digital transformation projects, the team ensures colleagues have the tools and systems they need to work effectively and deliver exceptional client service.

This is the perfect first role for someone who has recently completed a degree (or equivalent) and wants to build software in a business setting rather than a software house.

You will work alongside the team to build and maintain the internal tools, integrations and automations that our fee earners and support teams rely on. Typically, that means moving data between systems that were never designed to talk to each other, replacing manual spreadsheet processes with something reliable, and building reporting that gives our partners a clear view of the business.

We will give you real responsibility early, but you will be fully supported. We also fund professional qualifications and certifications relevant to your role.

What you’ll be doing

Building integrations between our practice management system, HR platform, CRM, resource planning tool and Microsoft 365, using REST APIs, Power Automate, UiPath and scripting
Writing and optimising SQL queries to extract, transform and validate data from our core systems
Developing internal applications and workflows using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) and Python or C#/.NET
Building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards for operational and board level reporting
Contributing to our robotic process automation programme, automating repetitive, high volume tasks in our tax and audit teams
Supporting the rollout and configuration of new business systems, including data migration and testing
Documenting what you build, so that someone else can pick it up and maintain it
Working directly with colleagues across the firm to understand their needs

What we need from you

Ideally you will:

Have a degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related subject, or demonstrable equivalent experience through self teaching, apprenticeship or personal projects
Have a working knowledge of at least one programming language (Python, C#, JavaScript or similar) and a willingness to learn others
Grasp relational databases and have the ability to write SQL
Be familiar with Microsoft Azure, the Power Platform, or Power BI
Have an interest in AI and automation, and how they can be applied responsibly to professional services work
Have great attention to detail and organisational skills
Be a confident communicator, and ask questions of people who are not technical

What we can give you in return

We offer a fantastic place to work with a competitive and flexible benefits package. This includes:

A minimum of 25 days holiday which increases with length of service. Plus, the option to buy and sell holiday
An annual salary review
Group pension scheme
A Level 1 Medicash Plan provided to all employees
Life assurance, which includes access to a smart health app
An employee assistance programme for you and your family
One volunteering day per year
Cinema society discounts
GymFlex discounts
Bupa private medical insurance available
Electric car and cycle to work schemes

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About Bounty

Bounty has supported UK parents since 1959, when it launched with hospital-given packs for new
mothers, and today reaches millions of families each year through the Bounty app, prenatal packs in
clinical settings, and bounty.com. Bounty is part of Joy, an AI-powered parenting platform that pairs
certified experts with AI to give parents round-the-clock support, alongside sister brands and
services across the group.

The Bounty app and bounty.com support hundreds of thousands of parents each month through
pregnancy, birth, and early parenthood. We're now investing in a full modernisation of the platform
behind that experience — a ground-up rebuild designed to give the business a faster, more flexible
foundation for years to come. We're hiring the person who'll lead that rebuild.

The role in brief

Come in, understand what we've built to date, then design and build a modern replacement for the
backend APIs that power the mobile app and website. Preserve the existing users, their data, and
our search ranking through the move. Then rebuild the website on the new backend.

What you'll be doing

Understand the current platform
Get familiar with our current environment: Sitecore, SQL Server and .NET on Azure IaaS, along with a network of scheduled tasks, SFTP feeds and partner integrations built up over time.
Some areas are better documented than others, so part of the role is building a clear, first-hand picture by exploring the code and observing the live systems directly, supported by AI tooling to move quickly.
Document your findings and recommended approach: target stack, migration plan, realistic timeline, risks, and how we keep the app and website running throughout the rebuild.

Rebuild the backend
Design and build the replacement backend API from scratch. We already have the mobile app's API contract documented (OpenAPI 3.1 spec, around 40 endpoints, mapped from the app codebases). The new backend needs to match that contract so we don't have to re-ship the app.
Migrate existing users and their data (accounts, permissions, engagement history, vouchers, editorial content) into the new data model. Nobody should have to re-register.
Switch over from the current backend once you're confident, with a written rollback plan you've tested in advance.

Rebuild the website
SEO is the biggest priority to protect. Rebuild bounty.com off Sitecore onto a modern stack you propose and we agree together. The site ranks well, and that ranking is worth real money, so URLs, redirects and structured data all need to carry over cleanly.

Keep it running
Once the move is complete, the day-to-day is keeping the new stack healthy and making sure integrations (Klaviyo, Purchasely, partner feeds) stay reliable. Our React-based Voucher
Management System sits with you too, both keeping it running and picking up feature work on it.
You'll also keep the analytics pipelines healthy (BigQuery, Looker Studio, Mixpanel) so the business team can rely on them for reporting.

Build what's next
With solid foundations in place, you'll work with the Bounty team on their product roadmap: new
features, improvements to what's there, and whatever the business needs from a platform built to
move quickly. This is where the rebuild starts paying off.

Who you are

Non-negotiables
Lead-level full-stack engineer. You can own a whole system yourself, from database through backend and frontend to deployment and monitoring, and you're comfortable making the architectural calls. You'll own this project end-to-end, with our mobile app engineers available to support you where the app side needs input.
Strong production backend in Node/TypeScript. We're standardising on TypeScript across the stack, so this role can extend into other engineering work at Bounty (and sister brand Joy) over time. React/TypeScript on the frontend is a given.
API design discipline. REST, OpenAPI, versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation. You've kept a client-consumed API stable over time.
Comfort with established systems. You don't need prior experience with our specific stack, but you're comfortable getting to grips with systems that are new to you — reading the actual code and running the actual systems rather than guessing.
Sensible use of AI-assisted development. You use AI tools day-to-day and know when to trust them and when not to, especially around company data, IP, and hallucinations.
Clear writing. You can put together a technical proposal or a handover document without hand-holding. You'll be writing for non-technical stakeholders throughout.
Good judgement about scope. You know when to park a nice-to-have because it's holding up the critical path, and when to flag a scope risk before it becomes a delivery problem.

Nice to have
You've led a live data migration before, at real scale, without losing data or breaking things. You understand why dual-write, reconciliation and a rehearsed cutover matter.
SEO awareness (URL preservation, canonical tags, structured data, redirect chains).
Azure and/or GCP experience. We're on Azure today and moving toward GCP to align with the wider organisation.

Explicitly not required
Please don't rule yourself out because you haven't used our specific stack or third-party tools before.
None of that is a blocker, the parts that matter, you'll pick up quickly.

What we offer

Salary range £90k–£115k, depending on experience.
Remote (UK), with occasional in-person time for team offsites.
25 days holiday.
Pension: 3% employer + 5% personal contribution.
Life assurance at 2x salary.
Option to enrol in private medical cover after a 6-month probation.
Genuinely interesting work: you'll build something modern from scratch with real autonomy, rather than shipping small features on an existing platform.
A well-established brand with a loyal, sizeable audience — hundreds of thousands of parents will be using what you build.

How to apply

Send a CV plus a short note (under 400 words) covering:
The most complex legacy or platform rebuild you've led, and what surprised you about it.
One thing you'd want to understand about our current setup before committing to a target architecture.

Applications via LinkedIn only. Closing date: 30 September 2026.

MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.

The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability
Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful
Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable
Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design
Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network
(Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About You

5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks
Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality
Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Bonus points

Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!)
Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs
Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)
Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)
Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3)
Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open fully remote, or hybrid from our Berlin, Germany hub if you prefer time with the team in person.
