AVEVA’s Chief Technology Office drives emerging-technology innovation from early signals to real-world impact by scouting technology and market trends and then maturing capabilities such as Industrial AI, Digital Twins, robotics, simulation, visualization, and edge-to-cloud technologies through hands-on technical evaluation, experimentation, and rapid prototyping. The CT Office Incubation Team turns emerging technology ideas into working prototypes that can be validated with customers, partners, and internal teams.

As a Full Stack Developer, you will help build end-to-end prototype solutions (UI, APIs, data integration, and cloud/edge deployment) to test new concepts in Digital Twins, Industrial AI, robotics, simulation, and visualization. You’ll work in small, fast-moving, multidisciplinary teams, collaborating with engineers, researchers, product and solution specialists, and industrial domain experts. This role suits an early-career developer who enjoys learning quickly, working across the stack, and turning ideas into functional software—valuing curiosity, practical problem-solving, and clear communication alongside coding skills.

Key Responsibilities

Support the build of full‑stack prototypes by implementing and testing frontend, backend, APIs, and basic data integrations under guidance.
Help turn product ideas into small, testable demos by contributing to minimum-viable implementations and iterating quickly.
Develop and maintain simple, well-documented REST APIs and integrations (including event-driven patterns when needed) for internal and customer-facing prototype environments.
Use AI-assisted coding tools effectively and responsibly, while learning to validate generated code for correctness, security, quality, and IP compliance with support from senior engineers.
Improve reliability and demo readiness by fixing bugs, adding basic tests, and ensuring prototypes can be set up and reproduced by others.
Apply baseline security best practices (secrets handling, dependency hygiene, access control awareness, safe data handling) following team standards.
Troubleshoot prototype applications using logs and basic observability tools; escalate issues early with clear context.
Document your work clearly (setup steps, API notes, known limitations, assumptions) to help teammates and future reuse.
Collaborate with cross-functional teammates (product, researchers, solution architects, domain experts) and participate in team practices such as PR reviews, while building confidence in providing feedback.
Contribute small reusable components and templates and grow your knowledge of industrial software topics (Digital Twins, simulation, industrial data, robotics, edge/visualization) over time.

Essential Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or equivalent hands-on experience) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Maths/Physics, or a related field.
1–3 years of practical coding experience through a mix of internships, junior roles, university projects, open-source, or personal projects.
Experience building end-to-end applications or prototypes, covering both backend and basic frontend components.
Working knowledge of at least one backend stack (e.g., Python, Rust, Java, Node.js, C) and a willingness to learn new tools as needed.
Familiarity with REST APIs, basic database concepts (relational and/or NoSQL), and software engineering fundamentals (testing, debugging, modular design, incremental delivery).
Comfortable using Git and common team workflows (branches, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD).
Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot/Cursor/Claude Code/Codex), with an understanding that generated code must be reviewed and validated.
Exposure to containers (Docker/Podman/Apptainer) and at least one cloud platform (Azure/AWS/GCP).
Initial experience with edge and autonomous deployments, for example deploying software to constrained devices or platforms such as robots, drones, gateways, or on-prem edge servers, including awareness of reliability and connectivity
Able to work in ambiguous problem spaces, ask good questions, learn quickly, and communicate clearly in English; willing to travel occasionally for workshops, demos, and prototype validation.

jobs.title: Engineering Architect
jobs.description:
As our new Engineering Architect, you will own and evolve the technical foundations that underpin product and service delivery, including engineering standards, development frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, testing harnesses, observability, and operational practices.

Your focus will be on enabling a fast-moving, AI-first delivery team to consistently deliver high-quality, scalable, and supportable solutions without needing to rebuild core foundations for every delivery cycle.

What you'll do

In this varied role, you will:
own and version technical foundations across all seven harness dimensions (Security, performance, coding style, UI/UX baselines, logging and observability, testing) so that every deliverable inherits secure, observable and tested defaults
build and maintain the shared ADO CI/CD pipelines and release governance so that standards are enforced automatically, and DORA metrics are produced from the pipeline itself
own the light-touch technical governance model - automated gates over committee review
ensure observability is instrumented from the first commit through to live running so that everything the team ships can be operated and handed over to a receiving product team
contribute hands-on as a full-stack builder inside each delivery's time box so that the harness stays credible and drift is caught in days rather than at cycle end
own the design and hands-on running of the delivery stack end to end - application architecture, containerisation, virtualisation, networking and deployment topology - so that what the team builds can be stood up, scaled and supported in the Azure estate without external dependency
shape deliveries as one of three leads, testing technical feasibility and setting the no-gos, so that committed work stays inside its appetite
represent the team's technical position in assurance, security and enterprise architecture conversations
proactively track industry trends, emerging tools and agentic engineering practice, and self-initiate the learning needed to apply them - trialling promising techniques and approaches in cooldown and sharing what works back into the harness, rules files and skills library.

What you'll need

We are looking for:
deep, current full stack engineering capability with hands-on delivery in an Azure and Azure DevOps (ADO) ecosystem using infrastructure as code approaches
strong practical coding experience in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with the fluency to work across back-end services, front-end interfaces and automation scripting
sound stack design judgement, with working knowledge of containerisation, virtualisation and networking sufficient to design, deploy and troubleshoot applications across Azure environments
proven ownership of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, release governance and DORA-based delivery measurement

The project:
New Canary Wharf HQ represents an opportunity to redefine digital delivery standards on one of a leading Financial Institutions most important London developments. The project has been specifically established to avoid lessons learned from previous programmes where inconsistent BIM adoption across the supply chain resulted in significant handover challenges and incomplete information records.

This role offers the chance to shape BIM strategy, drive innovation and establish a leading BIM-to-Digital-Twin delivery model for the flagship global client.

This is a high-profile project that will establish a benchmark for BIM-enabled project delivery and digital twin readiness across the institutions real estate portfolio. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that BIM requirements are embedded from project inception through design, construction, handover and operational readiness.

Working closely with the clients Design and Construction stakeholders, designers, contractors and specialist trade partners, you will drive compliance with BIM Requirements, ISO 19650 processes and digital twin objectives, ensuring that all project information is delivered in a structured, coordinated and operationally useful manner. The role will also play a key part in preparing project information for integration into Autodesk Tandem and future operational digital twin environments.

You’ll Be Responsible For

Information management leadership

Manage the implementation of BIM and Information Management processes in accordance with ISO 19650.
Act as the primary BIM and Digital Delivery lead for the project.
Establish project BIM governance, assurance and reporting processes.
Review and monitor compliance with Employer's Information Requirements (EIR), Asset Information Requirements (AIR), BIM Execution Plans (BEP), MIDPs and TIDPs.
Provide strategic guidance to designers, contractors and trade contractors on BIM implementation.

BIM assurance and compliance

Undertake formal BIM compliance reviews at key project milestones.
Monitor model quality, metadata completeness, naming compliance and information standards.
Review federated models for coordination and constructability.
Conduct BIM maturity and supply-chain capability assessments.
Produce BIM compliance dashboards in Tableau, risk registers and executive reporting for bank’s stakeholders.

Design and construction coordination

Facilitate BIM coordination workshops and design review sessions.
Oversee clash detection processes and issue management workflows.
Ensure coordination issues are identified, assigned and resolved.
Monitor contractor and subcontractor model delivery throughout construction.
Drive accountability across the supply chain to ensure BIM deliverables are maintained throughout the project lifecycle.

Asset information and digital twin readiness

Define and oversee asset information requirements and data governance processes.
Review COBie deliverables and asset metadata quality.
Ensure information required for operations and facilities management is captured progressively throughout the project.
Support the development and population of the Asset Information Model (AIM).
Prepare project information for handover into Autodesk Tandem and future digital twin environments.

Stakeholder management

Serve as the primary point of contact for all BIM-related matters.
Build strong relationships with the clients Design and Construction teams, consultants and contractors.
Present BIM performance, risks and recommendations to senior client stakeholders.
Support procurement activities by reviewing BIM capability, methodologies and tender responses.
The EIR specifically identifies BIM Managers as responsible for ensuring model delivery, CDE uploads, EIR compliance, COBie delivery, model federation, coordination reviews and communication between project stakeholders.

You’ll Need To Have

Significant experience in BIM, Digital Engineering or Information Management.
Proven experience leading BIM delivery on major commercial, mixed-use, data centre or corporate workplace developments.
Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams and contractors.
Strong knowledge of BIM governance, model assurance and information management workflows.

Experience leading project-wide BIM coordination and assurance programmes.

ISO 19650 series.
Autodesk Construction Cloud or Forma.
Autodesk Revit.
Navisworks Manage.
Solibri (as alternative)
COBie.
IFC workflows.
Asset information management.
Common data environment administration.
Digital twin platforms and BIM-to-Operations workflows (advantage)
Experience delivering BIM on projects exceeding £100m construction value.
Previous client-side or consultancy-side advisory experience.
Experience supporting digital twin initiatives and operational information management.
Familiarity with Autodesk Tandem.
Experience working within highly regulated or corporate real estate environments.

jobs.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

The Team

The Structured Finance (SF) Methodologies team is responsible for a large portfolio of criteria and models spanning the global SF universe, including CMBS, RMBS, CLO, Covered Bonds, Non-Traditional and ABS asset types. The criteria and models that the group develops and maintains help analysts produce independent credit ratings that increase S&P Global’s analytical relevance in the market. As a Methodology Model SME, the position is embedded within the SF team and works closely with the Model and Criteria SMEs, who are responsible for developing and maintaining a growing portfolio of cutting-edge quantitative tools and analysis that enable analysts to continually produce high-quality and transparent credit analysis.

The Impact

The Associate Director enhances S&P Global Ratings’ ability to produce high-impact, insightful research and models and supports the continued growth of S&P Global Ratings’ relevance in an evolving market by synthesizing, analyzing, and deriving value from datasets, developing innovative analytic solutions and tools, and helping to build data analytics capabilities across the SF team.

What’s in it for you?

The role leverages quantitative abilities to develop analytic solutions and tools that enable credit analysts to perform high-quality analysis and research.
The position explores new areas for research and aids in business development initiatives. It supervises and performs implementation and testing of quantitative models as prototypes and production engines using the Quantitative Toolbox as appropriate, to further the study, application and acceptance of quantitative methodologies as part of the firm’s businesses.
The role offers a challenging, steep learning curve, and the position could lead to continued growth within the organization by demonstrating strong analysis and presentation skills.
Gain analytic knowledge of a wide range of global sectors and market topics.
Gain exposure to stakeholders across S&P Ratings and enjoy a strong collegial, collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain nimble, user-friendly quantitative solutions and tools that will be used by credit analysts globally in credit rating analyses and research publications.
Synthesize and analyze large datasets to derive analytic value and insights for credit rating analyses and research publications.
Proactively identify and implement creative solutions to drive continuous improvement across models and analytical workflows.
Provide analytical insight and technical guidance to help the team resolve complex, non-routine problems and tasks.
Maintain close interaction with analysts, model developers, and subject matter experts to ensure that data analyses and tools effectively inform analytical decisions.
Work closely with the Model and Criteria Validation group to ensure a high-quality product.
Write clear, concise specifications and development documentation to ensure consistent and thorough documentation in accordance with policy and procedures.
Support criteria projects and be an active member of projects, including testing of new concepts, data gathering, writing and preparation of materials.
Coach and guide junior developers on technical tasks and best practices; support criteria projects by assisting with tool development, testing, and data gathering 

Compensation / Benefits Information

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $148,491 to $176,000 USD (This section is only applicable to US Candidates). Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please visit spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries.

Basic Qualifications

What We’re Looking For:

An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 5 to 7 years of experience in quantitative modeling or software development supporting financial analysis.
Knowledge of capital markets and financial instruments, with an emphasis on credit risk modeling preferred.
Basic understanding of database modeling/design and applications, including knowledge of SQL and experience in databases such as Oracle, Sybase, or Access.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel/VBA and programming languages such as R, Python, C++, and MATLAB.
Persistent with a natural curiosity about credit markets and technical details.
Displays well-rounded communication skills that implement good listening techniques, clear and good verbal skills. The ability to communicate across a wide range of groups and personalities internally and externally.
Works well in a team environment, focusing on collaboration and adapting to the needs of a diverse team.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field 
Self-starter with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across diverse teams.
Able to summarize complex quantitative concepts clearly and concisely for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience supporting multi-stage projects from planning through execution.
Strong time management, prioritization and deadline-management skills.
Effective communication, interpersonal and facilitation skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder-management skills.
Creative problem-solver who works well in fast-paced environments.
We require all candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, which is ordinarily at your nearest S&P Global Ratings office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer.
All employees are required to work from the office a minimum of 2 days per week

About S&P Global Ratings

At S&P Global Ratings, our analyst-driven credit ratings, research, and sustainable finance opinions provide critical insights that are essential to translating complexity into clarity so market participants can uncover opportunities and make decisions with conviction. By bringing transparency to the market through high-quality independent opinions on creditworthiness, we enable growth across a wide variety of organizations, including businesses, governments, and institutions.

S&P Global Ratings is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today.

For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/ratings

What’s In It For
You?

Our Mission

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Our Values

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

Benefits

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.

Our Benefits Include

Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role:

As a Senior Solutions Architect specializing in containerized solutions, you will play a crucial, pioneering role in this new initiative. Your primary focus will be leading the deployment of these solutions within our customer environments.

Solutions Architects are vital members of our project teams, often serving as the initial technical point of contact for our customers and key technical stakeholders for a successful deployment of Celonis. To ensure our customers achieve value, you will drive the technical setup required to leverage the full range of Celonis features and functionalities, including process mining, execution management, process automation, Action Flow, and task mining.

Given the unique nature of every customer environment, you will be the key liaison for translating the customer's technical requirements to ensure successful deployment on the clients infrastructure and successful integrations with their source systems. Furthermore, you will lead discussions on user management and authentication, acting as a technical partner to remove any technical barriers to user adoption.

The work you’ll do:

On Celonis side you are the key technical stakeholder for a successful technical delivery and onboarding of Celonis for enterprise clients.
Lead technical discussions to analyze customer architecture, recommend optimal solutions, and facilitate deployment, managing expectations amidst technical constraints.
Remove technical obstacles to maximize Celonis user adoption, clarifying technical risks and necessary tradeoffs.
Promote reusability by choosing between dedicated customer solutions and broader platform enhancements in collaboration with Celonis product development.
Establish real-time data integrations between customer systems and Celonis via APIs and internal tools.
Guide customers on authentication, user/group management, and provisioning best practices. Thus, removing all technical barriers to drive user adoption of Celonis.

The qualifications you need:

Proven experience of 5+ years, with at least 3 years in deploying and managing containerized applications on Kubernetes.
Advanced knowledge with at least one specific Kubernetes distribution (Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, RedHat OpenShift, etc.).
Eligibility for UK Security Check (SC) clearance is required; existing clearance is a strong advantage.
Very good understanding of best practices in deploying, scaling, and maintaining highly available, secure and resilient containerized applications on Kubernetes, ensuring efficient resource utilization and operational stability.
Proven experience implementing infrastructure as code (IaC, e.g. with Terraform) is required; Helm or Kustomize experience is strongly preferred. Fluency with additional tools such as ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Ansible, etc., is a plus.
Experience with at least one of the major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) would be a plus.
Experience & interest in working with modern tech stack & methods like REST/SOAP API-Management, Data Ingestion & Streaming (Kafka or similar), SSO, LDAP, IT Security, Agile, etc.
Experience in industry with experience to work on Python, SQL, data pipelines & ETL processes for large volumes of data is a plus.
Knowledgeable about security and compliance topics for enterprise applications.Solid experience with project management, outstanding customer-centric & proven experience working with customers.
A solution-oriented professional that enjoys deep technical discussions as much as transferring your technical knowledge into understandable terms to a broader audience

What Celonis can offer you:

Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

The Team

The Audit Technology team at KPMG is driving innovation at the intersection of auditing and advanced technological solutions, reshaping the future of audit delivery. By combining expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, and Software Development, the team is revolutionising the auditing process to deliver smarter, faster, and more reliable outcomes.

Our mission is to design and implement robust, intelligent, and scalable technologies that not only streamline workflows but also enhance audit quality and generate actionable insights for auditors and clients. Through harnessing the power of cutting-edge tools, we aim to transform traditional audit practices into dynamic, forward-thinking processes that are built for the complexities of the modern business environment.

Our team, supported by KPMG’s global network, serves as the driving force behind this transformative journey. Focused on innovation, this team is dedicated to engineering solutions today that anticipate the challenges and opportunities of tomorrow, ensuring that audit services remain at the forefront of technological progression.

The Role

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in transforming advanced AI concepts into impactful, production-ready solutions within the Audit Technology team. You will lead a dedicated AI engineering squad, working closely with data scientists, data engineers, software developers, cloud architects, and audit professionals to build and scale AI-driven systems that enhance audit quality, efficiency, and insight generation.

From developing robust proof-of-concepts to deploying enterprise-grade solutions, you will apply your expertise in AI engineering, cloud platforms, and technologies such as Generative AI, Azure, Databricks to embed intelligence into critical audit workflows and products.

In addition to technical leadership, you will shape the growth of the team—mentoring engineers, promoting best practices, and fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. You will stay at the forefront of AI engineering trends, advocate for modern development methodologies, and drive knowledge-sharing across both the technology and audit domains.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Mentorship: Lead a high-performing AI engineering team comprising software engineers and AI practitioners. Provide hands-on technical direction, foster career growth, and cultivate a collaborative culture that emphasizes engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Scalable AI Engineering: Drive the design, development, and deployment of production-grade AI systems tailored to audit applications. Ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and maintainable by applying strong software engineering principles, MLOps practices, and cloud-native development.
End-to-End AI Solution Delivery: Oversee the full lifecycle of AI product engineering—from architectural design and prototyping to CI/CD-enabled deployment—using modern platforms and tools such as Azure ML, Databricks, MLflow, LangChain and LangGraph. Champion automation, testing, and observability across pipelines.
Operational Excellence: Define reusable development patterns, enforce coding standards, and promote MLOps best practices that support version control, performance optimisation, and maintainability.
Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Partner closely with data scientists, product managers, platform engineers, and QA teams to align on technical requirements, delivery timelines, and integration plans. Ensure AI capabilities are well-embedded within core audit platforms and services.
AI Governance & Risk Management: Implement engineering controls to support responsible AI use, including model monitoring, explainability, security, and auditability. Contribute to the operationalisation of AI governance frameworks to ensure regulatory and ethical compliance.
Capability Building & Knowledge Sharing: Drive initiatives to enhance internal capabilities, empowering team members and the broader Audit Technology function with the skills and knowledge to adopt and adapt AI innovations effectively.

Requirements

Bachelor (preferably master or PhD) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent professional experience.
Strong knowledge of generative AI, machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing and other relevant AI fields.
Proven track record of designing, developing, and deploying AI systems in production environments.
Proficient in Python and key ML libraries (e.g. PyTorch, PySpark, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers).
Hands-on experience with modern data platforms and AI tooling such as Azure ML, Databricks, MLflow, LangChain, LangGraph.
Proven experience with modern engineering practices Git, version control, unit testing and containerisation.
Familiarity with agile work methodologies and tools like Jira and Confluence.
Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Advanced certifications in AI, machine learning, cloud computing or data engineering are highly advantageous.
Professional accounting qualification preferred, however not a requirement.

Why Audit at KPMG?

Audit is the largest of our UK practices. Some of the world’s biggest companies rely on us to provide independent insight, challenge and expertise, so the work we undertake affects investment decisions, inspires confidence in public sector expenditure and supports our economic growth. Today, more than ever in disruptive times, audit is a function needed by society, and in the future, so we can capitalise, and grow. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

As a Senior Pre-Sales Engineer
, you are a "developer-plus" technical contributor. You are responsible for building high-quality mock backends, APIs, and demo infrastructure, but with a unique twist: you leverage LLMs and Generative AI
to prototype at high velocity.

This role sits at the critical boundary between Product Engineering and Go-to-Market. While you won't build production systems, you will build "production-shaped" assets: reusable, well-structured, and documented services that enable credible technical storytelling and high-fidelity client validation.

Your core responsibilities will include:

AI-Accelerated Prototyping: Leverage LLMs (e.g., Claude and Gemini) to rapidly scaffold, build, and iterate on proof-of-concept apps and mock services. You move faster than a traditional sprint by using AI to handle the "heavy lifting" of boilerplate and logic generation.
Technical Asset Development: Design, build, and maintain reusable mock services in Node.js / TypeScript. You’ll implement contract-first APIs (REST/GraphQL), manage AWS deployments (API Gateway, Containers), and handle persistence using PostgreSQL or DynamoDB
Infrastructure as Code: Manage demo environments using Terraform, ensuring environments are reproducible and secure using existing OIDC authentication patterns.
Frontend Collaboration: Work closely with frontend engineers to ensure UI components point cleanly to your mock services, debugging integration issues and supporting end-to-end demo flows.
Strategic Pre-Sales Support: Partner with Pre-Sales consultants to translate client "win themes" into working technical artefacts. You will occasionally demo directly to clients, showcasing how Kaluza solves their specific retail challenges.
Product & UX Influence: Collaborate with Design and Product teams for UI direction while developing your own design ideas to make Kaluza’s capabilities shine.
Mentorship & Standards: Set informal engineering standards for the pre-sales team, mentoring others on API design and architecture.
AI Evangelism: Act as the resident expert in GenAI workflows for the Commercial team, mentoring others on how to use AI to bridge the gap between "slide-ware" and "software."

What this role is NOT:

A pure presentation-led role (you will be writing code regularly).
Shipping production code (your value comes from building things that work for a demo, not maintaining production SLOs).

About You

You are a software engineer by trade but a prototyper by heart. You understand the rigour of clean code but know when to lean into AI to accelerate delivery. You are motivated by the immediate impact of winning new clients and validating Kaluza’s value proposition in real-time.

Ideally you’ll have/be:

Software Engineering Foundation: Strong hands-on experience in Node.js / TypeScript and React. You know how to write code from scratch, which is why you’re so good at prompting AI to do it for you.
GenAI Power User: Deep experience leveraging LLMs and Generative AI to build apps, debug complex issues, and accelerate the development lifecycle. You aren't just using an AI assistant; you are "vibe coding" complete PoCs.
API Design Expert: Experience designing clean, well-documented APIs (REST and/or GraphQL) and using Git/Github workflows effectively.
Cloud & Infrastructure Knowledge: Familiarity with AWS primitives and a proven ability to deploy infrastructure using Terraform.
Pragmatic & Autonomous: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, translating vague client requirements into working systems through a high degree of initiative.

What Will Set You Apart

The "Prototyper" Portfolio: A track record of building internal tools, sales demos, or high-fidelity PoCs using AI-first workflows.
Energy Sector Insight: Understanding the specific challenges facing energy retailers globally.
Auth & Security Savvy: Practical knowledge of OIDC-based authentication flows.
Design Thinking: A talent for sharing UX/UI design thinking with wider product teams.

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At MHR, our employees are central to our success and play a key role in helping customers achieve sustainable high performance. With a team of over 900 professionals, we work to make things flow smoothly, whether it's for large organisations or individual employees. As businesses face rapid changes in the world of work, our team is here to help them adapt and thrive.

By focusing on the core needs of efficiency, productivity, growth, and impact, our employees use their expertise to deliver real solutions through our People and Finance platform. This system, which covers finance, HR, payroll, and learning, helps businesses run more smoothly and make better decisions in real time.

With over 40 years of experience behind us, MHR’s track record as a high-performance organisation is built on clear goals, a shared vision, and strong communication - all of which we pass on to our customers.

MHR is more than just a place to work; it’s a platform for empowerment. Joining us means bringing innovation, technology, and teamwork seamlessly removes obstacles, enhances your skills, and allow you to focus on what’s most important to you- work that matters.

With us, you’ll grow, find your flow, and make a lasting difference in your career, your team, and your impact.

Your Career

Join MHR as a Principal Software Engineer, leading complex engineering challenges that shape our products and technical direction.

In this role, you will operate across the organisation—defining strategy, influencing architecture, and guiding delivery within a modern SaaS environment. Drawing on experience with Microsoft technologies such as .NET and Azure, you’ll apply modern programming practices including cloud-native design, distributed systems, and test-driven development.

You will also champion AI-assisted development to improve engineering efficiency, quality, and innovation. This is a high-impact position combining hands-on expertise with technical leadership and mentoring.

Your Team

You’ll work across cross-functional Agile teams, partnering closely with engineers, architects, and stakeholders.
Through influence rather than authority, you’ll help align teams and foster a collaborative, inclusive culture focused on continuous improvement.

Your Impact

This role will see you defining and executing technical strategy, shaping scalable, resilient architecture aligned with business goals.

You’ll drive engineering excellence through best practice—embedding test-driven development and using AI-assisted tooling to enhance delivery. Working across teams, you’ll help align priorities, mitigate risks, and ensure consistent, high-quality outcomes, while mentoring engineers to strengthen capability.

As a trusted technical leader, you’ll balance long-term vision with delivery outcomes.

What you’ll bring to the role and MHR

Strong experience with Microsoft technologies (.NET, Azure) and modern engineering practices
Expertise in scalable architecture and cloud-native systems
Proven ability to deliver technical strategy and complex initiatives
Advocate of TDD, continuous improvement, and AI-assisted engineering
Strong collaboration and stakeholder communication skills
Experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards

Benefits to support you personally and professionally

Alongside the opportunity to work with an incredible team and express your individuality, we offer a range of personalised benefits including:

Access to over 60 internal training courses, professional qualifications, and cross-departmental mentoring and coaching programs
24/7 access to a GP through Help at Hand for you and your family, confidential mental health support, and paid sick leave
Ability to purchase or sell additional holiday days beyond 25 days and bank holidays
Enhanced Family leave
My MHRewards offering discounts at over 900 retailers
Monthly employee recognition program and departmental awards
Referral bonus scheme of up to £2,000
Employee-led social events such as running clubs, football teams, book clubs, and bake-offs
On-site subsidised restaurants offering a variety of fresh meals daily
Opt-in benefits schemes such as private medical insurance and dental coverage

We value the well-being, financial stability, and inclusivity of our employees, and strive to provide a supportive working environment.

At MHR, we’re completely committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where all voices are heard, and everyone feels valued and supported.

Whatever your background, abilities and experiences, if you’re excited by this role we want to hear from you. If you require assistance for an interview, please let us know and we’ll make sure your needs are met when you arrive.

If we receive an exceptionally high volume of applications, we reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier than originally advertised.

based on deep technical understanding and business context

establish security practices and conduct comprehensive security reviews

used consistently within the team

for complex software issues and production incidents

and drive knowledge transfer practices across team deliverables

actively to raise team capability and technical standards

conduct complex feature reviews, and drive quality improvements across team deliverables

and champion responsible AI adoption with team governance practices

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
At MHR, our employees are central to our success and play a key role in helping customers achieve sustainable high performance. With a team of over 900 professionals, we work to make things flow smoothly, whether it's for large organisations or individual employees. As businesses face rapid changes in the world of work, our team is here to help them adapt and thrive.

By focusing on the core needs of efficiency, productivity, growth, and impact, our employees use their expertise to deliver real solutions through our People and Finance platform. This system, which covers finance, HR, payroll, and learning, helps businesses run more smoothly and make better decisions in real time.

With over 40 years of experience behind us, MHR’s track record as a high-performance organisation is built on clear goals, a shared vision, and strong communication - all of which we pass on to our customers.

MHR is more than just a place to work; it’s a platform for empowerment. Joining us means bringing innovation, technology, and teamwork seamlessly removes obstacles, enhances your skills, and allow you to focus on what’s most important to you- work that matters.

With us, you’ll grow, find your flow, and make a lasting difference in your career, your team, and your impact.

Your Career

As a Software Engineering Manager at MHR, you'll lead a cross-functional team of Software Engineers and Test Engineers, helping build the next generation of our cloud-based HR and Payroll platform. You'll combine people leadership with technical influence, fostering a culture of engineering excellence, test-driven development and continuous improvement.

Working with modern technologies including .NET, Angular, Azure and AI-assisted development tools, you'll help shape how software is built while supporting the growth and success of your team.

Your Team

You'll lead a collaborative Agile team of engineers and testers, working closely with Product and Scrum teams to deliver high-quality software. We value shared ownership, continuous learning and a growth mindset, creating an environment where people can do their best work and develop their careers.

Your Impact

You'll be responsible for building high-performing teams, improving engineering practices and ensuring the delivery of scalable, maintainable software. Through coaching, mentoring and technical leadership, you'll help shape both our products and our engineering culture.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead, coach and develop a cross-functional engineering team.
Drive a culture of quality, test-driven development and continuous improvement.
Support the delivery of scalable, maintainable software and architecture.
Partner with Product teams to deliver against product roadmaps.
Remove delivery obstacles and improve team effectiveness.
Support recruitment, talent development and succession planning.
Champion AI-assisted development practices to improve productivity and quality.

What We're Looking For

Experience leading or mentoring software engineers within Agile teams.
Strong software engineering background
Passion for engineering excellence, code quality and test-driven development.
Experience driving continuous improvement and high-performing teams.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Interest in modern engineering practices, cloud technologies and AI-assisted development.

Benefits to support you personally and professionally

Alongside the opportunity to work with an incredible team and express your individuality, we offer a range of personalised benefits including:

Access to over 60 internal training courses, professional qualifications, and cross-departmental mentoring and coaching programs
24/7 access to a GP through Help at Hand for you and your family, confidential mental health support, and paid sick leave
Ability to purchase or sell additional holiday days beyond 25 days and bank holidays
Enhanced Family leave

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers don’t just write code. They harness AI tools to architect, optimize, and deliver scalable software faster while shaping the future of legal technology. They design systems that help industries uncover critical insights, ensure compliance, advance access to justice, and continuously evolve our platform using cloud-native architectures, AI capabilities, and modern developer tooling.

Our AI helps power privacy programs, identify confidential information, and detect language indicating misconduct. We are reimagining how legal professionals uncover truth at scale, and engineering is at the heart of that transformation.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Design, develop, and operate cloud-based services that enable organizations to manage and process data at scale across multiple platforms
Build full-stack features across .NET/C# backend services, React/JavaScript frontends, and SQL data layers that support core product workflows
Build and maintain integrations with external systems and internal platform services, including third-party cloud data sources, notification providers, and cross-team APIs
Plan and execute service and data migrations, including schema changes, deployment progressions, and feature transitions in live production environments
Apply cloud-native patterns including containerization, event-driven architecture, and infrastructure-as-code to deliver scalable and resilient services on Azure
Manage and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and independently deploy team-owned services
Use observability tooling including structured logging, metrics dashboards, and distributed tracing to investigate production issues and drive system improvements
Triage and remediate security vulnerabilities as part of the team’s ongoing security posture efforts
Participate in on-call rotations, contribute to incident response activities, and complete follow-up work to support continuous improvement
Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and adjacent teams to deliver committed sprint work on a regular cadence

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of professional software engineering experience
Proficiency in C# and .NET, or a comparable object-oriented language with willingness to ramp up on the stack
Experience building and operating cloud-based services
Ability to work independently through complex features and debug production issues with minimal direction
Familiarity with relational databases and SQL, including schema change management

Preferred

Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React for full-stack development
Working knowledge of CI/CD pipeline tooling using GitHub Actions
Familiarity with observability platforms such as New Relic, Grafana, or equivalent APM and logging tools
Exposure to authentication patterns including OAuth2, OIDC, or SAML in enterprise SaaS applications
Experience building or maintaining integrations with third-party APIs or enterprise SaaS systems
Familiarity with cloud-native concepts such as containerization, event-driven design, or infrastructure-as-code, with Azure experience preferred

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

160 000 and 240 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Netwrix is on a mission to help customers protect and secure their identity and data landscape through market-leading on-prem and SaaS products and integrated solutions. Netwrix Identity products provide leading identity security solutions to thousands of enterprise customers worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Software Engineer who will develop new features and capabilities for Netwrix Identity Recovery, our enterprise solution for backup and recovery of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta environments. The Staff Software Engineer will ensure scalable, secure, high-quality experiences for enterprise customers in both on-prem and SaaS environments.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced technical leader to help shape the future of identity recovery. You will contribute to the advancement of Netwrix Identity Recovery and key technologies across the platform, with opportunities to integrate AI capabilities into our products and development process. Working closely with engineers and product leaders, you'll influence architectural direction, mentor engineers, and help deliver solutions that protect organizations worldwide against identity-based threats.

Your home base is the Netwrix Identity Recovery team. You will work within a shared engineering platform and technology stack, with opportunities to contribute to other products across the Netwrix ITDR portfolio — such as PingCastle, Threat Prevention, and Threat Manager.

Write high-quality code and design scalable backend services for on-prem and SaaS environments, setting examples of technical excellence for the team and supporting key decisions on architecture, scalability, and integration

Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to tackle complex, ambiguous challenges

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. You will work on high-impact initiatives that shape how our engineers build, test, deploy, and scale software—driving technical excellence across the company.

As part of a growing and financially stable organization, you will contribute in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that values autonomy, ownership, and practical action over excessive process. jobs.description:

Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

Copilot Studio Architect
works within a technologically versatile team located in Poland, providing consulting services to biggest market players in EMEIA region and around the globe.

The opportunity

With a constant growth of our business and customers’ needs we are willing to move our projects on the new track. We are able to offer you a senior developer role with opportunity to support your further professional growth. You will work as part of a team that designs, develops, tests, deploys and supports different types of solutions using Power Platform, RPA and other modern technologies. You will work with the most recognizable and influential players on the financial markets within the challenging projects.

Your Key Responsibilities

Design and deliver end-to-end agentic AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform
Build scalable, secure architectures with strong focus on enterprise readiness
Develop advanced integrations with systems like SAP using APIs, custom connectors, and Azure services
Implement identity & access management patterns, including principal propagation (ensuring agents correctly inherit user permissions across systems)
Define how agents are authenticated and authorized when accessing external systems (e.g., retrieving invoice data or status from SAP)
Work hands-on with pro-code extensions (Microsoft AI stack, agent frameworks) for complex scenarios
Lead client engagements: shape vision, design solutions, run workshops, and present architectures
Support pre-sales activities (demos, PoCs, proposals) and contribute to AI/automation offerings

Skills And Attributes For Success

We are looking for experienced individuals with RPA and/or Power Platform skills, ready to further develop their technical and consulting skills across a variety of business processes, who are able to work independently but also as a part of a team.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio and agentic AI solutions
Solid background in integration design (REST APIs, OAuth, identity propagation patterns)
Strong experience with Power Platform architecture (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
Expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, service principals, and managed identities
Ability to design complex solutions independently and clearly communicate them to stakeholders
Strong consulting and problem-solving mindset

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience integrating Copilot Studio / Power Platform with SAP
Experience working with Agent365 or at least thorough understanding of capabilities and implementation best practices
Familiarity with agent frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, AutoGen)
Pro-code development skills (.NET, C#, JavaScript)
Experience with custom connectors and API management

What We Look For

We love working with people who are passionate about their job and have great interpersonal skills, who are ready to face new professional challenges. Are you a person with a good sense of humor and open to significantly extend your skillset? If yes, it’s a role for you.

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering (BI & Analytics)
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Since being founded in 2001, BlackLine has become a leading provider of cloud software that automates and controls the entire financial close process. Our vision is to modernize the finance and accounting function to enable greater operational effectiveness and agility, and we are committed to delivering innovative solutions and services to empower accounting and finance leaders around the world to achieve Modern Finance.
Being a best-in-class SaaS company, we understand that bringing in new ideas and innovative technology is mission critical. At BlackLine we are always working with new, cutting-edge technology that encourages our teams to learn something new and expand their creativity and technical skillset that will accelerate their careers.
This role is specifically for our AI-powered Invoice-to-Cash (I2C) solution, a market-leading platform that uses intelligent automation to help companies collect cash faster, unlock working capital, and supercharge efficiency in their accounts receivable processes.
Work, Play and Grow at BlackLine!

Make Your Mark

As the founding Manager, Software Engineering for our new Business Intelligence & Analytics Engineering team
in Krakow, you have one of the most consequential roles in this new chapter of BlackLine's growth. This is a genuinely multi-disciplinary team - spanning data engineering, cloud data platforms, BI and analytics, and applied AI - and you will be the architect of the team itself: hiring and developing a world-class group of engineers across those disciplines, and shaping the culture, practices, and career trajectories of everyone in it.
You will lead the team through an ambitious delivery arc. You will start by standing up modern data pipelines - using Fabric database mirroring to move data from our Azure-hosted tenant databases into a canonical data model in Snowflake
- then build the modelling layer and surface insight to customers through Power BI
dashboards. From there, the team will develop true agentic AI experiences for risk analysis, credit management, cash allocation, and Disputes & Deductions (D&D), blending Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) patterns on BlackLine's BL 3.0 Agentic framework.
You will partner closely with your senior engineers and cross-functional product leadership to ensure the team operates with clarity, urgency, and a high engineering bar. You will champion a culture of AI-accelerated development, where tools like Claude and Cursor are woven into the everyday fabric of how we build. This is not just a management role - it is a founding leadership role with an enduring impact on our mission to deliver autonomous finance and expand BlackLine's office-of-the-CFO footprint.

You'll Get To

Build and Scale the Krakow BI & Analytics Engineering Team:
Lead the hiring, onboarding, and ongoing development of a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team spanning data engineering, BI/analytics, and AI. Be an ambassador for BlackLine's engineering culture in the Krakow hub from day one.
Deliver the Snowflake Analytics Platform:
Own delivery of our modern data platform - Fabric database mirroring from Azure-hosted tenant databases into a canonical Snowflake data model, the Snowflake modelling and semantic layers, and customer-facing Power BI dashboards that turn that data into insight.
Lead the Agentic Experience Roadmap:
Guide the team from analytics into applied AI - building true agentic agents for risk analysis, credit management, cash allocation, and Disputes & Deductions management, delivering a mix of Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) experiences on BlackLine's BL 3.0 Agentic framework, integrated with our existing web applications.
Lead, Coach, and Grow Your Team:
Own the career development, performance, and wellbeing of your direct reports across a varied set of specialisms. Conduct regular 1:1s, provide meaningful feedback, and create growth paths that retain and attract top talent in a competitive Krakow market.
Drive Delivery and Execution:
Partner with Product Management to align on priorities, manage engineering capacity, and ensure the team consistently delivers high-quality software and data products on time. Remove blockers, manage risk, and keep commitments.
Champion AI-Accelerated Development:
Cultivate a team mindset and workflow that embraces modern agentic development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) as force multipliers for velocity and quality - and hold the bar high for what great engineering looks like in this era.
Shape Engineering Culture and Standards:
Establish and uphold best practices across the full stack of the team's work - data pipeline reliability and observability, data quality and lineage, dimensional and semantic modelling standards, code quality, CI/CD, testing, and security. Set the tone for a culture of ownership, craft, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally:
Serve as the primary engineering leadership voice in conversations with Product, Design, and senior stakeholders, and with the analytics and office-of-the-CFO consumers of the team's output. Translate business goals into actionable engineering plans and communicate engineering realities clearly to non-technical partners.
Contribute to Strategic Roadmap Planning:
Participate in quarterly and annual planning cycles, providing technical and capacity input that shapes the product roadmap, the data platform architecture, and long-term agentic-AI direction.
Sustain Enterprise-Grade Quality:
Ensure the team's output - data pipelines, analytics, and AI agents alike - meets the reliability, performance, accuracy, and security standards required by a global SaaS platform serving finance and accounting professionals worldwide.

Technical / Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Proven experience leading and growing engineering teams
in a SaaS product environment, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining engineers at multiple seniority levels.
Strong technical foundation in data engineering and analytics
- hands-on experience with cloud data platforms and pipelines, ideally including Snowflake
, Microsoft Fabric
, and Power BI / DAX
, and dimensional or semantic data modelling - sufficient to earn trust with your engineers and make sound architectural trade-offs.

- production-grade, scalable, secure services, ideally in C# / .NET
- and comfort leading integration with modern web applications (React / C# / SQL Server / PostgreSQL).

(including HITL and HOTL patterns) and integrating them into enterprise products.

aligning engineering, product, and design stakeholders around shared goals and managing execution with clarity and accountability.
Strong people management skills,
including structured performance management, career development frameworks, and the ability to have direct, compassionate conversations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
comfortable representing the team to senior leadership and working effectively across time zones and cultures.
A high engineering bar:
you understand what great looks like in data quality, pipeline reliability, code quality, CI/CD, testing, and observability, and you hold the team to that standard.

We're Even More Excited If You Have

Experience standing up a new engineering team or office, especially in a greenfield or hub-expansion context where you shaped culture from scratch.
Experience delivering a cloud data-warehouse migration or modernisation (e.g., to Snowflake) and building customer-facing embedded analytics.

jobs.title: L3 Support Engineer
jobs.description:
About the project:

US-based home medical equipment providers and hospitals run on tight schedules — missed deliveries, billing errors, and documentation gaps have real consequences. We're building a centralized SaaS platform that handles the operational backbone for these providers: scheduling, invoicing, documentation, and medical item logistics. The system is live, growing, and needs someone who can hold the line when things get complex.

A new team member will be in charge of:

Own the L3 escalation layer — be the last technical stop before an issue reaches the development team, and make sure most don't need to.
Diagnose and resolve deep-level issues across backend services, APIs, and databases, with a clear path to permanent fixes — not just workarounds.
Drive root cause analysis in close collaboration with dev and DevOps, turning recurring incidents into documented, solved problems.
Keep the knowledge base current — incidents, solutions, and patterns that actually help the next person on shift.
Support releases and bug fix validation from the operational side, including CI/CD touchpoints.

Does this relate to you?

3–5+ years in IT support roles, with hands-on experience in SaaS or enterprise application environments.
Solid experience troubleshooting .NET-based applications — C# and ASP.NET Core specifically. This is a hard requirement.
Strong grasp of microservices architecture — you understand how services talk to each other and where things break down.
Comfortable working with MySQL or PostgreSQL at a diagnostic level — reading query plans, spotting data issues, tracing DB-side failures.
Familiar with API troubleshooting, authentication flows, and authorization patterns — you know what a broken token or a misconfigured scope looks like.
Experience with ticketing systems and incident management workflows (JIRA or similar) — you know how to work an SLA without losing the thread.
Upper-Intermediate English or above — enough to communicate clearly with a US-based client team in writing and on calls.
Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to speed up diagnostics, draft documentation, and work through unfamiliar codebases — treating them as a practical tool, not a novelty.
Available to start your working day at 2PM CET time. This is a firm schedule requirement tied to client timezone overlap.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines from an operational or support perspective is a plus.

How We Support Your Success:

Remote or hybrid? The choice is yours. We offer a highly flexible approach to time off and personal days, empowering you to manage your own work-life balance.
We invest in your proactive mindset. Access dedicated professional training and development opportunities, customized to align with your career goals.
Sharpen your cross-cultural communication with our dedicated in-house English tutor.
Influence our growth and culture. Participate in our Referral Bonus program to get rewarded for bringing top talent to the team, and benefit from our Recognition Reward program, which celebrates and rewards your productivity and contributions as a team member.
We recognize that life happens outside of work. Enjoy special perks to celebrate your birthdays, weddings, and the arrival of new family members.
We handle the logistics so you can focus on ownership. Benefit from dedicated invoicing assistance, tech admin support, and proactive People Partnership.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Software Mind develops solutions that make an impact for companies around the globe. Tech giants & unicorns, transformative projects, emerging technologies and limitless opportunities – these are a few words that describe an average day for us. Building cross-functional engineering teams that take ownership and crave more means we’re always on the lookout for talented people who bring passion and creativity to every project. Our culture embraces openness, acts with respect, shows grit & guts and combines employment with enjoyment.

Job Description

Project – the aim you’ll have

You will join our WEBCON practice, a team of developers, analysts and consultants delivering business process automation for clients across financial services, technology and manufacturing. In this role you will work on engagement for one of our clients, taking ownership of solution design, the most complex integrations and technical standards for their WEBCON BPS platform. You will be the technical reference for the client team, with the wider practice as a source of shared knowledge and support.

Position – How You’ll Contribute

Design end-to-end WEBCON BPS solutions: application architecture, process models, data structures and integration approach.
Implement complex processes, business rules and reports in Designer Studio and extend the platform with SDK plugins in C#.
Lead integrations with the client's systems (ERP, DMS, identity, external APIs) and define reusable integration patterns.
Make technical decisions on platform configuration, performance, upgrades and environment setup together with architects.
Review solutions delivered by other developers and enforce good practices and naming, versioning and deployment standards.
Support estimation and scoping of new requirements together with the client and the delivery lead.
Mentor mid-level developers and share knowledge across the team.
Troubleshoot production issues and drive root-cause analysis for critical workflows.

Qualifications

Expectations – the experience you need

Minimum 5 years of commercial experience in software development, including a substantial part on WEBCON BPS.
Proven delivery of at least several WEBCON BPS applications from design through production, including migrations or upgrades.
Advanced WEBCON Designer Studio skills and experience with the WEBCON SDK (C#, .NET).
Strong T-SQL on Microsoft SQL Server, including performance tuning of process-related queries.
Solid JavaScript, HTML and CSS for advanced form customisation.
Very good knowledge of system integration methods (REST, SOAP, authentication mechanisms).
Understanding of business process modelling and the ability to translate business requirements into process design.
Good written and spoken English for client-facing work and documentation.

Additional Skills – The Edge You Have

Experience with Camunda or another BPMN-based process engine, enabling work on hybrid or multi-engine process landscapes.
WEBCON BPS certifications.
Experience with SharePoint, Microsoft 365 and Power Platform integrations.
Experience delivering for financial services or manufacturing clients with formal compliance and audit requirements.
Familiarity with CI/CD or release management for WEBCON environments.

Additional Information

Our Offer – Professional Development, Personal Growth

Flexible employment and remote work
International projects with leading global clients
International business trips
Non-corporate atmosphere
Language classes
Internal & external training
Private healthcare and insurance
Multisport card
Well-being initiatives

jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE Cognism is the leading provider of European B2B data and sales intelligence. Ambitious businesses of every size use our platform to discover, connect, and engage with qualified decision-makers faster and close more deals. Headquartered in London with global offices, Cognism’s contact data and contextual signals are trusted by thousands of revenue teams to eliminate the guesswork from prospecting.
About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer within the Integrations & Enrich domain, you will build the capabilities that connect Cognism with customers' technology ecosystems. Your work will focus on CRM integrations, enrichment workflows, synchronization services and customer-facing data experiences. You will help enterprise customers seamlessly move trusted Cognism data into platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot and other business applications.  

What You'll Do

100% remote work
Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off
A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from
A MacBook set up and ready from day one, plus a $500 stipend to design your ideal workspace
Central European Time (CET) hours to support a balanced schedule for our Poland-based team
Equity in a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier VCs

About The Role

As a Software Engineer II, you bring growing technical depth, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership of features and components across the product. You focus on building scalable, reliable systems, writing well-structured code, and contributing to solutions that deliver real customer value.

focuses on authentication, authorization, and access management, ensuring users can access only the resources and functionality they are permitted to use. One of the team’s key projects involves Keycloak, an open-source Identity and Access Management solution. The API team
owns and improves the backend API layer that powers the Housecall Pro application, with a strong current focus on application performance and creating a fast, reliable user experience.

Design, build, and maintain reliable, performant, and maintainable software systems that deliver real value to users

Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate product goals into technical solutions
