jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Empirical Software Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Position

As agile development scales to larger, more complex organizations, software engineering is being transformed by a set of intertwined changes. Continuous software engineering is converging development and operations to enable frequent releases, while AI is touching every stage of the software lifecycle, bringing agents that work alongside developers. Together, these changes are reshaping team composition and dynamics, as well as enabling shorter feedback loops, while introducing new roles and requiring new skillsets.

The purpose of empirical software engineering research is to study these shifts as they unfold, examining real-world practice to generate knowledge that can guide how teams and organisations build quality software. As a PhD Candidate, you will carry out this work within the Software Engineering group at the Department of Computer Science, one of Norway's leading software engineering environments. The group works closely with industry and publishes at leading international venues.

Your immediate leader will be the head of unit.

Duties of the position

Develop research-based knowledge on continuous software development, grounded in empirical studies.
Carry out empirical studies in Norwegian software companies, with the aim of publishing in recognised journals and conferences.
Responsible for conducting your own studies and for taking part in project teams together with master's students.
Contribute to teaching activities, including lab sessions and supervision
Other career-promoting work agreed with the department, such as work on smaller related research projects or collaboration with organisations in the public and private sectors. Applicants who hold a position outside the university may, by agreement, retain part of that position as career-promoting work.

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required Selection Criteria

You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
You must have a relevant Master’s degree in computer science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
You must master English as a professional language, both written and orally.
You must attach a project outline (1500 words) to your application. It should set out your theoretical and methodological approach to the research topic, together with proposed research questions.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred Selection Criteria

Academically relevant background within software engineering or information systems

Experience from the software industry
Experience with empirical studies and scientific publishing
Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to:

A good team player
A good communicator
Eager to learn
Results-oriented
Work independently

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer

An exciting job with an important mission in society
Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
Working capital that can be used to implement the project
Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary.

The employment period is 4 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work. (A minimum of three work years of the total term period must be dedicated to doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About The Application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note:
the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The Application Must Include

Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
CV
Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages)
Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
Possibly certificates
Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Joakim Klemets (Associate Professor), phone +47 413 51 921, email: joakim.klemets@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR at hr@idi.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10..2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage.

is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. We are the leading academic IT environment in Norway, and offer a wide range of theoretical and applied IT programmes of study at all levels. jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a subject-matter-oriented Solution Architect ready to shape digital transformation in complex environments? Do you enjoy tackling business challenges in an international setting and collaborating closely with customers and fellow experts? Then this role might be just right for you.

Nortal is currently looking for a Solution Architect to join impactful projects with our enterprise customers. In this role, you will collaborate closely with both our customers and internal development teams, focusing on understanding business needs through active stakeholder discussions and shaping them into high-value solution opportunities. You play a key role in engaging with stakeholders, gathering and refining requirements, demonstrating solutions, and proactively identifying how we can best support business goals.

What you will do

Support customers in their digital transformation across areas such as data modelling and architecture, system integrations, platform modernization, and AI-driven solutions.
Engage in regular discussions with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
Translate high-level architectural directions into concrete guidance for development teams.
Own and prioritize the backlog, ensuring alignment between business value and technical feasibility.
Produce documentation, technical diagrams, architectural notes, and decision records.
Work closely with developers to clarify technical implications, even if you don’t write code yourself.
Collaborate closely with Nortal colleagues, including development, project management, and data/architecture experts.

Our tech environment

In this role you don’t need to program hands-on, but a background in software engineering is essential. Technologies in use include Azure (Azure SQL, Functions, Data Lake, Container Apps etc.), MS Fabric, C#, React, and API management.

What will help you to succeed

Ability to understand business needs and ways of working, enabling smooth collaboration.
Solid technical understanding and ability to discuss architectural-level topics such as software and data architectures, integrations, and AI.
A background in software development (hands-on coding experience at some stage).
Ownership mindset and ability to drive initiatives forward.
Consultant-like approach: proactive, solution-oriented, comfortable in the client interface, willingness to ask questions.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English.

If you’re not yet familiar with Nortal, we are a global leader in strategic change and technology. Our 2,500+ employees worldwide share the vision of creating a better future through seamless digital transformation, and we're constantly on the lookout for new talents to join us on this journey. We maintain offices in Helsinki, Oulu, Turku, Jyväskylä, and Uusikaupunki. We highly value flexibility, giving you the option to work from home, your local office, or find a balance that suits your needs.

Why join us?

You’ll play a central role in driving digital transformation for our customers. You’ll gain broad visibility into complex ecosystems—and real ownership of key areas. You’ll work closely with a friendly and experienced team.
We value individuals not just for their skills, but also for their cultural alignment. Our core values include a commitment to delivering value and results, taking ownership, empowering oneself and others, and owning your future and growth. In addition to our professionalism, we appreciate a touch of good humor!
We prioritize your growth and development. At Nortal, we actively support constant improvement and knowledge sharing, both internal and external training opportunities, self-learning, a mentorship program, and strong 1:1 culture.
We prioritize your health and well-being by offering a flexible range of benefits, including adaptable working hours, access to high-quality occupational healthcare, massage services, and bicycle benefit. We are also a remote friendly company.

Salary range: 5200-7800€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, culture or minority group.

Kokemusta backend-kehityksestä Pythonilla
PostgreSQL- ja tietokantapohjaisten sovellusten tuntemusta

jobs.title: AI Developer - Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Tule mukaan Tieto Tech Consulting -tiimiin ja kasva rooliasi laajemmaksi! Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa ja yhteiskunnallisesti merkityksellisissä projekteissa. Kehitämme palveluita, joita todennäköisesti käytät itsekin.

Etsimme AI kehittäjää tiimiimme. Kehitä uraasi ympäristössä, jossa yhdistyvät huipputeknologia, kannustavat kollegat sekä mahdollisuus liikkua joustavasti eri roolien, tiimien ja toimialojen välillä.

Mikä on Tech Consulting?

Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen asiantuntemuksen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen.

Uskomme yhteistyöhön, avoimuuteen ja siihen, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät, kun erilaiset ihmiset ja ideat kohtaavat.

Asiakkainamme on yli 130 organisaatiota eri toimialoilta, kuten julkishallinnosta sekä finanssi-, eläke-, energia-, logistiikka- ja valmistavasta teollisuudesta. Kehitämme digitaalisia palveluja, joilla on todellista vaikutusta ihmisten arkeen ja yhteiskuntaan.

Millaiset tehtävät sinua odottavat?

Etsimme AI kehittäjää, jolla on vahva tekninen osaaminen ja konsultoiva työote. Tässä roolissa osallistut asiakasprojekteihin yhdessä arkkitehtien ja kehittäjien kanssa, suunnittelet AI- ja GenAI-ratkaisuja sekä perustelemaan selkeästi, miksi valitut ratkaisut tukevat parhaiten asiakkaan tavoitteita.

Teknisten keskustelujen vetäminen ja ratkaisujen määrittely asiakkaiden kanssa
Liiketoimintatarpeiden kääntäminen AI käyttötapauksiksi ja selkeiksi ratkaisusuunnitelmiksi
Modernien ja ylläpidettävien sovellusten suunnittelu ja toteutus
AI- / LLM- / GenAI-ratkaisujen rakentaminen ja tuotantoon vieminen (RAG, agentit, työkalukutsut, evaluointiputket)
Skaalautuvien dataputkien suunnittelu sekä MLOps- ja LLMOps-käytäntöjen soveltaminen
Turvallisten, vaatimustenmukaisten ja vastuullisten AI-ratkaisujen varmistaminen
AI-agenttien ja avustajien hyödyntäminen omassa työssä sekä niiden käyttöönoton tukeminen
Kehittäjien mentorointi sekä uudelleenkäytettävien ratkaisujen ja arkkitehtuurien kehittäminen

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Vahvat konsultointi- ja viestintätaidot; kyky perustella valintoja ja ohjata päätöksentekoa
Ohjelmistokehityskokemusta (esim. Python), backend- / API-kehitystä sekä pilvinatiivien arkkitehtuurien tuntemusta (Docker, Kubernetes)
Kokemusta modernien yritystason sovellusten suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta
Käytännön kokemusta AI/ML-kehyksistä ja LLM-alustoista (esim. Azure AI / Azure OpenAI), mukaan lukien mallien käyttöönotto ja optimointi
Ymmärrystä vektorihakutekniikoista, RAG-malleista, evaluointimenetelmistä, prompt engineeringistä ja guardraileista
Kokemusta CI/CD:stä, Infrastructure as Code -ratkaisuista (Terraform / Bicep), havainnoitavuudesta sekä data engineeringin perusteista
Tietämystä turvallisista kehityskäytännöistä, GDPR:stä ja vastuullisesta tekoälystä

jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to develop cutting-edge software applications for our world-leading products? Looking to use and grow your development skills in a fast-paced and creative environment? If this sounds like an exciting challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

About The Job 

Trackman products generate extremely accurate measurements using a patented combination of camera and radar, which provide valuable insights for athletes ranging from top worldclass professionals to enthusiastic amateurs, as well as coaches, scouts, and clubs of all levels.

As part of our company's continued expansion, we are looking for a .NET C# backend developer. You will join a department of 45+ skilled developers, responsible for applications used in golf, baseball, softball and football. You will be part of refinement, planning, implementation, testing and deployment to our customers.

We build applications hosted on distributed Linux servers running Docker, on Microsoft Azure technologies, on mobile devices and customer laptops. You will get to interact with skilled developers working across a range of platforms and apps. We always work with the latest LTS .NET version using C# with web frontends in React. 

As part of our development toolkit, our teams actively use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to speed up coding, testing, and documentation — letting our developers spend more time on solving interesting problems and less on repetitive tasks.

You will join a team of skilled developers who love what they do and, in a role, where you can have a big impact both on what is being built and how it is built. We value having our developers being part of refinement and you will be deeply involved in finding great solutions from a technical as well as a user perspective together with our Head of Products and UI/UX designers.

Job Requirements

Required skills:

3+ years of working with .NET and excellent C# programming skills
Professional usage of an IDE like Visual Studio or Rider
Work in an agile environment with a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and clear communication 
Good understanding of architectural patterns and software design principles 
Good communication skills and a positive and proactive mindset 
Experience with Git  

Additional skills (not required, but nice to have): 

Experience with using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude)
Experience with Docker and Azure Pipelines

All we ask is that you bring passion, curiosity and structure to our workplace. We are a company of many nationalities. Whether you are from abroad or already living in Denmark, we welcome talented people of any gender, nationality and belief. We think the right mix of people makes for the best culture and product. 

At Trackman, we see AI not as a replacement for great developers, but as a tool that makes great developers even more effective — accelerating code reviews, catching bugs earlier, and freeing up time for the creative problem-solving that moves our products forward.

The IT landscape is evolving faster than ever and staying up to date with AI-assisted development is quickly becoming a fundamental part of the software development process.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.title: ED, Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job description:

BUILD MARKETS. SHAPE ECONOMIES.
At SGX Group, we create markets. We turn ideas into products and expand access to new opportunities. We are building the future of the exchange in-house: from architecture and platforms to the critical systems that power markets. The biggest decisions are still open to people who join us now.

The opportunity
The Executive Director, Software Engineering is a seasoned technology leader responsible for shaping SGX’s enterprise software engineering vision, platform strategy, and technical operating model. This role holds broad accountability for engineering excellence across architecture, platform resilience, governance, and leadership capability, ensuring SGX’s technology estate remains secure, scalable, and future-ready. Working across multiple teams and domains, the role translates strategic priorities into modern engineering practices, drives critical technology decisions, raises technical standards, and enables senior engineering leaders to deliver high-performing platforms that strengthen SGX’s long-term competitiveness, innovation, and operational resilience.
This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of software engineering at SGX by influencing enterprise architecture, platform strategy, and the engineering practices that underpin critical market infrastructure. It is suited for a leader who is motivated by building long-term capability, modernising engineering at scale, and leaving a lasting impact on how technology enables business growth, resilience, and innovation.
Beyond immediate leadership accountability, the role provides a compelling career path into broader enterprise technology leadership, with opportunities to deepen influence across strategy, engineering transformation, architecture governance, and organisational capability building. It is an ideal platform for a senior leader seeking to expand enterprise impact, develop the next generation of engineering leadership, and play a defining role in SGX’s technology evolution.

The Software Engineering team
Software Engineering builds, runs and evolves the applications and platforms behind SGX Group's business and market infrastructure.
The team works closely with product, architecture, platform, security and delivery colleagues to turn business priorities into secure, resilient and scalable services. Its remit spans the full engineering lifecycle, from technical design and delivery through to production ownership and continuous improvement.
Our next phase is about strengthening engineering ownership, modernising platforms and practices and building consistency across teams without flattening the different needs of each business domain.

What you will do
Software Development: Define the enterprise engineering vision and drive transformation of the software delivery process across SGX Tech.
Software Design: Shape enterprise-wide software architecture strategy and technology evolution.
Secure Software Development: Define Tech org-wide application security and engineering risk strategy.
Testing & Quality Engineering: Drive Tech org-wide quality transformation and delivery assurance strategy.
System Integration: Define Tech org-wide integration and interoperability strategy.
SDLC & Delivery Excellence: Drive Tech org-wide operational resilience and service reliability direction.
Observability & Production Support: Define organisational service ownership and operational excellence strategy.
Automation & Productivity: Lead organisational productivity strategy and investment priorities, driving productivity transformation through automation and AI.
Leadership & Mentoring: Define engineering culture, workforce strategy and long-term capability development.
Agentic AI Engineering: Reimagine software delivery around AI-native operating models and ecosystem capabilities.
Act as a senior technology leader and trusted partner to business and technology stakeholders, influencing strategic decisions and positioning engineering as a driver of resilience, innovation, and competitive advantage.

What we are looking for
Experience: Extensive experience in senior software engineering, platform engineering or technology leadership roles, with accountability for multiple engineering teams, senior leaders or enterprise platforms in complex, high-availability environments.
Track record: Strong track record of defining enterprise engineering direction and translating strategy into scalable operating models, governance frameworks and long-term platform evolution.
Technical stack: Deep expertise in modern distributed systems including microservices, service mesh and observability platforms, with strong cloud platform knowledge across AWS EKS, Azure AKS and GCP GKE, and advanced knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering practices such as incident management, chaos engineering and capacity planning.
Standards & environment: Track record of improving operational resilience and service maturity across mission-critical, regulated enterprise platforms.
Communication & leadership: Proven ability to lead leaders and scale engineering organisations through mentoring, upskilling strategies and performance frameworks, with strong executive presence and the ability to influence major technology decisions and align engineering outcomes with enterprise priorities.
Education & certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information and Communications Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.
Domain Knowledge: Exposure to financial market infrastructure, including securities and derivatives trading, clearing, settlement, market operations, or exchange-related systems.

Why this role matters
You will work on technology that underpins critical market infrastructure, where engineering decisions have direct consequences for the business, its customers and the markets it serves. Not many engineering roles carry that weight.
The mandate is real. You will shape how platforms are engineered, owned and evolved, and what software engineering becomes at SGX Group. The work is demanding and the organisation is still changing, which is exactly where the opportunity sits. There are not many chances in a career to build something that outlasts you.

About SGX Group
SGX Group is one of the world's most trusted international marketplaces, known for its stability and openness. Anchored in Singapore, we enable price discovery, capital formation and risk management across asset classes, supported by resilient infrastructure and robust clearing. We convene issuers, investors and intermediaries to create and grow markets that stand the test of time. Find out more at www.SGX Group.com.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Site Reliability
jobs.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

At UiPath’s Site Reliability team, we build the platforms and systems that the entire company depends on to deliver on our compliance and SLA promises to customers. This spans monitoring, alerting, cloud infrastructure, access management, standardized synthetics, performance and test validation, incident detection and status reporting, incident management, automated remediation, structured post-mortems, customer communications, repair item tracking, and assertion of engineering best practices across UiPath. We are scaling each of these pillars - and building the next generation of capabilities on each, increasingly powered by AI.

This is a software engineering role.

You will not be the person who identifies a reliability gap and files a ticket for another team to fix. You are the engineer who identifies the gap, designs the system that closes it, builds it, ships it, and drives its adoption - often by doing the integration work yourself rather than asking other teams to come to you. You build platforms that other engineers depend on in their critical path, and you hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not outputs.

You treat every system you ship as a product: you put it in front of users early, seek feedback, and iterate until it delivers real results. If adoption is slow, you don’t blame the docs - you sit with the team, understand the friction, and remove it.

What You'll Do At UiPath

Design, engineer, and build SRE platform systems and capabilities with cutting-edge AI, treating them as products that other engineering teams depend on in their critical path.
Participate in livesite monitoring rotations, handle escalations, and drive effective mitigations - reducing customer impact through broad, detailed, and effective post-mortems.
Drive availability, scalability, and performance improvements based on livesite learnings. Generate (or codify existing) best practices and ensure they are followed widely across UiPath - not by publishing guidance, but by embedding them into the systems you build.
Ensure technical deliverables meet or exceed expectations on reliability, scalability, quality, and performance. Identify and drive architectural changes that significantly move the needle on these dimensions.
Onboard other teams onto your platforms by driving outcomes yourself - writing the integrations, pairing with their engineers, removing friction - rather than handing off documentation and waiting.
Ship early, seek feedback relentlessly, and iterate fast. Treat every user complaint as a design input, not a support ticket.
Drive task planning, estimation, scheduling, and staffing.
Mentor Software Engineers to develop their skills and knowledge through hands-on coaching, advice, and training opportunities.
Participate in and influence process improvements and best practices across the engineering organization.

What You'll Bring To The Team

Proven track record (10+ years) of architecting and engineering world-class, large-scale, distributed commercial applications and services, and ensuring customer success.
Experience building large-scale, complex internal platforms adopted by 10+ teams in their critical path at a large company — systems that have stood the test of time, not prototypes that were handed off or abandoned.
Demonstrated ability to drive adoption of your systems by doing the hard work yourself: writing integrations, removing friction for other teams, and measuring success by outcomes delivered - not features shipped.
Experience building and maintaining complex AI-powered applications in production.
Proficiency in one or more object-oriented languages (such as C#, C++, Java, or Python), backed by solid computer science fundamentals.
Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, multithreading, synchronization, asynchronous patterns, and cloud programming.
Experience with service-oriented and microservice-based architectures, HTTP applications, and web services development.
Familiarity with modern engineering practices including agile development, CI/CD, and DevOps. Ability to work with globally distributed teams.
Experience working with or managing production Kubernetes infrastructure is a plus.
Experience with cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP) and managed services (AKS, GKE, etc.) is a plus.
Experience with database backends (e.g., Azure SQL, CosmosDB, Azure Data Lake, Power BI, MongoDB, MySQL, DynamoDB, etc.).

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

jobs.description:
About us:

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction.

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Rust Developer to join one of our high-growth client teams as a technical lead for their core systems. In an era where performance and memory safety are non-negotiable, you will be responsible for architecting and building low-latency, high-throughput services that serve as the backbone of the client's platform.

You will lead the transition from legacy services to high-performance Rust microservices, leveraging the ownership model to eliminate data races and ensure memory safety. This is a role for a developer who loves "getting close to the metal" while maintaining the productivity of a modern web stack.

What we are looking for:

Professional experience building production-grade applications in Rust. You should have a deep understanding of ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, and the Send/Sync traits.
Strong experience with the Tokio ecosystem and asynchronous programming patterns.
Proficiency with modern Rust web frameworks such as Axum, Actix-web, or Rocket.
Proven ability to design distributed systems using gRPC, Protocol Buffers, and message brokers like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
Advanced knowledge of SQL (PostgreSQL preferred) and experience with asynchronous ORMs or query builders like sqlx or Diesel.
Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker/K8s) and deploying Rust services to cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Experience with profiling tools (e.g., flamegraph, valgrind) to identify and resolve bottlenecks in high-load scenarios.
Strong verbal and written English; comfortable leading technical discussions with cross-functional stakeholders.
Time zone: CET (+/- 3 hours). We are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

Nice-to-Have:

Experience with WebAssembly (Wasm) for edge computing or browser-based logic.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Pulumi).
Familiarity with "Unsafe Rust" and when (and when not) to use it.
Background in low-level systems languages like C or C++.

Responsibilities:

Design and implement highly performant backend services that are robust, maintainable, and type-safe.
Lead the shift toward memory-safe distributed systems, ensuring zero-cost abstractions are utilized effectively.
Conduct rigorous code reviews, emphasizing idiomatic Rust ("Rustacean" style) and safety best practices.
Architect secure and scalable RESTful and gRPC APIs for consumption by frontend and mobile applications.
Maintain high code quality through comprehensive unit, integration, and property-based testing.

What we offer:

Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options.

Predictable project hours

Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients.

Flex days, so you can recharge

Enjoy up to 24 flex days off per year without losing pay, for full-time positions found through Proxify.

Career-accelerating positions at cutting-edge companies

Discover exclusive long-term remote positions at the world's most exciting companies.

Hand-picked opportunities just for you

Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched positions.

One seamless process, multiple opportunities

A one-time contracting process for endless opportunities, with no extra assessments.

Compensation

Enjoy the same pay, every month with positions landed through Proxify.

What Impact will you make?

Are you looking for an opportunity
in Thessaloniki
, that offers you a hybrid working model
?

Are you ready to work on international projects for industry-leading clients
around the world and elevate your tech consulting career
to an international level
?

If so, check below for more info about this career opportunity
!

You bring passion, we bring opportunities!

#YourOpportunity

Deloitte is a worldwide leader in Professional Services with a presence in more than 150 countries and territories. Since 2018, Deloitte has been operating its Alexander Competence Center in Thessaloniki with satellites in the cities of Patras, Heraklion, and Ioannina
- which are model hubs of expertise, training, and innovation, specializing in cutting-edge exponential technologies, in which graduates and young professionals undergo immersive experiences, continuous learning, gaining practical insights and hands-on training that empower them to navigate the complexities of the digital landscape.

Deloitte is an ideal working environment for both young and senior professionals
who want to take the next step in their careers, offering them a supportive and international working environment that leverages their expertise and potential. Its corporate culture is based on trust and collaboration and ensures diversity and inclusion so that everyone feels part of a great team.

#YourServiceLine: Technology & Transformation

Our Technology & Transformation teams empower organizations to navigate the future through technology-driven business transformation. Combining deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge technology, we deliver tailored solutions that drive innovation, enhance efficiency, promote cybersecurity, and foster sustainable growth.

#AboutYourTeam

Deloitte CRM
professionals lead the technological development trend through cutting edge technologies, oriented to the Cloud environment.

We are looking for a CRM Full Stack Developer
in Thessaloniki
. You will have the chance to participate in important international projects, working on the Salesforce platform and its products. You will focus on designing, implementing and delivering complex applications, carrying out actively and responsibly your project-related activities. Acting with progressively increasing autonomy within multi-functional teams, you will be responsible for the quality of your work and its alignment with the clients’ priorities, targets, and needs.

If you want to find out more and go further, within our Division, you will get a chance to express your potential while being supported by training and structured career paths
.

For a full coverage of your role, you ought to be able to:

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable web solutions on Salesforce Platform and other Cloud Applications.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, propose technical solutions, and deliver business-oriented functionalities.
• Ensure code quality through best practices, including code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration.
• Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, sharing ideas and progress clearly.
• Single out possible issues and come up with the ideal solutions and proposals related to the project and swiftly share them with the rest of the team.
• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues efficiently, proposing improvements and optimizations.

#OurRequierements

Key Qualifications

To qualify for the role, you must have:

• Bachelor/master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or in similar technical-scientific disciplines.
• Proven experience (typically 2-5 years) in Object-Oriented programming with languages such as Java, C#, or Python.
• Strong skills in web frontend development (JavaScript, HTML, CSS). Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Node.js) is a plus.
• Solid understanding of relational databases and proficiency in SQL.
• Familiarity with software development best practices, including version control (Git), automated testing, and Agile methodologies.
• English proficiency.
• Proactivity, genuine enthusiasm and curiosity, teamwork attitude.

Bonus Qualifications

• Cloud Computing fundamentals.
• Experience with CRM systems or enterprise software solutions.
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
• System Integrations and Communication Protocols such as HTTP, JSON, API, WS, SOAP, REST, XML.

The profile is rounded up by excellent analytical skills, precision, self-management capacities and a strong goal-oriented inclination.

#WhoWeAreLookingFor

Individuals who have a strong will
to expand their knowledge of new technologies, a passion to grow within the company and aspirations
for career growth. At Deloitte we foster a consultative culture because the best decisions are made in collaboration with others. We approach our work with a collaborative mindset, teaming across businesses, geographies, and skill sets to deliver tangible, measurable, attributable impact. These are not aspirations, but principles that we all commit to today and every day.

#WhatWeOffer

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits:

🏠 Modern hybrid workplace, characterized by flexibility and Smart Working
⚖ Empowered well-being: We provide multiple program offerings to support your well-being needs (flexible working arrangements, extra days of leave, parental allowances)
🌍 Engagement within international large-scale teams and projects, with opportunities to travel for training or client purposes.
📚 Constant opportunities for learning with unlimited access to internal and external learning platforms and sponsored certificates aligned with business needs and technology trends
🚀 Challenging and innovating environment where personal development and growth are encouraged, always with transparency and trust
🌈 Diverse culture and active communities that enable you to bring yourself to work
🎉 Team Building and Corporate Social Responsibility Activities
🏃 A buddy to support you with your onboarding
🌴 Extra days of annual leave
⚕️Private medical health insurance plan
💳 Ticket restaurant card
🏷️Exclusive Discounts to several retail providers, restaurants, and others
📱 Mobile phone
🍏 Fresh fruits and unlimited coffee every day at our offices 

Sounds like the sort of role for you? Apply now.

Location: Thessaloniki

jobs.title: AI Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

Are you ready to shape the future technological landscape in Europe?

We are dedicated to responsible digitalisation, building innovative, inclusive solutions that drive meaningful impact. With over 8,900 professionals across Europe, we help EU institutions, public and private organisations thrive in a rapidly evolving digital world. Are you ready to shape the future through technology? Your journey starts here. Take a look at some of our impactful projects here: https://netcompany.com/cases/

Job Description

So, what are the main responsibilities of the AI Principal Engineer
in Netcompany’s Enterprise Solutions?

Joining us as an AI Principal Engineer
, you will lead the design, delivery, and scaling of advanced GenAI, LLM, and Machine Learning (ML) solutions for enterprise clients across both public and private sectors. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of technical leadership, people management, and client engagement, driving impactful AI initiatives from concept to production.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, translating complex AI capabilities into clear business value, while leading and mentoring a high-performing team of AI/ML engineers. As a Principal (Manager-level role), you will be accountable not only for technical excellence but also for team growth, delivery quality, and client success.

This is a highly client-facing leadership role. Your ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes, align business and technology priorities, and communicate effectively with both technical teams and executive leadership will be key to success. You will represent the AI function in strategic discussions, lead workshops, and shape enterprise AI adoption roadmaps.

You will focus on the architecture and delivery of scalable, production-grade AI systems, ensuring solutions are reusable, extensible, and aligned with best practices, while pushing the boundaries of innovation beyond off-the-shelf tools.

As The AI Principal Engineer, You Will

Serve as the primary AI and ML advisor to enterprise clients, translating business challenges into scalable AI-driven solutions with measurable impact.
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of AI/ML engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.
Drive the end-to-end architecture and delivery of ML and GenAI pipelines, from ideation and prototyping to production deployment.
Collaborate closely with MLOps, DevOps, and data engineering teams to ensure robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
Manage stakeholder relationships across multiple projects, including executive communication, reporting, and risk management.
Lead client workshops, discovery sessions, and technical presentations to define AI strategies and accelerate adoption.
Oversee delivery quality, ensuring solutions meet performance, scalability, security, and governance standards.
Contribute to practice development, including methodology, tooling, reusable assets, and pre-sales activities.

Qualifications

What would make you a fit for the role:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Engineering, Operational Research, or a related field (PhD is a plus).
8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with a strong track record of delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions from concept to production.
Proven experience in a leadership or management role, including team leadership, mentoring, and performance management.
Strong experience in client-facing environments, including leading workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders (C-level, board members).
Deep expertise in Machine Learning and GenAI, including LLMs (e.g., GPT, Claude, Gemini), RAG architectures and prompt engineering, Agentic AI systems and orchestration frameworks.
Solid understanding of MLOps practices, model lifecycle management, and production deployment patterns.
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Hands-on experience with modern AI/ML frameworks and tooling, including open-source ecosystems.

It would also be a plus if you match some of the following:

Experience in consulting, systems integration, or professional services environments.
Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, and LLM monitoring frameworks.
Experience with advanced GenAI frameworks (e.g., LlamaIndex, LangGraph) and evaluation tools.
Exposure to AIOps practices and production AI observability.
Experience supporting pre-sales, proposals, or business development in AI/data domains.

Additional Information

Being a part of the Netcompany team, you will be provided with:

The opportunity to work in a modern environment & in a hybrid working model
A seamless onboarding experience and a buddy to support you on your first steps
A competitive compensation & benefits package
Health and life insurance program
Meal and commuting allowance
Well-being activities (on premises)
Continuous learning opportunities using the most modern methods (unlimited access to Udemy for Business, ad-hoc trainings)
A personalized development plan for targeted career growth

If you are looking forward to be part of a diverse environment, and have the opportunity to work alongside well-experienced professionals, on challenging, large-scale projects that directly impact millions of citizens around the globe, then this is the place to be!

By joining Netcompany in Athens, you will be part of a vivid team of 2,300+ tech professionals. When at the office, you'll have the flexibility to work from our three modern, sustainable, and state-of-the-art offices!

Please upload your CV in English
via the Apply button. All applications will be treated as strictly confidential.

We ensure equal opportunities, treatment, and consideration to all candidates. Discrimination based on sex, racial or ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation or marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other factor protected by applicable laws and regulations is prohibited. As part of the Netcompany culture, we respect human rights and focus on creating a positive workplace, where all employees are valued, and where diversity and inclusion are a vital part of our everyday working experience.

In the following link you may find our CV Submission privacy notice: https://netcompany.com/cv-submission-privacy-notice/

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the role

In this role, you’ll contribute directly to Axon™
, our Digital Twin SaaS platform. We’re looking for Software Engineers who are curious, analytically strong, and excited to grow in an intellectually challenging product environment.

A background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field will provide a strong foundation for success in this role. Beyond that, we value strong reasoning skills, an interest in software development, and the ambition to continuously learn and improve.

You join the backend Analytics team within Product & Engineering: a close‑knit team of 20+ data scientists and engineers working closely with product owners to deliver end‑to‑end platform features.
You help build and evolve the analytical backbone of the Axon platform.
You translate strong abstract and analytical thinking into real‑world software solutions.
You integrate customer data into scalable data models, building complex graph structures, analytical logic, and advanced capabilities for calculations, simulations, and querying.
You know what clean, production‑ready code looks like. You have a strong focus on quality and maintainability.
You build and extend a sophisticated backend, using .NET.
You use AI -curiously and with judgement- to explore design options, write and improve code, validate tests, and speed up repetitive work.
You’ll report to the Lead Software Engineer of Axon technology.

Job Requirements

About you

We value people with a strong technical foundation, a growth mindset, curiosity, and the drive to build solutions that create real impact.

Have a strong analytical and abstract reasoning mindset and enjoy mathematics, complex systems, and intellectual challenges.
Hold a master’s degree in fields such as (Civil) Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, or similar.
Have a strong interest in software development . Prior development experience is a big plus, but not required.
Are curious about how AI is reshaping software development and eager to grow with it.
Enjoy understanding how technical choices connect to real business impact.
Are fluent in Dutch & English.
Feel connected with and are ready to represent our company values: dig deep, own it, come together, move fast and be kind!

Why join us?

Strong onboarding, daily collaboration and coaching by experienced engineers to help you grow fast.
The chance to build a strong foundation for your software engineering career.
Work on one growing SaaS product, instead of jumping from one short project to another.
Build deep product and technical knowledge over time, so you can become an expert faster.
High-impact work on real-life, complex supply chain problems.
An intellectually challenging environment where deep thinking is valued.
AI-enabled development that helps you focus on creativity, problem-solving, and quality.
A fun culture that values ownership, curiosity, kindness, and helping each other succeed.
Flexible working hours and a 50/50 hybrid model from our Mechelen office.
Alongside a competitive salary and bonus, you'll have the choice between a flexible mobility budget or an electric company car with convenient charging facilities.

About us

Start your career shaping the future of supply chains.

Bluecrux is a value chain consulting and technology company, specializing in transformative solutions for today’s complex supply chain landscape. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we’re committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

Axon
helps companies bring scattered supply chain data together in one clear view, so our clients can better understand what is happening, make smarter decisions, and act faster. Our platform is used especially in Life Sciences and Healthcare, where supply chains are highly complex, and decisions can directly impact product launches, availability, and access to medicines. By helping companies see their supply chain more clearly, Axon supports faster product launches, better use of working capital, and more room for investment in research and development.

Axon is also still in a scale-up phase. There is a strong product vision, many new ideas to build, and a lot of product innovation still ahead.

Description

Sr. Systems Developer (Applications Developer- Sr)

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Systems Developer (Applications Developer - Senior)
to join our Health IT team. This role is ideal for a senior-level professional with deep expertise in application development, system architecture, and enterprise content management (ECM) technologies, especially within Department of Defense (DoD) environments. The ideal candidate will bring a solid understanding of the DoDI 5000.02 Agile development process, proven technical acumen, and hands-on experience with implementing large-scale solutions using OpenText Content Suite and related platforms.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain advanced application solutions for Health IT systems in alignment with DoD standards and frameworks.
Lead and participate in the full software development lifecycle using Agile methodologies in accordance with DoDI 5000.02.
Provide technical direction in the development of business processes, automation strategies, and application integration efforts.
Implement and support enterprise content management (ECM) systems, specifically OpenText Content Suite, AppWorks, and Archive Center.
Collaborate with stakeholders to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable and maintainable solutions.
Ensure system integrity, quality assurance, security compliance, and interoperability with other defense health applications.
Mentor junior developers and contribute to best practices for coding, testing, deployment, and documentation.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex system issues and recommend improvements to optimize performance and maintainability.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 10 years of technical experience in Health IT systems and software development.

Required Skills

Demonstrated experience with Department of Defense systems development using the DoDI 5000.02 Agile acquisition lifecycle.
Strong technical expertise in application development and business process automation.
Deep understanding of computer science concepts and techniques, especially for solving engineering, scientific, or data management problems through automation.
Hands-on experience with large-scale ECM implementations, preferably with OpenText Content Suite, AppWorks, and Archive Center.

Desired Skills

Experience working within secure, highly regulated environments (e.g., FedRAMP, DoD RMF).
Familiarity with service-oriented architecture (SOA) and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience in developing custom workflows and forms in ECM platforms.
Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, information assurance, and data governance.
Certifications related to ECM platforms, Agile methodologies, or DoD IT systems (e.g., OpenText certifications, PMP, SAFe, Security+).

Security Clearance

Eligible to obtain a Public Trust Clearance.

More About B&A

Notable Clients

B&A has grown to be a company that is trusted by our clients for exceptional service, innovative solutions, and inspired employees. Our service extends through federal, state, and local Government, the private sector, and higher education. Some of our notable clients include Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, U.S. Senate, U.S. Courts, U.S. Census Bureau, U.S. Navy, and more.

Benefits and Programs

B&A is proud to offer three robust individual and family medical plans to full time employees, including a Health Savings Account (HSA) option as well as two tiers of dental coverage, vision, life & AD&D, disability, accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness insurance. In addition to these benefits, B&A employees enjoy paid time off, B&A sponsored trainings and certifications, pet insurance benefits, commuter transit benefits and a free subscription to a virtual exercise platform (NEOU). B&A’s 401(k) plan is available to all employees and includes a company matching contribution.

B&A has launched several programs to focus on employee engagement, wellness, and assistance. These include:

The B&A Cares program: 30/60/90-day wellness check ins, personal development, financial management, and stress management seminars, and more
A formal mentorship program
Job shadowing and cross training opportunities
Brand Ambassador program
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access to various support resources to include counseling, legal guidance, financial planning, and more
Monthly teambuilding events
B&A Annual Wellness Challenges: #StepWithB&A, #WalkDuringLunchWithB&A, #VolunteeringWithB&A, #ExerciseDuringLunchWithB&A, and more

At B&A, we place significant importance on improving the communities and lives of citizens across the nation through our involvement, technology expertise, and employees. B&A puts an emphasis on charitable efforts in the Northern Virginia area, including Capital Area Food Bank pantry drives, book donations, Hope for Henry Foundation events, and many more. In recognition of all these efforts, B&A has been named a Companies as Responsive Employers (CARE) award recipient by Northern Virginia Family Services and nominated by the Northern Virginia Chamber of Commerce for Outstanding Corporate Citizenship Award.

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location:

Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries

Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.

Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. As a Staff Software Engineer

Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language

A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution

Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

Unser Rocken Partner entwickelt Softwarelösungen für Verwaltungen, Schulen und Archive – massgeschneiderte Standardlösungen, die den Alltag erleichtern und Prozesse durchgängig digitalisieren. Von der Geschäftsverwaltung über Behördenadministration bis zur Archivierung: Hier entstehen integrierte Fachlösungen, die wirklich genutzt werden. Das Unternehmen setzt auf Eigenentwicklung und Innovationskraft – etwa im Bereich künstlicher Intelligenz – und verbindet technologische Weiterentwicklung mit dem Anspruch, zuverlässig und nah am Kunden zu arbeiten. Flache Hierarchien und direkte Kommunikation prägen den Arbeitsalltag. Lust, Verwaltungsprozesse neu zu denken? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung bei unserem Rocken Partner.

Du entwickelst und betreibst die CMI Cloud Plattform für Schweizer Verwaltungen und Schulen

Du verantwortest Cloud-Architektur und Plattformthemen von der Konzeption bis zum produktiven Betrieb

Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch sowie gut Englisch

Homeoffice

Flache Hierarchien
