jobs.description:
About Us

At Nextlane
, we don’t just develop software solutions – we create the future
of the automotive industry.

We are a company that combines advanced technology
with a clear vision: simplifying and digitizing
every step of the automotive customer journey, empowering manufacturers and dealerships to thrive in a constantly evolving market.

We believe in the value of every team member, offering opportunities for you to develop
and contribute to meaningful solutions.

So… What does it mean to be a #Nextlaner?

Be part of a growth-oriented culture.
Collaborate with colleagues from all over the world.
Believe in the Power of ideas and the diversity of thought.
Be committed to provide an environment where you can learn, grow, and collaborate on projects that make a global impact.

Our success is measured not just by results, but also by the growth and satisfaction of those who are part of our company.

At Nextlane, you’ll have the opportunity to innovate
, push boundaries
, and work on solutions that are transforming
the automotive world.

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong expertise in C#/.NET, cloud-native backend development, and API engineering.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building scalable, secure, and maintainable backend services in cloud environments. The engineer will work closely with Tech Leads and cross-functional teams to implement high-quality solutions aligned with established architectural and engineering standards.

This role is not a Tech Lead or Architect position. The expectation is strong technical execution, active contribution to engineering quality, support for architecture compliance, and ownership of backend deliverables.

AI-assisted development practices are a core expectation for this role. Candidates should be comfortable using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code Codex, or similar within their daily engineering workflow.

Your Responsibilities

As a key member of the team, you will be responsible for:

Backend Development

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using C# and .NET Core.
Build secure, scalable, and high-performance REST APIs.
Implement backend solutions aligned with approved architectural patterns and technical guidelines.
Develop services capable of handling high concurrency and production-scale workloads.
Write optimized and maintainable database queries while ensuring data integrity and performance.
Troubleshoot and resolve backend and production issues efficiently.

Code Quality and Best Practices

Write clean, maintainable, testable, and production-ready code.
Apply SOLID principles and safeguard architectural practices such as Clean Architecture, Onion Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
Implement and maintain:
Unit tests
Integration tests
End-to-end tests
Performance/load tests
Participate actively in code reviews and engineering quality initiatives.
Contribute to continuous improvement of development standards, tooling, and workflows.

Collaboration and Agile Development

Work closely with Tech Leads, frontend engineers, QA engineers, and DevOps engineers
Translate technical and business requirements into high-quality implementations.
Support architecture compliance and contribute to solution improvement discussions.
Provide technical guidance and support to less experienced engineers when needed.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and team collaboration activities.

DevOps, Cloud and Architecture

Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Containerize backend services using Docker.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
Support observability and monitoring practices using logging, metrics, and tracing tools.
Follow security, reliability, and operational best practices in backend implementations.

Continuous Improvement

Stay up to date with advancements in backend technologies.
Propose and implement improvements in system architecture and development workflows.

Contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives and technical documentation

What We're Looking For

Experience:
A minimum of 6 years of experience in backend development.
Experience in developing and maintaining scalable backend services.
Experience writing and maintaining unit, integration and performance tests.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude-Code … configuration, rule management and use.
Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Languages: English (Interview will be conducted in English)
Communication: Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
Technical Skills:
Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Core
Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Strong SQL and relational database experience
Good understanding of:
SOLID principles
Design patterns
Clean Architecture
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

Experience with Docker and CI/CD workflows
Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Understanding of scalable backend systems, observability, and reliability practices
AI Engineering
Practical experience using AI coding assistants in day-to-day software development (Cursor/Claude Code/Codex/Github Co-pilot)
Experience configuring or working with AI-assisted engineering workflows
Language Skills
Fluent in English (mandatory).
French language proficiency is a plus.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration int cross-functional teams.
Ability to take ownership and drive initiatives to completion.
Interpersonal Skills: Ability to collaborate in a diverse and dynamic environment.

Our Recruitment Process

15-minute introductory call with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.
Interview with the Hiring Team
Technical Interview

What We Offer

We understand that flexibility and trust
are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

🏡 Remote Work: Up to 3 days a week!
Work-life balance: We have flexible entrance and departure time.
Summer schedule on Fridays: Start early your weekends!
🤝 Referral Bonus: €1500 for every talent you refer (after 6 months).
🍱 Flexible Remuneration: COBEE platform.
⚕️ Private Medical Insurance: Adeslas.
📚 Continuous Learning: Access to our internal platform for continuous development.
🌴 Vacation: 23 vacation days plus an intensive schedule in July and August.
Teambuilding: Our afterworks and activities are memorable!

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

At Nextlane, we are committed to creating a space where everyone feels valued and respected
. We firmly believe that diversity in experiences and backgrounds strengthens our culture and drives innovation.

Support for people with disabilities. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, let us know so we can provide the best possible experience.
Equal opportunities for all: We welcome applications regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Join Nextlane
and become part of the technological revolution in the automotive industry.

Discover why we are a great place to develop your talent!

Desarrollador/a .NET para Automatización Industrial (disponibilidad para viajar)

En Esypro
buscamos incorporar dos Desarrolladores/as Senior .NET
para reforzar nuestro equipo de ingeniería de software industrial.

Participarás en el diseño, desarrollo y puesta en marcha de soluciones software que permiten automatizar y digitalizar procesos productivos y logísticos en empresas líderes del sector de la automoción.

Trabajarás en proyectos innovadores de ámbito nacional e internacional, desarrollando aplicaciones que permiten gestionar, supervisar y optimizar sistemas industriales complejos, acompañando a nuestros clientes desde las fases iniciales de diseño hasta la puesta en marcha y evolución de las soluciones implantadas.

Si disfrutas enfrentándote a retos técnicos, te interesa el entorno industrial y buscas seguir creciendo profesionalmente en proyectos de alto valor tecnológico, queremos conocerte.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Diseñar, desarrollar e implantar soluciones software industriales basadas en tecnologías .NET para automatizar procesos productivos logísticos, integrando sistemas corporativos, PLC, SCADA y MES, y aportando conocimiento técnico y experiencia en todas las fases del ciclo de vida del proyecto.

Contribuirás activamente a la evolución tecnológica de las soluciones, garantizando la calidad, mantenibilidad, seguridad y rendimiento de los desarrollos realizados.

Tus principales responsabilidades

Desarrollo de soluciones software industriales

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones basadas en tecnologías .NET.
Colaborar en el análisis funcional y técnico de los proyectos, definiendo soluciones robustas, escalables y alineadas con las necesidades del cliente.
Desarrollar interfaces y aplicaciones web utilizando tecnologías como HTML5, Bootstrap, JavaScript y Blazor.
Diseñar, optimizar y mantener bases de datos y consultas en SQL Server.
Aplicar principios de desarrollo seguro, buenas prácticas y estándares de calidad de software.
Participar activamente en la implantación y puesta en marcha de sistemas en instalaciones de cliente.

Participación en proyectos industriales

Participar en todas las fases del ciclo de vida de los proyectos, desde la definición de requisitos hasta la puesta en marcha.
Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de ingeniería mecánica, eléctrica y automatización y cliente para garantizar el éxito de las soluciones implantadas.
Realizar el seguimiento técnico de los desarrollos y reportar el avance de las tareas asignadas.
Analizar incidencias, identificar causas raíz y proponer mejoras funcionales y técnicas.

Mejora continua

Colaborar en actividades de mejora continua, evolución tecnológica y optimización de procesos internos.
Aportar visión técnica en la definición de nuevas funcionalidades y mejoras de producto.
Mantenerse actualizado en tecnologías, metodologías y tendencias relacionadas con el desarrollo de software industrial.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos profesionales con experiencia consolidada en desarrollo .NET, capacidad para asumir retos técnicos complejos y motivación por trabajar en proyectos vinculados a la automatización industrial, especialmente en entornos productivos del sector de la automoción.

Valoraremos especialmente:

Capacidad analítica y orientación a la resolución de problemas.
Autonomía y capacidad de toma de decisiones técnicas.
Orientación a la calidad y mejora continua.
Habilidades de trabajo en equipo y colaboración multidisciplinar.
Capacidad para interactuar con clientes y comprender sus necesidades.
Interés por la innovación tecnológica y el entorno industrial.
Experiencia o participación en proyectos de automatización industrial para el sector de la automoción.

Formación

Grado en Ingeniería Electrónica Industrial y Automática.
Grado en Ingeniería Informática.
Técnico/a Superior en Informática.
O formación y experiencia equivalente.

Experiencia y conocimientos

Experiencia mínima de 4 a 10 años en desarrollo de software con tecnologías .NET.
Experiencia sólida en diseño de aplicaciones empresariales y arquitecturas de software.
Dominio de patrones de diseño y buenas prácticas de desarrollo.
Experiencia demostrable con:
.NET
HTML5
Bootstrap
JavaScript
Blazor
SQL Server
Conocimientos de desarrollo seguro y desarrollo orientado a buenas prácticas.
Experiencia trabajando en entornos industriales o proyectos de automatización.
Nivel medio-alto de inglés.
Disponibilidad para desplazamientos nacionales e internacionales asociados a puestas en marcha y soporte a cliente.

Se valorará

Experiencia con ASP.NET Web API.
Conocimientos de GIT y control de versiones.
Experiencia en Windows Forms.
Conocimientos de automatización industrial: TIA PORTAL.
Experiencia en proyectos de logística interna, intralogística o sistemas de control industrial.
Conocimientos de integración de sistemas y comunicaciones industriales.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Contratación estable e incorporación a un proyecto con recorrido profesional.
Plan de formación personalizado desde el primer día.
Desarrollo profesional dentro de un modelo de carrera estructurado.
Jornada laboral de 39 horas semanales.
Flexibilidad horaria para favorecer la conciliación personal y profesional.
Posibilidad de solicitar vacaciones durante todo el año.
Participación en proyectos nacionales e internacionales para clientes de referencia en los sectores industrial, logístico e intralogístico.
Entorno colaborativo, cercano y orientado al aprendizaje continuo.
Integración en un equipo altamente especializado y con gran conocimiento del sector industrial.
Fruta gratuita en la oficina.

Salario bruto anual entre 30.000 € y 42.000 €, en función de la experiencia, conocimientos, nivel de responsabilidad y trayectoria profesional aportada.
Variable vinculado a desplazamientos y puestas en marcha en instalaciones de cliente.
Incorporación estable a un proyecto con alto componente de innovación, crecimiento y especialización.

¿Por qué Esypro?

En Esypro desarrollamos soluciones de automatización, software industrial e intralogística que ayudan a transformar los procesos productivos y logísticos de nuestros clientes. Nuestras soluciones integran sistemas de control, plataformas software y tecnologías de automatización avanzadas para entornos industriales altamente exigentes, especialmente en el sector de la automoción.

Tendrás la oportunidad de participar en proyectos reales con impacto directo en la operativa de nuestros clientes, colaborar con profesionales altamente especializados y seguir evolucionando técnica y profesionalmente en un entorno donde la innovación forma parte del día a día.

Si te apasiona el desarrollo de software, disfrutas resolviendo retos complejos y buscas dar un paso más en tu carrera dentro del ámbito industrial, nos encantará conocerte.

Esypro mantiene un firme compromiso con la igualdad de oportunidades, la diversidad y la no discriminación en todos sus procesos de selección, garantizando la valoración de las candidaturas exclusivamente en función de criterios profesionales, competencias y experiencia.

Backend Developer – Global Customized Solutions

Build the integrations that make complex access solutions work.

What happens when a customer needs SKIDATA products to work with a system they already rely on? That’s where you come in.

As a Backend Developer
, you’ll design and build tailored software integrations that connect third-party systems with SKIDATA products. You’ll solve varied technical challenges, work with integration partners and turn specific customer requirements into working solutions.

Why this role matters

Access solutions need to work seamlessly with the wider systems customers depend on. Your work will help turn specific customer requirements into reliable solutions, extending the flexibility and reach of SKIDATA products across different markets and real-world environments.

The role

You’ll take ownership of your own projects, from design and implementation through testing and documentation, while working as part of the global GCS team. Alongside your development work, you’ll support colleagues across regions and contribute to shared coding, architecture and engineering practices.

What You’ll Work On

Build custom integrations — design, develop, test and document backend solutions connecting third-party systems with SKIDATA products.
Develop in C#/.NET — build reliable solutions primarily using .NET.
Work with APIs and interfaces — develop and integrate solutions using technologies such as REST, SOAP, gRPC, RMQ and sockets.
Support integration partners — provide integration support for public interfaces and help third-party companies connect with SKIDATA systems.
Contribute to engineering practices — support the implementation of coding standards, architecture guidelines and reusable frameworks, and contribute to practices such as CI/CD and AI-assisted development.
Support colleagues across regions — assist regional developers and contribute to code reviews, technical mentoring and consistent quality.

What Will Help You Succeed

Backend development experience — around 3–5 years of software development experience, with solid hands-on skills in C#/.NET.
Integration experience — familiarity with APIs and system interfaces such as REST, SOAP, gRPC, RMQ or sockets.
Software development foundation — experience with databases and software design, with exposure to Java or web technologies such as JavaScript/TypeScript being a plus.
Modern development practices — familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps, an understanding of secure coding, and familiarity with AI-assisted development tools.
Collaborative approach — self-organised, analytical and comfortable working with colleagues across different regions and cultures.

Fluent English and Spanish is required. German would be a plus.

Why SKIDATA

At SKIDATA, you’ll work on technology that connects access solutions with the wider systems customers rely on, while having the autonomy to own your work and collaborate with colleagues across borders.

Meaningful impact — Build integrations that help SKIDATA access solutions work seamlessly with the systems customers and partners depend on.
Innovation & scale — Work with modern backend technologies, APIs and integration solutions as part of a global organisation.
Autonomy & trust — Take ownership of your projects from design through delivery, with the freedom to shape solutions and solve problems in your own way.
Growth & development — Broaden your technical experience through varied projects, different technologies and collaboration with colleagues across regions.
Work–life balance — Benefit from a flexible hybrid working model in Madrid that supports a sustainable way of working.

Ready to build what connects it all?

If you’re a backend developer who enjoys solving integration challenges and turning customer requirements into working solutions, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply today and help build the connections that make SKIDATA’s access solutions work in the real world.

We review applications continuously and will be moving forward with suitable candidates throughout the process. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner.

Innovative solutions at the cutting edge, a dynamic and forward-thinking work environment, and diverse opportunities – welcome to the world of SKIDATA. Join our strong, international team now and help shape the future of modern access solutions with your creativity and expertise. When you join our SKIDATA team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 62,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries.

to join our Playgami team in Barcelona on a hybrid basis!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to encourage play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.

Playgami is building the best SaaS gaming platform ever! The team strives to build the world’s best products for game production, operation, and insights. Powering many award-winning, loved-by-millions franchise games over mobile, web, and PC.

Always looking further to keep improving your skills

You are not senior? Go for it and apply, we are seeking talented and driven engineers at all levels, from junior on up!

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Join Liebherr, a global leader in engineering and manufacturing, as we advance our digital transformation journey. We are looking for a motivated
Integrations & Data Migration Architect - Microsoft Dynamics CRM (m/f/d)
to play a key role in our newly established IT Shared Service Center in Madrid.
In this role, you will own and shape the integration and data migration architecture for Liebherr's global CRM solution (OneCRM), supporting its deployment across our international Sales and Service Companies. You will ensure reliable and scalable data flows between Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, master data management solutions, central data platforms, customer systems, and other enterprise applications.
You will define and govern the end-to-end approach for data migration across global rollout waves, from source data analysis and mapping through cleansing, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and final migration. Combining architectural ownership with hands-on technical expertise, you will help ensure high levels of data quality, integrity, and operational reliability. You will be part of an international, cross-functional team that values innovation, methodology, and long-term thinking, making a direct impact on the way Liebherr serves its customers worldwide.
The working location for this position will be in Madrid city, where we operate a hybrid model, requiring at least 40% of working time spent on-site on a weekly basis.

Own the end-to-end integration and data migration architecture for Liebherr's global Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solution.
Define and govern integration patterns and data flows between Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, master data management solutions, central data platforms, customer systems, and other enterprise applications.
Define and drive the data migration approach for global CRM rollouts, including source analysis, data mapping, transformation, cleansing, enrichment, validation, reconciliation, and loading.
Establish reusable migration standards, tools, and templates to enable consistent and industrialized global deployments.
Define data synchronization and master data exchange mechanisms, ensuring reliable and maintainable data flows.
Coordinate data cleansing and migration readiness with business stakeholders, data owners, and rollout teams.
Maintain transparency of critical data flows, system dependencies, data ownership, and system responsibilities across the OneCRM landscape.
Provide technical leadership to Dynamics and integration developers, implementation partners, and other technical teams.
Maintain architecture and technical documentation for integrations, data models, mappings, and migration concepts using tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Travel (up to 30%) to Liebherr sites worldwide to support architecture, migration, and rollout activities.

Contributing your strengths: your qualifications

7+ years of professional experience in enterprise application integration, data architecture, data migration, or related technical roles within complex IT landscapes.
Proven experience designing and executing large-scale data migrations and enterprise system integrations, ideally within international transformation or rollout programs.
Strong experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Dataverse, including a solid understanding of data structures and integration capabilities.
Deep understanding of data mapping, transformation, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, synchronization, and master data management principles.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Azure integration technologies, APIs, event-driven integration, and enterprise integration architecture patterns.
Experience with SQL and relevant tools and technologies for data analysis, transformation, migration, integration, and validation.
Strong architectural and analytical capabilities, with the ability to understand complex multi-system landscapes and translate them into scalable and maintainable data flows.
Ability to combine architectural thinking with hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and technical problem-solving, with a strong focus on data quality and reliability.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical teams, business stakeholders, data owners, external partners, and international organizations.
Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages (e.g., German or Spanish) and relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, or integration architecture certifications are considered a strong advantage.

As an internationally successful family business, the Liebherr Group offers you a secure job, a unique variety of tasks and exciting development opportunities. Become part of our strong team today and get to know the Liebherr Group as a reliable partner. Profit from these benefits:

Continuous learning and development with tailored training and certification opportunities

A safe, stable and international workplace within a trusted family business that invests in people

Please note that we do not accept applications via recruitment agencies for this position.

Liebherr is a family-run technology company that is not only one of the largest construction machinery manufacturers in the world, but also offers high-quality, user-oriented products and services in many other areas. Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.

We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. Strong technical foundation in AWS, .NET, Python, and MongoDB.
Obsessed with delivery: you ship, you improve, you own the outcome.

Build your future with Sovos.

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionising how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway. We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do

At Sovos, our Core Platform and AI Platform
are the foundation that dozens of engineering teams build on. We're seeking a Fullstack Senior Engineer
who will design, build, and operate the platform services that power that foundation — services that are reliable, well-documented, and adoptable at scale.

This is a builder role at the center of the Sovos platform strategy. You'll work closely with the Platform Adoption
team to understand how teams are using what you build, close feedback loops quickly, and ensure that what ships is something the broader engineering organization can confidently rely on.

The Fullstack Senior Engineer
will own the design and delivery of platform services that span the Sovos portfolio — from identity and administration to AI capabilities and shared infrastructure
. Your work directly determines what other teams can build and how fast they can build it
.

More Specifically You Will

Building Platform Services That Scale Across the Portfolio

You'll design and deliver the Core Platform and AI Platform services that product teams depend on — things like identity, shared admin experiences, design system components, and AI infrastructure. Adoptability is a first-class requirement: services need to be well-designed, well-documented, and easy to integrate correctly.

Design and implement platform services with clear contracts, versioning strategies, and backward compatibility in mind
Build with adoption as a first-class concern — prioritize APIs, SDKs, and interfaces that are intuitive for consuming teams
Contribute to Core Platform components including identity, Sovos Admin, Mosaic design system, and Sovos Home
Build and maintain AI Platform infrastructure including tooling, integrations, and agentic service components
Establish engineering standards, patterns, and guardrails that make the right way the easy way for consuming teams

Partnering Closely with the Platform Adoption Team

You'll work together with the Senior Developers on the Platform Adoption team who are embedded with consuming teams.

Treat adoption friction as a product defect - actively seek feedback from the Adoption team and act on it
Collaborate on Skills and integration guidance to ensure what gets taught matches what's built
Participate in onboarding sessions, design reviews, and pairing with consuming teams when platform depth is needed
Provide timely support and clear escalation paths for teams hitting blockers in platform integration

Owning Quality, Reliability, and the Path to Production

Platform services are only as good as their uptime, and the confidence teams have in them. You'll lead testing strategies, participate in deployment planning, and take ownership of the operational quality of what you build — because what you ship is someone else's critical path.

Author and maintain comprehensive test plans — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end — for platform services
Own the deployment lifecycle for platform components from development through staging to production
Establish observability practices (logging, metrics, alerting) so platform health is visible and actionable
Contribute to security and compliance reviews for platform services, particularly those touching identity and data
Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response for platform-level issues

What We Need From You

7+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time building shared services, platforms, or infrastructure consumed by other engineering teams
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React for frontend platform components; experience with backend services in Java, .NET, or Node.js
Experience designing APIs, SDKs, or component libraries with developer experience as a primary consideration
Familiarity with identity and authentication patterns (OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SSO) is a strong plus
Experience or genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling, agentic frameworks, and integrating LLM-based capabilities into platform services
Strong instincts for testing strategy - you write tests because you care about what happens after you ship, not because someone asked you to
Excellent communication skills: you can explain platform design decisions and trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders
A collaborative mindset - you view the teams building on your platform as customers, not consumers

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life – because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

An opportunity to work with a global team
Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
Mentoring Programs
Globally recognised Training and Development programs

jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

Flix is reshaping how customers get help, moving towards AI-driven resolution across every channel, language, and market. As a Process Intelligence & Automation Engineer(m/f/d)
, you turn that ambition into running systems: you design and deliver end-to-end automated processes on the Celonis platform that resolve real customer cases without human intervention, for millions of passengers.

You bring engineering rigour into a business team. You translate business requirements into data models, pipelines, and automations fast, you own what you ship in production, and you are comfortable being the most technical person in the room.

About The Role

Data integration and modelling: identify the source-system tables and fields that need to be brought into Celonis; build and maintain the extractions, transformations (ETL) and Celonis data models for each Customer Service process, spanning ticketing, order management, and payment/refund data.
Automation development: design, build, and operate production automations on the Celonis platform (Action Flows and Process Orchestrator) that execute real customer outcomes (e.g. end-to-end refund handling), including API calls into Flix backend systems and integrations with AI-driven customer contact channels (chatbot, voicebot).
Reliability and guardrails: your automations move real money; build for scalability, error handling, monitoring, auditability, and safe rollout of changes.
Insourcing and takeover: take over data models and automation logic built by an external implementation partner (reverse-engineer, document, harden, and extend them as the in-house owner).
Collaboration: work daily with business users who own rules and business logic, the Data Analyst who owns dashboards and process mining, and IT engineering who own system integrations, security, and scalability.
Documentation: document all technical and data requirements and all ETL and automation work to Centre of Excellence standards, so nothing you build depends on you being in the room.

About You

Automation platform experience: 3+ years hands-on building production automations on process orchestration or automation platforms; Celonis is a strong plus (Data Integration, PQL, Knowledge Models, Action Flows, Process Orchestrator); strong experience with platforms such as n8n, Camunda, UiPath, Power Automate, or Make is also relevant. We care about proven end-to-end delivery, not certifications.
Production ownership at scale: you have owned and shipped solutions handling transactions at scale (1M+ annually) and can talk concretely about what broke and how you fixed it.
Data fundamentals: working SQL and data modelling basics; you understand how to identify a correct case ID, control grain in joins, and validate a data model against its sources. Scripting (Python or similar) is a plus but not required (you are comfortable using AI tooling to fill gaps here).
Enterprise systems and integration literacy: solid understanding of how core operational systems work — CRM, ticketing, order management, and ERP — including their data structures, process flows, and the business logic they enforce. Equally, you are fluent in how these systems integrate: REST and SOAP APIs, authentication mechanisms, webhooks, rate limits, and data exchange formats (JSON, XML). You can independently read API documentation, navigate integration patterns, and reason about data flow across system boundaries.
Hybrid profile: you thrive in a roughly 70/30 technical-business role: you sit inside the business, gather requirements yourself, and can explain and defend technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
Communication: clear written documentation and communication in English; you leave behind artefacts other people can pick up.
Conversational automation experience: hands-on experience connecting automated workflows to chatbot or voicebot platforms is a plus.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer

Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

The role combines technical discovery, architecture, prototyping, estimation and client presentation. The successful candidate must be able to move comfortably from an executive use-case discussion to building and demonstrating a working solution on the Microsoft AI stack.

Please note, this role is open to candidates based in both the UAE and India locations.

Key responsibilities

• Lead technical discovery with client business, data, security and technology stakeholders; convert business priorities into qualified AI use cases, solution requirements and a practical delivery approach.
• Design secure, scalable enterprise architectures for generative AI, agentic AI, conversational AI, intelligent search, document intelligence and AI-enabled applications using the Microsoft cloud stack.
• Build working demonstrations, accelerators and proof-of-concepts using production-relevant patterns not only mock-ups to validate feasibility, user experience, integration and expected value.
• Own the technical workstream of RFPs, RFIs and proposals, including architecture, solution narrative, scope, assumptions, dependencies, non-functional requirements, effort estimates, bill of materials and delivery risks.
• Define RAG, grounding, tool-use, memory, orchestration, evaluation, observability and human-in-the-loop patterns appropriate to each use case.
• Assess model and platform choices across quality, latency, throughput, security, data residency, responsible AI and cost; explain the trade-offs clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
• Present solutions in workshops, solution reviews, demonstrations and bid presentations; respond credibly to detailed questions from enterprise architecture, cybersecurity and procurement teams.
• Work with account, industry and delivery teams to shape opportunities, identify reusable assets and position differentiators without overcommitting scope or capability.
• Support technical due diligence, implementation planning and handover after award, ensuring that proposal commitments are understood, feasible and traceable into delivery.
• Maintain current knowledge of Microsoft AI services, reference architectures, licensing and emerging agentic patterns, and turn that knowledge into reusable pre-sales assets.

Required experience and capabilities

• 10+ years of professional experience across software engineering, cloud architecture, AI/ML engineering or enterprise solution consulting.
• At least 5 years of hands-on experience specifically designing and building generative AI solutions using large language models, including enterprise RAG and/or AI agents.
• Demonstrable experience delivering AI or advanced analytics solutions beyond proof-of-concept stage, with a strong understanding of production engineering, security, monitoring and operational support.
• Strong hands-on development capability in Python and APIs/SDKs; experience with C#/.NET is advantageous.
• Deep understanding of LLM application patterns: prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, tool/function calling, structured outputs, agent orchestration, evaluation and guardrails.
• Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, document repositories and identity platforms.
• Strong knowledge of cloud security, Entra ID, managed identities, private networking, secrets management, role-based access control, data privacy and responsible AI controls.

• Ability to produce clear architecture diagrams, sequence flows, assumptions, sizing models and implementation plans under bid deadlines.
• Excellent written and verbal English; able to challenge requirements constructively and communicate complex concepts without unnecessary jargon.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in regulated or government environments, including security review, data residency and private-cloud/hybrid integration requirements.
• Experience estimating Azure AI consumption, model throughput/capacity, search capacity, infrastructure and licensing for commercial proposals.
• Experience creating reusable accelerators, reference architectures or demo environments for an AI consulting or technology pre-sales organisation.

Jouw Functie Als Integratie Engineer

Onder het label Integratie zit een breed pallet aan werkzaamheden. In het ene traject ben je samen met je collega’s bezig om het nieuwe integratie landschap vorm te geven, terwijl je bij de andere klant je tanden zet in het omzetten van een niet-gedocumenteerd stuk oude software naar moderne integraties. Het fijne is dat je bij ilionx veel invloed hebt op de trajecten waar je in zit. Sommige collega’s werken graag op meerdere opdrachten tegelijk, terwijl anderen al jaren met veel plezier één en dezelfde klant bedienen. Wat vast staat is dat je werkt aan uitdagende en uiteenlopende projecten. Dit doe je in house, vanuit huis of gezellig bij de klant. Als Integratie/API Specialist loop je voorop in de technische ontwikkelingen die je toepast in nieuwe en bestaande software. Zo werk je veelal met de technologie van Red Hat, TIBCO of MuleSoft op het gebied van integratie, API’s, events, microservices en cloud. Je bent echter zeker niet beperkt tot deze technologieën. Andere specifieke kennis of ideeën zijn bij ons van harte welkom!

Een scherpe, analytische en creatieve blik

Vasthoudendheid bij het omzetten van vragen naar werkende oplossingen
Dat je een leuke, slimme, hardwerkende collega bent
Je bent klant- en resultaatgericht
Je schrijft en spreekt de Nederlandse taal vloeiend

Een afgeronde hbo of wo opleiding, of autodidact met de juiste werkervaring
Goede zelfkennis, weten wat je kunt en vooral ook wat je niet kunt
Sterke affiniteit met techniek
Analytisch denkvermogen
Kritisch op kwaliteit, maar waar nodig pragmatisch
Goede communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden, we praten graag

Bovenstaande criteria zijn een indicatie van het profiel dat we zoeken. We beseffen dat elk individu een unieke set aan vaardigheden, expertise, skills en denkwijzen met zich meebrengt. Na jouw inwerkperiode word je o.a. verantwoordelijk voor de volgende taken:

Het beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande engineering- en automatiseringssystemen, zoals Autodesk Vault, Autodesk Inventor en het ERP-systeem Ridder iQ.

Het automatiseren van terugkerende werkzaamheden en het optimaliseren van data-, document- en versiebeheer.
Het ondersteunen van gebruikers bij technische vraagstukken en het oplossen van verstoringen binnen de systemen.
Het opstellen en onderhouden van technische documentatie en werkinstructies.
Het delen van kennis, begeleiden van gebruikers en ondersteunen bij de implementatie van nieuwe functionaliteiten.
Het volgen van technologische ontwikkelingen en deze waar mogelijk vertalen naar praktische toepassingen binnen de organisatie.

Jouw achtergrond

Je bent analytisch en communicatief sterk en vindt het fijn om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken. Je hebt kennis van engineeringdatabeheer en hebt ervaring met het automatiseren van technische processen. Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in de volgende zaken:

Ervaring met RidderIQ, Autodesk Inventor, Autodesk Vault en/of machinebouw is een pré;
Beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Werken bij Innovatec betekent werken met plezier en passie. Door de ruimte te krijgen om zelf met ideeën te komen en ze uit te voeren, halen we het beste naar boven in onze mensen.

Everyone's story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces - designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don't have to worry about it.

And there's more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Backend Engineer specializing in C#/.NET to join our dynamic team at Riverty's Berlin location, with hybrid working arrangements available. In this role, you will be instrumental in developing innovative financial technology solutions that empower consumers and merchants alike. Our solutions facilitate flexible, customer-centric payment options, allowing consumers to choose their preferred payment methods while ensuring a predictable cash flow for merchants. As part of a fast-growing product and technology organization, you will have the opportunity to influence the development of new teams and contribute to the creation of revolutionary products that shape the future of FinTech.

You will be integrated into one of our product teams, collaborating closely with cross-functional members to design, develop, test, and deploy robust software applications, APIs, and workflows. Your contributions will directly impact the scalability, security, and efficiency of our payment solutions, supporting our mission to deliver human-centric and sustainable financial services backed by significant investments. This position offers a unique chance to be at the forefront of technological innovation within a fast-paced, evolving industry.

Qualifications

What you bring:

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in software development.
Proven expertise in developing, deploying, and maintaining cloud-based applications, preferably in Azure.
Strong knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed systems design.
Deep understanding of RESTful API design and implementation.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer / Architect (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
Wir sind die byteAgenten. Seit 2008 lösen wir gewachsene Altsysteme ab und bauen datensouveräne Individualsoftware – performant, wartbar und mit herausragender Usability. Aber die Welt der Software-Entwicklung dreht sich weiter – und wir drehen uns mit.

Wir suchen erfahrene Entwickler mit tiefer technischer Expertise, die auf der neuen Abstraktionsebene arbeiten wollen: über das Ergebnis entscheiden Anforderungen und Architektur, die Implementierung beschleunigt KI. Unser Fokus ist die Ablösung von Altsystemen in Industrie und Mittelstand: KI-gestützte Rekonstruktion der Fachlogik, moderne Architekturen, Datenmigration und Betrieb in der EU oder on-premises. Dazu gehört für uns auch die Beratung des Kunden, nicht nur die Umsetzung.

Bist du bereit, nicht nur User Stories umzusetzen, sondern Projekte aktiv zu gestalten? Bei uns arbeitest du in Projekten an der Schnittstelle von High-Performance-Architektur, KI-gestützter Effizienz mit eigenem AI-Dev Harness und echter Kundenberatung. Als Teil unseres festen Teams in Deutschland oder Österreich genießt du große Freiheiten, kombiniert mit dem Rückhalt aller byteAgenten.

Deine Mission

Du gestaltest nicht nur Software, sondern wirkst im gesamten Entstehungsprozess mit, vom Legacy-Check und ersten Requirements-Workshop bis zur Abschaltung des Altsystems.
Du nutzt deine Erfahrung, KI und moderne Tools nicht nur als Mittel zum Zweck, sondern als Multiplikator für Kundenprojekte und steigerst damit die Qualität deiner Lösungen. Unser AI-Dev Harness gibt dir dafür den Rahmen: definierte Arbeitsschritte, wiederholte Prüfschleifen gegen Code, Daten und Tests sowie feste Kontrollpunkte mit deiner Freigabe.
Du berätst unsere Kunden auf Augenhöhe, verstehst deren Business-Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in eine solide Systemarchitektur.
Du bist Teamplayer. Du weißt, welche Aufgaben du an Junior-Developer delegieren kannst, was du automatisiert löst und wo dein Deep-Dive als Experte gefragt ist.
Du evaluierst neue Technologien und prägst die technologische Roadmap der byteAgenten aktiv mit.

Dein Agenten-Leben

Wir bieten dir große persönliche Flexibilität im Rahmen einer Festanstellung. Abhängig vom Projekt genießt du Autonomie bei Arbeitsort und Zeiteinteilung – bei uns zählt das Ergebnis und die Qualität. Wir vertrauen darauf, dass du weißt, wie du dich am besten organisierst.
Im Grunde wählst du deine Werkzeuge selbst (z. B. Mac/Win), je nach Kunde nutzt du die Tools, welche für die Rahmenbedingungen am besten passen.
Neben Schulungen und Zertifizierungen bieten wir dir den Freiraum, dich zum Tech-Consultant oder Leader weiterzuentwickeln. Dein jährliches „Build your own Company“-Gespräch ist dein Hebel für Veränderungen.
Wir leben flache Hierarchien und ein familiäres Miteinander. Bei uns gibt es kein Micromanagement – Vertrauen ist unser wichtigstes Asset.
Unsere Benefits: Fitness Studio im Bürogebäude, Job-Rad oder Firmenwagen, Deutschlandticket und eine Spendit Card.

Deine Must-haves:

Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Informatik, Ingenieurwesen) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Viel wichtiger ist uns jedoch deine mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Realisierung komplexer Enterprise-Software-Projekte und in der Arbeit mit gewachsenen Bestandssystemen sowie dein sicheres Gespür für Machbarkeit und den damit verbundenen Aufwand.
Du beherrschst moderne Technologien wie Java / Spring Boot, .NET / C# oder TypeScript / Node im Backend sowie Angular, React oder Vue.js im Frontend. Clean Code, Architektur- und Designpatterns nutzt du instinktiv, um wartbaren und skalierbaren Code zu produzieren.
Du nimmst Anforderungen nicht nur entgegen, sondern hinterfragst sie kritisch. Du erkennst Feature Creep frühzeitig und kannst technische Entscheidungen souverän moderieren sowie in verständlichen Roadmaps für das Management aufbereiten.

Deine Nice-to und Want-to-haves:

Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude Code, GitHub Copilot oder andere Modelle, um Entwicklungszeiten zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig die Code-Qualität durch automatisierte Reviews und Tests zu steigern.
Du entwirfst skalierbare Software-Architekturen und bist sicher im Umgang mit Cloud-Ökosystemen (AWS, Azure oder GCP) ebenso wie mit On-Premises-Betrieb, Containerisierung (Docker, Kubernetes) und modernen CI/CD-Pipelines.
Du verstehst Application Security als Kernanforderung. Du kennst die OWASP Top 10, implementierst sichere Authentifizierung (OAuth2, OIDC) und achtest auf Schwachstellenprävention.
Du handelst wie ein „Unternehmer im Unternehmen“. Du hast den Blick für die Wirtschaftlichkeit technischer Entscheidungen, erkennst Potenziale für Prozessoptimierungen und treibst Themen proaktiv voran.
Du liebst es, Verantwortung für Ergebnisse zu tragen. Du strukturierst Aufgaben effizient und delegierst sie gezielt an Junior-Developer oder KI-Assistenten, während du die technologischen Leitplanken sicherstellst.
Du berätst unsere Kunden sicher auf Deutsch (C1/C2) und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

Jahresgehalt 70K€ bis 90K€

Wir wissen, dass du den einen oder anderen Skill nicht mitbringst. Aber wenn dich die Rolle reizt, und du dich weiterentwickeln möchtest, schick uns deinen LinkedIn-Link oder einen Lebenslauf. Wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich für ein erstes Online-Kennenlernen. In einem zweiten Gespräch testen wir dein fachliches Know-how und entscheiden ob und wie es weiter geht. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

new_jobs.title: Senior Integration and Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
Location: Bristol or Manchester hybrid (regular travel to partner sites across the UK and Ireland as needed)

Role Type: Permanent (full-time preferred, flexible working considered)

About PACT Solutions:

PACT Solutions is a specialist management and digital transformation consultancy working exclusively with higher education institutions across the UK. 

We help universities solve complex challenges across strategy, student records, data, change and delivery. Our work often sits at the heart of major institutional transformation, helping partners improve the student journey, modernise operations and deliver change more effectively. 

PACT has grown quickly and is now entering its next phase. We are moving from a founder-led boutique consultancy into a more scaled and structured business, while protecting the quality, culture and partner focus that have made us successful. 

Our culture is crucial to our success. Each day, our team significantly contributes to our business and that of our partners.  

We combine the agility and collaborative spirit of a close-knit consultancy with the credibility, structure, and professionalism needed to deliver meaningful digital transformation. 

Our values sit at the heart of everything we do and are core to our business. 

Partnership: We work with you, not for you. 

Integrity: We do the right thing, even when it requires difficult conversations.  

Curiosity: We dig deeper to uncover what will truly deliver value.  

Transformation: We focus on outcomes that create lasting, measurable improvement.  

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Integration and Solution Architect to own the architecture of data integration solutions across our higher education partners. You will define the integration framework: the principles, patterns, standards and technical decisions that determine what is built and how it is built.

This is an architecture role, not a day-to-day delivery management role. Working alongside colleagues who lead programme and technical delivery, you will provide the architectural direction and assurance that enable secure, resilient and maintainable integrations across complex transformation programmes.

You will combine strong consulting skills with practical experience of Azure Integration Services and software engineering. You will shape target-state architectures, guide solution design and support teams to apply consistent, reusable approaches.

Purpose of the role

To support the delivery of effective, practical and people-centred change activity that helps PACT's partners adopt new systems, processes and ways of working successfully.

Key Responsibilities

Integration and solution architecture
Own the integration architecture for assigned partner programmes and shape the target-state integration landscape.
Define and evolve integration principles, reference architectures, patterns, standards and reusable components.
Translate business, data and operational requirements into clear solution architectures, design decisions and technical roadmaps.
Set the approach to API design, data contracts, message design, asynchronous processing, error handling, security, observability and resilience.
Assess architectural options and technical trade-offs, providing clear recommendations to partners and delivery teams.
Solution design and technical assurance
Design practical, scalable and maintainable integrations using Azure Integration Services, including Azure Service Bus, APIs and related Azure services.
Provide architectural assurance at key design, build, test and deployment points, ensuring solutions conform to agreed standards.
Review technical designs, code and documentation to improve consistency, quality and long-term supportability.
Support the resolution of complex integration issues and design risks, focusing on root cause and sustainable architectural outcomes.
Stakeholder and consulting leadership
Lead architecture workshops, discovery sessions and design forums with senior business and technical stakeholders.
Build trusted relationships with stakeholders up to Head of Service and senior manager level.
Explain complex technical concepts in clear business language and challenge constructively where decisions create avoidable risk or compromise.
Work closely with programme, product, data and technical delivery colleagues so architectural decisions are understood and actionable.
Capability development
Develop PACT's integration framework, methodologies, standards, reusable assets and propositions.
Coach consultants and engineers in sound integration design and engineering practice.
Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and the continued development of PACT's Data Integration capability.

What we offer

The opportunity to shape integration architecture across major higher education transformation programmes.
Work with Azure Integration Services, Azure Service Bus, Python and .NET in complex enterprise environments.
Development of consulting, architecture and technical capability.
A clear progression path through PACT's consulting career pathway, including Principal-level opportunities.
The opportunity to shape PACT's Data Integration capability.

This role sits at the Senior Consultant within PACT's consulting career pathway (Analyst → Consultant → Senior Consultant → Lead → Principal), providing a strong foundation to develop core consulting and delivery skills.

Requirements

Essential experience

Significant experience as an Integration Architect, Solution Architect or similar senior architecture role in complex enterprise environments.
Strong integration architecture capability, including API design, messaging patterns, asynchronous processing, event-driven integration and data contracts.
Ability to define architectural principles, standards, patterns and reusable components, and apply them across multiple systems and teams.
Hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services, particularly Azure Service Bus, APIs and related Azure services.
Strong Python and/or .NET development capability, with experience building or assuring production-grade integration services.
Ability to design secure, scalable and maintainable integrations, including observability, error handling, resilience and supportability.
Experience facilitating architecture workshops, communicating technical trade-offs and influencing senior stakeholders.
Experience reviewing and assuring technical designs, documentation and engineering outputs.

Desirable

Experience within higher education.
Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as SIS, ERP, CRM and VLE systems.
Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, source control and automated testing.
Experience in consultancy or transformation environments.

Benefits

PACT offers a flexible and supportive approach to work, including hybrid and flexible working arrangements. Our benefits package includes enhanced pension contributions, an annual bonus and enhanced parental leave, helping our people balance a rewarding career with the commitments that matter to them.

Hours

Hybrid Working

Closing Date

Tue, 29 Sept 2026

If you’re passionate about building smart, scalable, game changing solutions, this is your moment. We’re searching for Microsoft Dynamics Engineers to join our innovative and ambitious Customer Engagement Platform team at our Head Office in Skipton — officially named the happiest place to live in Great Britain for 2025/2026 by Rightmove’s annual Happy at Home survey. There’s no better place to grow your career and make an impact.

Who Are We?

Not just another building society. Not just another job.

We're the fourth biggest building society in the UK and what makes us a bit different is that we're a mutual organisation. We don't have shareholders; we're owned by our members.

Our colleagues say Skipton's a great place to work, and you could be one of them, bringing with you new ideas on how we can keep customers at the heart of what we do.

Whatever your background, and whatever your goals, we'll help you take the next step towards a better future.

Why This Role Matters

As a Dynamics Engineer, you’ll be at the heart of our digital evolution. You’ll develop, innovate, and maintain Dynamics solutions that streamline processes, empower colleagues, and enhance the experience of our members. You’ll collaborate with stakeholders across the business, turning ideas into powerful, automated products that make a real difference.

What’s In It For You?

Skipton values work/life balance and we are proud to support hybrid and flexible working, where possible. We have a newly refurbished head office which offers a vibrant and collaborative working space.

We have a range of other benefits available to you including

Annual discretionary bonus scheme

25 days standard annual leave + bank holidays + rising 1 day per year of service to a maximum of 30 days

Holiday trading scheme allowing the ability to buy and sell additional annual leave days

Matching employer pension contribution (up to 10% per annum)

Colleague mortgage (conditions apply)

Salary sacrifice scheme for hybrid & electric car

A commitment to training and development

Private medical insurance for all our colleagues

3 paid volunteering days per annum

Diverse and inclusive colleague networks available for you to join including our Carers and Pride Alliance groups

We care about your health and wellbeing – we provide a range of benefits that support this including cycle to work initiative and discounted gym membership

What Will You Be Doing?

You will lead end-to-end technical delivery of solutions for our Customer Engagement Platform built on Microsoft Dynamics 365. Ensure solutions are designed and engineered using appropriate methods and tools, aligned to organisational strategy, security, and standards. Drive adoption of best practices in solution architecture and ALM to meet business goals, deliver value to stakeholders, and manage technical risk. Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers, fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture.

What Do We Need From You?

Lead and take ownership across all stages and iterations of Dynamics delivery.
Plan, drive, and evaluate Dataverse solution construction (tables, relationships, forms, views, model-driven apps) aligning with engineering and security standards
Design and implement server-side extensions (C# plug-ins, custom workflow activities) and client-side behaviours (TypeScript/JavaScript, form/context APIs)
Define and execute robust integration patterns using Azure Functions, Service Bus, Webhooks, virtual tables and API Management; ensure observability with Application Insights
Automate business processes with Power Automate (cloud flows) with error handling
Establish ALM practices: solution layering, environment strategies, CI/CD using Power Platform Build Tools and Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions.
Assure security-by-design (environment roles, security roles, field security, DLP policies) and compliance (auditing, GDPR)
Set quality standards via reviews, Solution Checker, static analysis and test automation
Optimise performance and scalability (plugin pipeline optimisation, batching, concurrency controls, index strategy)
Provide production support leadership, troubleshooting complex incidents and driving root-cause remediation via controlled releases.
Evaluate emerging platform capabilities and their organisational impact. Champion continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for someone who blends technical expertise with curiosity, creativity, and a passion for improvement.

Ideally, You’ll Have

Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant Associate (PL-200)
Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Service Functional Consultant Associate (MB-230)
Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)

If you’re excited by the potential of automation and want to help shape the future of how we work, we’d love to hear from you.

Ready to Make an Impact?

Jo in us and help build the next generation of digital solutions at Skipton, the happiest place to live in Great Britain. This is your chance to innovate, collaborate, and create technology that truly matters.

new_jobs.description:
About The Company

TEKsystems, a leading provider of technology and talent solutions, is part of Allegis Group, one of the world's largest privately-held talent management firms. With a strong global presence, TEKsystems specializes in connecting organizations with top-tier IT professionals and delivering innovative technology solutions. The company is committed to fostering a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and excellence, ensuring that clients and employees alike thrive in a rapidly evolving digital landscape. TEKsystems prides itself on its customer-centric approach, leveraging deep industry expertise and cutting-edge technologies to drive business success and digital transformation across various sectors.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Azure Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, with a focus on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). You will take a hands-on approach across the full technology stack, guiding technical direction, establishing engineering standards, and ensuring that solutions are secure, resilient, observable, and operationally straightforward. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work on complex, high-impact projects within a collaborative environment that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in cloud architecture, microservices, and modern development practices, with a passion for delivering scalable and secure cloud solutions.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess significant experience in senior or lead engineering roles, particularly in delivering and operating production systems. A strong hands-on background in Java, especially with Spring Boot, REST API development, and performance tuning is essential. Experience with Python, using frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask, for service development and automation is highly desirable. Proven expertise in building and maintaining front-end applications with React, preferably with TypeScript, modern hooks, and comprehensive testing strategies, is required. Deep knowledge of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including deployments, ingress, autoscaling, and secrets management, is critical. Familiarity with containerization using Docker, CI/CD pipeline development with Azure DevOps, and security best practices such as SAST/DAST, role-based access control, and secrets management are also necessary. Candidates should demonstrate a solid understanding of security, reliability, and operability in enterprise environments, with experience applying DevSecOps principles and modern identity management protocols like OAuth2 and OIDC. Additional qualifications include experience with Azure services like ACR, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and API Management, along with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Bicep.

Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end delivery of full-stack applications, including React (TypeScript) front-end interfaces and Java/Python back-end services, encompassing microservices and APIs.
Design and own cloud-native solutions for AKS-based platforms, defining service boundaries, resilience strategies, scaling approaches, deployment processes, and operational readiness standards.
Develop, build, and operate back-end services using Java (Spring Boot) and Python (FastAPI/Flask), ensuring API design adherence with OpenAPI, performance optimization, and security controls.
Create modern, accessible user interfaces with React, emphasizing reusable components, efficient state management, and robust testing practices.
Manage Kubernetes deployments on AKS, including configuration of manifests, ingress controllers, autoscaling policies, secrets, and configuration management, along with rollout and rollback procedures.
Implement DevSecOps practices by building CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, integrating automated testing, security scans, and dependency checks to ensure high-quality releases.
Enhance observability and production stability through logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and defining Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Indicators (SLIs). Lead incident response and post-incident reviews.
Embed security by design, incorporating secure coding practices, threat modeling, role-based access controls, secrets management, and modern authentication protocols.
Mentor and coach engineering team members by conducting code and design reviews, promoting best practices, and reducing technical debt.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, architects, UX designers, QA, and platform engineers to plan, deliver, and manage project risk.
Set clear technical directions, balancing rapid delivery with sustainable, maintainable solutions.
Foster an inclusive engineering culture that values diverse perspectives and continuous learning.
Take accountability for delivery timelines, system stability, and root cause analysis, ensuring long-term solutions over temporary fixes.
Streamline processes by removing blockers, automating tasks, and simplifying complex workflows to enable high-quality software delivery.

Benefits

Joining TEKsystems offers the opportunity to work within a forward-thinking, innovative environment that values technical excellence and professional growth. Employees benefit from a collaborative culture that encourages ownership, mentorship, and continuous learning. The company provides competitive compensation packages, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance. Additionally, employees have access to cutting-edge technologies and participate in projects that have a meaningful impact on clients' digital transformation journeys. TEKsystems fosters a supportive environment where diverse viewpoints are welcomed, and individual contributions are recognized and rewarded. The company also emphasizes career development through training programs, certifications, and leadership opportunities, enabling employees to advance their skills and careers in cloud engineering and related fields.

new_jobs.title: Solutions Architect
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Ascent has recently been acquired by Acuity Analytics . This is both a significant milestone for us and a tremendous opportunity for you.
Acuity Analytics is a business with a strong global reputation, an impressive client base, and ambitious growth plans. We deliver deep insights and domain-led digital transformation to high-growth and heavily regulated organisations. To our customers, we bring a partnership that provides the talent, technology, and capability to enhance performance and operational efficiency.
As part of our continued growth, we are looking for a Solutions Architect to define enterprise-grade application solution architecture for large-scale legacy modernization initiatives within a Banking & Capital Markets environment.

About the Role

You will be responsible for assessing complex existing application and integration landscapes, particularly Microsoft technology-based estates, identifying modernization opportunities, and designing scalable, resilient, secure, maintainable and cloud-agnostic target solutions aligned to business capabilities and enterprise architecture standards.
You will bring strong functional understanding and technical depth to translate business workflows, operating processes, integration dependencies, data flows, control points, reporting requirements and non-functional needs into practical modernization blueprints. The role involves defining migration-ready architecture patterns across .NET, C#, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure and related Microsoft-based technologies, evaluating technology options, guiding engineering teams, and ensuring solutions address scalability, availability, disaster recovery, RPO/RTO, security, auditability, observability, operational resilience and long-term supportability.

Skills and Experience Required

Core Skills (must-have):

Enterprise Solution Architecture
Application Legacy Modernization
Cloud-Agnostic Architecture
Microservices
Kafka / Event-Driven Architecture
Kubernetes
API & Integration Modernization
HA/DR design
DevSecOps / GitOps

Nice to Have:

Financial Services / Capital Markets domain experience
DORA / operational resilience awareness

Key Competencies:

Strong enterprise solution architecture experience in large-scale legacy modernization, application transformation, distributed systems, financial services platforms or high-volume transaction processing environments.
Ability to assess legacy estates including monolithic applications, tightly coupled integrations, shared databases, batch workflows, reporting platforms, operational bottlenecks and technology obsolescence risks.
Ability to understand business capabilities, functional workflows, operating models, reporting needs, controls, data dependencies and user journeys, and translate them into executable modernization solutions.
Deep understanding of microservices, domain-driven design, API design, database-per-service, event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging and enterprise integration design patterns.
Hands-on knowledge of Kafka or equivalent event streaming platforms, IBM MQ, REST, gRPC, FIX, SFTP, schema registry, message transformation, replayability, retry, exception handling and reconciliation patterns.
Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, container orchestration, cloud-native deployment, CI/CD, GitOps, Terraform, secrets management and DevSecOps engineering practices.
Good working knowledge of Azure and/or GCP cloud services, cloud landing zones, networking, identity, security, observability, resilience and workload deployment patterns.
Hands-on exposure to Azure architecture and Microsoft-based modernization patterns, including App Services, AKS, Azure SQL or SQL Server modernization, Entra ID, Key Vault, Azure Monitor and secure enterprise deployment practices.
Knowledge of cloud-agnostic architecture principles, multi-cloud deployment considerations, workload portability, exit strategy, high availability, disaster recovery, RPO/RTO definition and cross-environment resilience patterns.
Working knowledge of enterprise data platform concepts such as batch and streaming data flows, data quality, metadata, lineage, governance and regulatory data controls will be an advantage.
Strong understanding of Microsoft application landscapes including .NET, C#, WPF, Microsoft SQL Server, stored procedures, SSIS/SSRS awareness, Azure services, PostgreSQL, Redis, relational modelling, reporting platforms and approaches for modernizing legacy enterprise applications.
