Company Profile

Thermoteknix Systems Ltd, founded in 1982 and based in Cambridge, is a world leader in thermal imaging, night vision, and augmented reality systems. Our award-winning technologies are trusted by defence, security, and industrial customers in over 70 countries. With in-house R&D, cutting-edge innovation, and a global reputation for quality, we design and manufacture solutions that perform in the toughest environments.

Due to increasing market opportunities and an ever-growing product range, Thermoteknix is expanding its engineering capacity by expanding the New Product Introduction (NPI) team within R&D.

We are looking for an exceptionally motivated graduate software engineer who is passionate about software and enjoys solving difficult engineering problems. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to apply strong software engineering skills to real products, working at the intersection of software, electronics, firmware, automation, and manufacturing.

About You

As a member of the NPI team, you will be responsible for developing and supporting the software-driven automation and test systems used to transition products from development into scalable, repeatable manufacturing.

You will work closely with R&D, manufacturing, and quality teams, applying strong software engineering principles to implement comprehensive automated testing and validation processes.

Additionally, you will contribute to the enhancement of existing software to improve production test speed, reliability, and capability, ensuring that products are thoroughly tested and validated before reaching customers.

This is an opportunity for a graduate who wants to become an outstanding software engineer while working on real-world products and complex hardware/software systems.

Key Responsibilities

Support software and test design processes, ensuring DFT principles are applied throughout the product development lifecycle.
Support software and test workstreams within NPI projects, ensuring readiness for build and scale, and supporting the transition of products through to customer delivery.
Define and implement robust processes for firmware programming, product configuration, calibration data handling, and version control in production builds.
Define, develop, and document automated test processes during product development for new products and assemblies.
Work with mechanical and electronics engineers within the NPI team to design automated electromechanical test systems that optimise production throughput and ensure product quality.
Drive improvements in manufacturing readiness by identifying and implementing opportunities to streamline production test and build times.
Provide hands-on support during NPI builds, troubleshooting software, automation, and hardware-integrated system issues within the ECN framework.
Work with the quality department to support non-conformance investigations and product quality improvements during NPI phases.
Contribute to the development of the new NPI team's standards and processes.
Continuously look for opportunities to improve software quality, automation, test coverage, reliability, and development processes.

Required Skills & Experience

Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and solve complex technical problems.
Strong experience developing software in C#, with knowledge of WPF and MVVM methodologies.
Experience developing software tools, applications, or automation projects, ideally involving interaction with hardware or real-world systems, through academic, personal, or professional projects.
Understanding of software development practices including source control, testing, debugging, release processes, and configuration control.
Ability to troubleshoot software issues and communicate effectively with embedded hardware-integrated systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
Ability to create technical documentation and work within controlled software development and change management processes.
Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Commercial industry experience is not required. We are more interested in strong software engineering ability, technical curiosity, and the drive to learn than years of industry experience. Academic, personal, placement, and internship projects are all relevant.

Desirable Skills & Experience

Familiarity with embedded firmware programming tools.
Knowledge of manufacturing test systems, calibration workflows, and automation frameworks.
Knowledge of additional programming languages such as LabVIEW and C/C++.
Experience or academic/personal project exposure developing software that communicates with hardware, instruments, sensors, or embedded systems.
Understanding of engineering change control, ISO 9001 environments, and traceability requirements.
Exposure to thermal imaging products, or real-time embedded systems.
Exposure to the design or use of jigs, fixtures, tooling, or electronic test equipment through academic, personal, or project-based work.

Personal Attributes

Passionate about software and genuinely enjoys writing code.
Naturally curious and keen to understand how things work, from software through to electronics and hardware.
Hands-on, proactive, and solution-focused.
Enjoys tackling difficult technical problems and finding practical solutions.
Strong communication skills with engineering and production stakeholders.
Comfortable working across both software development and physical engineering environments.
Driven to improve processes and software quality and deliver manufacturing excellence.
Self-motivated and keen to learn from experienced engineers while contributing ideas of your own.

Who We Are Looking For

This role would suit a graduate who has gone beyond simply completing their degree and has demonstrated a genuine passion for software engineering.

Perhaps you have built software projects during university or in your own time, contributed to open-source projects, developed tools for yourself or others, competed in programming or engineering challenges, or simply spend your free time learning new technologies and understanding how things work.

You do not need to have years of manufacturing experience. What matters is that you have strong software fundamentals, intellectual curiosity, a high level of technical ability, and a desire to become an exceptional engineer.

If you love software, enjoy solving problems, and want to see your code interact with real products and hardware, we would like to hear from you.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

Opportunity to join and shape the developing NPI Team
A key software engineering role bridging cutting-edge R&D and real-world manufacturing

new_jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering
new_jobs.description:
The Role:

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 
The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system. 

What This Role Is Not: 

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title. 

What You Will Work On:

Technical Leadership 

Define and own the technical roadmap for autonomous constellation operations
Set the architectural direction for the data platform, reliability systems, and automation infrastructure
Stay hands-on: review code, prototype solutions, and get into the details when it matters
Establish engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing, and observability, and hold the team to them
Be the person engineers come to when the problem is genuinely hard

Team Building & Culture 

Recruit, develop, and retain a team of 6 to 10 world-class reliability and platform engineers
Set the pace, tone, and ambition for the team and make being on it feel like a privilege
Create an environment where engineers grow fast, own their work, and ship things they are proud of
Identify gaps and level up engineers through mentorship and not just management

Operational Transformation 

Lead the shift from manual, operator-driven processes to fully automated and self-healing operations
Define and drive toward SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets for the constellation
Partner with satellite operations and mission teams to translate pain into software solutions

Cross-Functional Influence 

Be the technical voice of the team in company-wide conversations about architecture, infrastructure, and platform strategy
Influence how Spire thinks about automation, data, and AI/ML across the broader engineering organization

Basic Qualifications: 

7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 in a technical leadership or staff-level individual contributor role
Demonstrated track record building and shipping reliable production systems at scale. You have owned things that could not go down.
Deep technical credibility. Engineers on your teams have respected your judgment and not just your title.
Experience with SRE principles, reliability engineering, or large-scale automation. You have reduced toil systematically and not just complained about it.
Strong foundation in Python, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
Experience hiring and developing engineers. You know what great looks like and how to find it.
The communication and influence skills to drive technical decisions across teams you do not directly control

Preferred Qualifications: 

Experience applying AI/ML or advanced analytics to operational or monitoring problems
Experience writing performance software in Rust
Background in space systems, aerospace, or highly constrained real-time environments
Experience building data lakes, telemetry platforms, or observability infrastructure at scale
A history of leading teams through technical transformations and not just maintaining the status quo

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.
Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying.

Global Perks

🥰 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

🍉 Healthy snacks & beverages in every office

We   improve life on Earth with data from space.
Spire Global is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates the largest multi-purpose constellation of satellites. Its proprietary data and algorithms provide the most advanced maritime, aviation, and weather tracking in the world. In addition to its constellation, Spire’s data infrastructure includes a global ground station network and 24/7 operations that provide real-time global coverage of every point on Earth.

Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Build technology that solves real business problems
We are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
to work at the intersection of technology, data, AI and the business.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will work directly with our investment, operations and distribution teams, spending time with the people who use our technology to understand their workflows, identify meaningful problems and build solutions that make a measurable difference.

You will have the autonomy to take ideas from problem definition through to production, often moving from prototype to a working solution in days or weeks rather than months.

The role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.
Rapidly prototype solutions, test them with users and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Take successful prototypes through to production, building secure, reliable and maintainable services.
Work across the full technology stack, including backend services, APIs, data pipelines and user-facing applications.
Integrate data and systems across APIs, databases, files and message queues, turning complex and fragmented data into useful products and services.
Apply modern AI and LLM capabilities to accelerate delivery and create new ways of working.
Partner closely with engineering, data and platform teams to align with architecture, security and technology standards.
Maintain a strong focus on security, governance, data protection and operational resilience, particularly where solutions interact with client assets and regulated activity.

About you
You are a hands-on engineer and pragmatic problem solver who enjoys being close to the people you build for.
You are comfortable operating in environments where the problem is not always clearly defined. You can ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, make sensible trade-offs and move quickly from an idea to something users can actually work with.
You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, mapping a business process with a subject matter expert, or explaining a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
Most importantly, you care about building the right thing, not simply building things right.

Experience needed for the role:
4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and supporting production systems.
Experience taking projects end to end, from problem definition and design through development, deployment and ongoing improvement.
Experience working directly with users, clients or business stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong experience integrating APIs, databases, files and messaging systems, and working with complex or imperfect real-world data.
Experience in financial services, investment management, asset management or another regulated, data-intensive environment is highly desirable.
Experience using modern AI/LLM technologies, or a demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to adopt them quickly.

Technical skills
We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals rather than a specific technology background. Experience with one or more of the following is valuable:
Programming: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# or Go.
Full stack development: backend services, APIs and modern web applications.
Data: SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, data modelling, cloud storage and graph technologies, including GraphRAG.
Cloud and infrastructure: Azure, containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
Security: authentication, authorisation, data isolation, input validation and secure handling of sensitive information.
AI: LLMs, AI-assisted development, intelligent automation and emerging AI application patterns.

If you are an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working directly with users and turning ideas into production technology, we would like to hear from you.

About the job:

Impact at Scale
: We are part of Allegro, developing high-performance IT systems for OneBox backend.
Massive Scale
: Design and build high-availability systems used by tens of thousands of users. This is high-performance engineering in practice.
Modern Tech Stack
: Work with a world-class environment using C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, REST, PostgreSQL, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, EntityFramework, and Redis.
True Ownership & Autonomy
: We live by a "you build it, you run it" philosophy. You'll join an autonomous team with full ownership of the services you create, from design to deployment.
Complex Challenges
: You will tackle complex backend problems, using technology to solve real-world business challenges.

Join the team building the backend powering our OneBox network! Imagine walking down the street, spotting a OneBox parcel locker, and knowing that your code helps drive it – that's the kind of impactful project you'll be working on. Our systems process millions of parcels, operating at high scale, high complexity, and deep integration close to the hardware.

In this role, you will work with physical machines, shape our backend architecture, and scale our infrastructure to support a continuously growing fleet of OneBoxes. We prioritize high reliability, modern engineering practices, and a supportive team culture, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex real-world challenges at scale.

Important things for you

Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):
PLN 14 600 - 20 825

Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
Our team is based in Warsaw.

We are looking for people who:

Have solid, fluent proficiency in C# and .NET Core / ASP.NET
for building reliable, maintainable backend systems;
Demonstrate solid proficiency in designing and maintaining REST APIs
and microservices;
Work confidently with relational databases like PostgreSQL
, including data modeling and basic database performance tuning;
Have hands-on experience with cloud-native tooling such as Docker and Kubernetes
;
Have experience working with asynchronous messaging systems like Azure Service Bus
or similar message brokers;
Understand caching concepts and usage of tools like Redis
to support system performance;
Have experience with large IoT device networks or similar systems (a plus), or are open, excited, and aware of working with such device ecosystems;
Enjoy sharing knowledge, and encouraging good engineering practices;
Are eager to grow toward end-to-end task ownership across the software development lifecycle with mentorship from senior engineers;
Are comfortable participating in architectural discussions and contributing to overall system design;
Are proficient in Polish and English (at least B2 level).

What's in it for you:

Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
A 16" or 14" Dell with Windows and all the necessary accessories.
A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.

#goodtobehere means that:

You will join a team you can count on
- we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.
You will love our level of autonomy
in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.
You will value our Developer Experience
and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.
You will be equipped with modern AI tools
to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).
You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!)
by your friends, family and millions of our customers.
You will meet the Allegro Scale
, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning.
You will become part of Allegro Tech
- We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!

Send us your CV and… see you at Allegro!

Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft.

Accuris has been an integral part of the engineering ecosystem for more than 60 years and is valued for standards content and workflow solutions including Engineering Workbench, Goldfire, Haystack, and Parts Management Solutions.

The Team:

The Engineering Workbench team builds and evolves a flagship Accuris product used globally by engineering professionals. The team focuses on delivering robust, scalable, and secure cloud-based solutions in AWS, supported by strong software quality practices across manual testing, automation, defect management, and CI/CD validation.

You will collaborate closely with software developers, QA specialists, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders. The team values ownership, practical test automation, clear communication, continuous improvement, and proactive collaboration across disciplines.

The Impact:

As a Senior SQA Engineer, you will design software testing plans, create and execute manual and automated tests, and help ensure the quality of web applications and services throughout the full product lifecycle, including Production.

You will guide the team on when and how to automate effectively, influence testability during design and development phases, coordinate defect management, and provide clear test results, regression feedback, and quality insights to development teams.

Responsibilities:

Design software testing plans and create and execute both manual and automated tests using test automation tools including, but not limited to Selenium and Playwright.
Understand the concepts behind automation, know when automation is appropriate, and guide the team on how to create the right tests.
Coordinate team members to solve issues assigned to the team and support timely resolution of quality risks.
Monitor Production quality and coordinate resolution of issues assigned to teams.
Ensure compliance of team testing activities with project rules, quality standards, and agreed processes.
Participate in functional testing during CI/CD processes and support reliable product releases.
Organize and monitor defect management processes within teams.
Influence the inclusion of testability during design, grooming, and development phases.
Test the product in all phases of its lifecycle, including Production.
Interface with developers in the project by providing clear test results and identifying regression areas.

What We’re Looking For:

Key qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years of automation engineering experience with Selenium WebDriver and/or Playwright using C#/.NET and xUnit frameworks.
Experience testing web applications built with .NET Core, microservices, and AngularJS, including cross-browser and cross-device validation using automated tools.
Solid knowledge of databases, including the ability to write CRUD operations, work with JOINs, and validate data-driven application behavior.

Key soft skills:

Strong collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate testing activities, defect management, and issue resolution across development teams.
Clear, structured communication with developers, including the ability to provide test results, regression areas, and actionable defect information.
Proactive approach to quality, testability, production monitoring, and continuous improvement throughout the software development lifecycle.
Good spoken and written English.

Required Knowledge / Technologies:

Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, C#/.NET, xUnit frameworks, manual testing, automated testing, functional testing, and test case/script design and execution.
Testing of web applications in .NET Core, microservices, AngularJS, client-server application architecture, RESTful APIs, and CI/CD processes.
Databases and SQL, including CRUD operations, JOINs, data validation, and practical understanding of application data flows.
Docker containerization basics, AWS cloud services such as EC2, S3, RDS, or similar, and development tools such as Visual Studio, VS Code, or Rider.
Agile software development, Azure DevOps / ADOPS bug tracking, defect management, and exposure to performance and load testing tools such as CloudTest, Cloud Testing using ADOPS, or K6 are considered a plus.

What’s in it for you:

Opportunity to shape testing strategy and improve automation practices for a flagship product used globally.

Close collaboration with experienced developers, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders in an Agile environment.

new_jobs.title: Director, Global WMS Software Engineering and Product Design
new_jobs.description:
Join our R&D Tech Hub in Warsaw

We’re building a new R&D Tech Hub in Poland and are looking for people who want to make a real impact from day one. You’ll be part of a globally connected team, helping to shape the culture and ways of working at our new location. This is a hands-on role in a supportive environment, where collaboration, learning, and adaptability are key.

We value practical problem-solving, diverse perspectives, and people who take ownership. If you're ready to contribute to meaningful projects and help lay the foundation for a growing team, we’d like to hear from you.

About the role: What's in the Box

HelloFresh is searching for an action-oriented servant leader for our warehouse management system (WMS) Software Engineering and Product functions. This leader owns the full software delivery lifecycle for HelloFresh's global warehouse fulfillment and inventory control domain — from architecture and product design through engineering execution, quality assurance, and operational reliability. You will drive a culture of product & engineering excellence, leveraging modern agentic tooling and AI-assisted workflows to increase team velocity, reduce defect escape rates, and accelerate deployment confidence.

You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across technology, operations, automation/production technology, procurement, and finance to deliver innovative solutions on our strategic WMS platform — Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) — while balancing competing priorities and technical resource demand.

The Director of WMS Engineering and Product will
work with key technology and product leaders across HelloFresh to enable the inventory management and control domain strategy, evaluate technology-related priorities, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines impeccable management and communication skills with a practitioner's instinct for modern software delivery — knowing how to build high-performing teams, establish engineering health metrics, and integrate AI-assisted tooling that meaningfully accelerates quality and velocity.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

WMS Solution Ownership: Provide technical direction, development oversight, and performance accountability for HelloFresh's deployment of Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform across all global locations
Integration Architecture & Reliability: Drive WMS application layer Integration architecture to upstream tooling and host systems via CI/CD pipelines [Debezium/Kafka to Snowflake/Databricks]
Platform Architecture: Partner/ support as needed the Hosting Architecture team in the optimal sizing and performance of WMS Architecture in AWS
Agentic Engineering & Developer Productivity: Champion and drive adoption of agentic engineering practices across the team: automated code review tooling (e.g., AI-assisted PR analysis, static analysis agents, LLM-powered code quality gates), AI-augmented test generation and execution, and intelligent deployment pipelines. Measure and report the impact of these practices on delivery velocity and defect escape rate
CI/CD & Deployment Automation: Own the maturity roadmap for CI/CD pipelines. Establish automated deployment workflows with robust rollback strategies, feature flagging, environment-specific gate checks, and infrastructure-as-code practices — enabling high-confidence, low-friction releases across all WMS environments
Quality Engineering & Test Automation: Partner with WMS Services and Support leadership to build a world-class QA function. Drive adoption of automated regression suites, AI-assisted edge case generation, and contract testing for integrations. Push teams beyond happy-path coverage toward comprehensive scenario validation, including automated performance and load testing for peak fulfillment periods
Engineering Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Establish DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore) as the foundation of engineering health reporting for the WMS organization. Set baselines, publish improvement targets, and use metric trends to identify bottlenecks, prioritize tooling and process investments, and communicate engineering performance to senior leadership
Technical Roadmap & Architecture Governance: Partner with peers and senior leadership on architectural decision-making for WMS platform evolution, integration patterns, and technology transitions. Champion the use of structured design reviews to maintain coherent, scalable technical direction. Lead evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including risk mitigation and transition planning
Vendor & Capacity Management: Work with department leadership to source and partner with 3rd-party vendors to augment internal engineering capacity and expertise. Maintain vendor performance accountability and ensure structured knowledge transfer to build durable internal capability
People Leadership & Talent Development: Coach, develop, and retain high-performing engineers, product managers, and team leads. Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to build organizational depth — playing an active role in recruiting, onboarding, and career development
International Standardization/ Release Consolidation. Partner with departmental leadership, peer domains, and executive leadership to own the long term roadmap for product consolidation to a single application release version administered globally
Cross-functional Leadership. Serve on both the Fulfillment Technology and overall Automation & Technology leadership teams, reinforcing HelloFresh DNA values, establishing KPIs, and prioritizing strategic initiatives at a departmental level

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

Technical/Engineering Experience

10+ years of warehouse management system (WMS) software engineering and implementation experience with a tier-one WMS in an RF-based distribution, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfillment environment
3+ years of direct hands-on experience with Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform with SQL Server
3+ years managing application integrations via microservices and associated toolsets, including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ETL pipelines
Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing gates, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices across multi-environment WMS or fulfillment technology stacks
Hands-on familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted engineering tools — including automated code review platforms, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeRabbit, SonarQube AI, or equivalent) — with a track record of driving meaningful team-wide adoption and measurable impact
Experience defining and tracking engineering delivery and quality metrics (DORA metrics or equivalent) and using data to drive process improvement and leadership reporting
Experience leading evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including developing and executing technology transition plans with appropriate risk mitigation strategies

Product Experience

Experience leading a design and product process that scales a digital technology operations ecosystem across volume growth, multiple brands, and new digital properties
Strategic thinker with the ability to build and execute innovative digital product strategy while executing tactically against multiple competing priorities simultaneously
Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, roadmaps, and delivery plans — and to communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to build leadership support for proactive technology investments, making the business case for engineering quality, automation, and platform modernization

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh Group better.
We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Health - You’re covered from your first day with private health insurance.
Flexible Working - We work in-office 3 days a week to align on goals, with flexible hours to support work-life balance and personal needs
Time Off - You receive 26 days of paid vacation each year, providing you time to rest and recharge.
Learning and Development - An annual Learning & Development budget and a Mentoring Program to support your ongoing professional growth.
Employee Referral Program - Our team members can take part in our internal employee referral program and receive a bonus for recommending successful candidates to open roles.
Daily Comforts - Free coffee, drinks, and fresh fruit are available to keep you refreshed throughout the day.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD100348

Senior Full Stack Software Development Engineer

Krakow, Poland

Position Overview

Autodesk, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADSK) makes software for people who make things. We are a global leader in design and make software for the architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing, and media and entertainment industries. If you have ever driven a high-performance car, admired a towering skyscraper, used a smartphone, or watched a great film, chances are you have experienced something created by millions of Autodesk customers using our software.

At Autodesk, we exist to turn ideas into new realities that shape a successful future. Our software and services harness emerging technologies—including additive manufacturing (3D printing), artificial intelligence, generative design, and robotics—to give companies and individuals the power to work more quickly and sustainably throughout the entire project lifecycle.

Autodesk Operations Solutions is developing a cloud-first platform that unifies facility operations, asset management, maintenance, process improvement, and building systems data, connecting the entire building lifecycle with day-to-day operations.

Central to this platform is Autodesk Tandem, which provides an ecosystem that transforms building and asset data into digital twin–based operational workflows and services. The solutions we are developing will build on this foundation through a modern web experience, a common information model, published APIs, and standardized connector patterns. These capabilities will enable customers and partners to integrate OT, IT, and CMMS systems, extend functionality, and operationalize analytics and managed services at scale.

We are expanding our presence in Kraków, Poland, and are looking for a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer to join our team and help shape the future of Autodesk Operations Solutions and Autodesk Tandem. Reporting to a Software Engineering Manager, you will contribute to delivering solutions that provide a cohesive, scalable cloud platform experience. The ideal candidate will have experience across all aspects of cloud application development.

Autodesk offers a hybrid work experience.

Responsibilities

.NET-utvecklare till Story House Egmont i Malmö/Köpenhamn

Vill du vidareutveckla system som våra läsare litar på — hos en arbetsgivare som ger tillbaka till samhället.

Om Story House Egmont

Story House Egmont är ett av Skandinaviens ledande medieföretag. Vi skapar engagerande berättelser och innovativa produkter för både tryckta och digitala plattformar. Vår satsning på e-handel och digital marknadsföring växer snabbt tillsammans med vår stabila medieverksamhet.
Bland våra varumärken inom Publishing finner du Hemmets Journal, ICA kuriren, Svensk Golf, Hus&Hem, King/Cafee, Kalle Anka & Co, Bamse och Fantomen, för att nämna några, och för att möta våra engagerade läsares förväntningar, bygger vi nu om många av våra tekniska plattformar, där vi går mot en modern, molnbaserad miljö, med hjälp av agentbaserad utveckling.

Din roll hos oss

Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en nyckelspelare i teamet som utvecklar och underhåller våra prenumerationstjänster. Vi driver redan idag det mesta i en cloud native-miljö på Docker/K8s. Databaslagret är en mix av SQL Server och PostgreSQL. Du får vara med och forma både arkitektur och arbetssätt — och du blir en del av ett team där agentbaserad utveckling redan är vardag och din roll handlar om att sätta riktning, granska och orkestrera snarare än att skriva varje rad själv. Här finns utrymme att påverka både hur vi jobbar och vad vi bygger.
Rollen är hands-on utveckling. Du rapporterar till Head of Subscription Systems och ingår i ett team på 9 personer — utvecklare och applikationsspecialister. Du har direktkontakt med användare och kommunicerar dagligen med dina teamkamrater som sitter utspridda på våra kontor i Malmö och Köpenhamn.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

•Vidareutveckla och modernisera våra applikationer i senaste versioner av .NET, K8s, REST och microservices — bland annat supportsystem för e-handel, betalsystem, masterdata, marknadsföring, printplanering, kundservicesystem och prenumerationsmotor.
•Arbeta agentbaserat i ditt dagliga arbete — orkestrera och granska kod skriven av AI-agenter, med verktyg som Claude, Codex eller liknande.
•Ta tekniskt ägarskap för specifika produkter och vara med och påverka arkitektur och tekniska beslut.
•Driva förändringsarbete och bidra till en modern utvecklingskultur.
•Arbeta nära verksamheten, inklusive sälj- och marknadsavdelningen, för att förstå deras behov och utforma lösningar som passar dem.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är en engagerad .NET-utvecklare med en stark teknisk grund och med en nyfikenhet på hur AI förändrar sättet vi utvecklar mjukvara på. Du trivs i en dynamisk miljö, är inte rädd för att ta ansvar, och är en lagspelare med god kommunikationsförmåga.

Kvalifikationer

•Relevant utbildning inom systemutveckling eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
•Minst 3 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling med .NET och C#.
•Erfarenhet av att arbeta med relationsdatabaser, till exempel SQL Server och/eller PostgreSQL.
•Erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsprinciper, automatiserad bygg/deploy (GitHub Actions) och unit-testning.
•Nyfikenhet på och gärna praktisk erfarenhet av agentbaserad utveckling (t.ex. Claude, Codex eller liknande verktyg).
•Du talar och skriver obehindrat på ett skandinaviskt språk (svenska, norska eller danska), samt har goda kunskaper i engelska, eftersom du kommer arbeta mot flera europeiska marknader.
•Meriterande: Docker/K8s, REST, Git/GitHub, Azure, Jira/Confluence.

Vi erbjuder dig …

•en spännande roll med en stor utvecklingspotential i ett modernt mediehus.
•agentbaserad utveckling — din roll är att orkestrera, granska och sätta riktning, och du får forma hur vi bygger våra interna verktyg för det.
•cloud native miljö på Azure och K8s, .NET.
•en roll där du kan forma både arkitektur och arbetssätt.
•ett modernt och flexibelt kontor i centrala Malmö eller på Österbro i Köpenhamn

Livet hos Story House Egmont — en del av något större

Vi som jobbar inom Story House Egmont står för kreativitet, långsiktighet och öppenhet. Vi jobbar i team och hjälper och stöttar varandra för att tillsammans utveckla de bästa berättelserna och produkterna. Vi välkomnar kompetenta, drivna och nyfikna människor.

Som medarbetare i en av Sveriges ledande medieverksamheter är du också en del av något större. Egmont är en internationell och expansiv mediekoncern fylld av passionerade och kompetenta människor med olika bakgrunder, kunskaper och erfarenheter.

Egmont är en helägd stiftelse som verkar utifrån ett dubbelt syfte: att utveckla verksamheten och att stötta utsatta barn och unga. Som anställd i Egmont är du med och ger tillbaka till samhället och skapar förutsättningar för ett bra liv för nästa generation.

Om du har frågor kring tjänsten så är du välkommen att kontakta: Head of Subscription Systems, Johan Friberg, johan.friberg@egmont.se .

Adress till arbetsplatsen:
Studentgatan 4
Malmö, 211 38
Sweden

Sista ansökningsdag är 04/10/2026, men vi intervjuar löpande. Vänligen använd ”Apply Now” knappen för att ansöka till tjänsten. Vi tar ej emot ansökningar vi e-mail.

About Story House Egmont
Story House Egmont är ett av Nordens ledande och mest traditionsrika medieföretag. Vi är passionerade historieberättare och står bakom några av landets populäraste varumärken. Inom våra tre huvudområden – Media, E-commerce och Agencies – utvecklar vi engagerande innehåll, högkvalitativa produkter, innovativa tjänster och personliga mötesplatser. Vår ägare är den nordiska mediekoncernen Egmont tillsammans med Nordisk Film, TV 2 i Norge och det danska bokförlaget Lindhardt og Ringhof. Egmont är en stiftelse som varje år delar ut en stor del av sitt överskott för att stötta utsatta barn och ungdomar.

Som senior .NET-utvecklare hos oss kommer du att

Arbeta med systemdesign, arkitektur och implementation i Microsofts teknikstack.
Bidra med din expertis i agila team och ta ansvar för både teknik och kundrelation.
Utveckla e-tjänster och lösningar som används av tusentals människor varje dag.
Dela kunskap och inspirera kollegor – vi tror att ju mer man ger, desto mer får man tillbaka.

Vi vill att du har

Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av .NET-utveckling och Microsofts teknikstack.
Erfarenhet av agila utvecklingsmiljöer
Ett självgående och strukturerat arbetssätt
God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift

Extra plus om du har erfarenhet av:
E-tjänster och offentlig sektor

Om oss

Vi på Softronic
jobbar ständigt med att förﬂytta våra kunder mot morgondagens teknik. Vare sig det handlar om att utveckla AI, automatisera processer eller modernisera en äldre lösning med bibehållen tillgänglighet. En annan sida av det vi gör är att vi hjälper våra kunder att utveckla innovativa och driftsäkra tjänster som skapar samhällsnytta genom att förenkla människors liv och jobb. På så sätt blir vi och vår teknik en positiv kraft i samhället och en del i att göra världen lite mer hållbar. Det är det vi kallar GoodTech.

new_jobs.title: Senior Cloud & Backend Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Do you like building backend solutions that don’t just work, but keep working, and are secure, scalable, and easy to live with? At Framna, we’re looking for a Senior Cloud & Backend Engineer who knows their way around .NET and Azure, and who likes thinking beyond the code itself. Someone who can zoom in on a tricky backend problem, zoom out to consider the architecture and infrastructure around it, and build solutions made to last.

Become part of the team

Framna partners with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, like Swish, SJ, Essity, and SEB, to create digital products that define markets and deliver real-world impact. We are more than 600 people across ten studios, building apps and digital products used by millions every day.

As our next Senior Cloud & Backend Engineer you’ll join our team in Östersund
, working alongside developers, designers, QA engineers, analysts, and product leads to take ideas from first sketch to live product.

You’ll also become part of Framna’s wider engineering and cloud community across our studios — sharing knowledge, discussing architecture, trying new approaches, and figuring out better ways to build together.

And while we collaborate across locations, Östersund is where you’ll call home. We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys being around their colleagues and wants the office to be a natural part of their working week.

What you’ll do

This is a senior role for someone who enjoys owning the bigger technical picture. You’ll work across backend development, cloud infrastructure, architecture, and operations, with a particular focus on .NET and Microsoft Azure
. More specifically, you will:

Design, develop, and maintain backend solutions primarily using .NET and Azure
.
Build and operate cloud infrastructure and applications with reliability, scalability, and performance in mind.
Make architectural and technical decisions that help our products stay maintainable as they grow.
Work with security, databases, networking, and cloud services to create stable and robust systems.
Collaborate closely with developers, product teams, and partners to turn both technical and business needs into great solutions.
Share your experience with the people around you, whether that means mentoring another developer, leading a technical discussion, or simply helping the team solve a particularly stubborn problem.

Who you are

We imagine you’ve spent around 6–7 years or more working professionally with backend and cloud development
, and that .NET and Azure have been a significant part of that journey
.
But years alone don’t make someone senior. We’re looking for someone who has developed the judgement that comes with experience. You know when to dig deeper, when to keep things simple, and how the decisions you make today will affect a product two years from now. You might recognise yourself if you:

Have strong professional experience with .NET and Microsoft Azure

Have worked with cloud architecture and understand the infrastructure surrounding the applications you build
Are comfortable thinking about the full lifecycle of a system, from development and deployment to monitoring and operations
Take pride in quality and don’t like solving today’s problem by creating tomorrow’s
Enjoy technical variety and are happy learning new tools or technologies when the problem calls for it
Like collaborating and sharing knowledge rather than disappearing into your own corner with a ticket
Feel comfortable taking technical ownership and helping less experienced developers grow
Enjoy working from the office and being part of the everyday life of a team

What you get

For us, it’s office first.
Our Östersund studio makes that pretty easy. With views over Storsjön, plenty of space to work together, and even a dedicated room for four-legged colleagues, it’s an office with a personality of its own. We spend time together because we believe it creates stronger teams, better collaboration, and ultimately better products.

A culture of curiosity.
On Fridays we have weekly demos, Wednesdays mean lunch-and-learns, and sometimes we throw ourselves into conceptathons just to see what happens. We gather for company conferences to share ideas, and we make room for learning when there’s something new we want to explore.

The freedom to follow your “what if.”
We believe the best roles are shaped by the people in them. If you’re curious about something, you’ll have the trust and space to chase it, and probably a few teammates who want to jump in with you.

Teammates who bring their whole selves.
Designers who doodle during standups, engineers who can’t resist showing off a clever hack, product leads who keep the energy up when things get tricky, and, in Östersund, the occasional dog making an appearance too. Around here, people genuinely like sharing what they know and celebrating when someone tries something new.

And of course, the benefits you’d expect.
A generous wellness grant, top-up on your parental leave, occupational pension, and plenty more to make life outside of work easier.

Our hiring process

Recruiter videocall
First interview
Case assignment
Technical interview
Reference check

Please note:
For this role, you need to be based in Östersund, Sweden
, or within commuting distance of our Östersund studio. Unfortunately, we are not able to offer relocation.

We're reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so don't wait to apply. We look forward to learning more about you!

, architecture
, operations
and data platforms
to ensure that our Azure and Databricks
environments remain secure, reliable and future-ready.

You will play a key role in advancing a modern enterprise data platform that enables data-driven decision-making across Vattenfall while continuously improving automation, governance and user experience.

Designing, implementing and operating Azure-based cloud platform solutions
Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Git and automation tools
Developing and managing Infrastructure as Code solutions using ARM, Bicep and scripting technologies
Automate provisioning, deployment and lifecycle management of cloud resources
Maintaining and improving self-service platform capabilities based on .NET Core and Angular
Ensuring platform reliability, availability and operational stability
Supporting administration and continuous improvement of Azure Databricks and Snowflake environments
Implementing security controls in alignment with enterprise policies and governance requirements
Collaborating with architects, developers and operations specialists to deliver secure and scalable cloud services

Azure Databricks Platform Operations & Governance

Operating and further developing Vattenfall’s Azure Databricks platform for analytics, data and AI workloads
Managing identity and access controls through Azure AD integration and RBAC principles
Supporting secure networking concepts including private endpoints and secure cluster connectivity
Implementing and maintaining data governance capabilities using Unity Catalog and related Databricks services
Managing platform resources using Infrastructure as Code approaches such as Terraform and ARM templates
Establishing compute standards, governance controls and cost optimisation practices
Enabling integrations with Azure Data Lake, Power BI, Snowflake and other enterprise services
Supporting onboarding and adoption of platform capabilities across teams
Contributing to monitoring, logging and security improvements throughout the platform landscape

Platform Improvement & FinOps

Identifying opportunities to improve performance, cost efficiency and sustainability of cloud services
Enhancing automation and self-service capabilities for platform users
Supporting the introduction of new cloud, AI and analytics capabilities
Helping to create a seamless developer and data practitioner experience across the platform ecosystem

Location

Stockholm, Katowice, Amsterdam and Berlin

Who are you?

You bring solid experience from cloud engineering environments and enjoy combining technology, security and automation to create reliable services for users. You are communicative, collaborative and enjoy working together with colleagues from different disciplines to solve complex challenges.

We believe you have

Several years of experience as a Cloud Engineer, DevOps Engineer or similar role in Azure environments
Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, preferably within operations, governance or platform engineering
Strong understanding of Azure services including Networking, Storage, App Services, Virtual Machines and Entra ID (Azure AD)
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD practices

A challenging and independent job in an informal, dynamic working environment. You can play a part in shaping the future of a company where the only constant is change. Besides being a challenging and inspiring place to work, we value a great work atmosphere!

new_jobs.title: Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Har du byggt och vidareutvecklat Azureplattformar i komplexa hybridmiljöer och vill fortsätta arbeta nära tekniken? Hos Akademiska Hus får du en tekniskt ledande och hands-on roll med stort inflytande över hur vår framtida infrastruktur ska standardiseras, automatiseras och säkras. Här bidrar du både till långsiktiga tekniska vägval och till att lösningarna faktiskt implementeras och fungerar.

DU KOMMER ATT

Akademiska Hus har gjort en omfattande förflyttning från traditionell on-prem-infrastruktur till Microsoft Azure. Samtidigt finns en stor, verksamhetskritisk systemmiljö kvar on-prem. Resultatet är en komplex hybridinfrastruktur där molntjänster och traditionell IT behöver fungera tillsammans – säkert, stabilt och effektivt.

Nu går vi in i nästa fas. Det innebär ökad automatisering och repeterbarhet, tydligare standarder och plattformsmönster, förbättrad governance och säkerhetsstyrning samt en mer enhetlig hybrid- och Azureplattform med mindre beroende av manuella arbetssätt.

Som Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer får du en central roll i denna utveckling. Det är en tekniskt ledande engineer-roll där tyngdpunkten ligger på eget genomförande. Du designar, implementerar och felsöker lösningar samtidigt som du samlar teamet kring tekniska frågor, skapar framdrift och stöttar kollegor genom kunskapsdelning och vägledning.

Teamet består av tolv personer i Göteborg och Stockholm, däribland fyra IT-teknikspecialister och tre nätverkstekniker. Tillsammans finns bred kompetens inom bland annat Azure, IAM, serverhallar och virtualisering, VDI, övervakning, brandväggar, SOC, VPN och nätverk. Du arbetar även nära arkitekter och har mandat att påverka tekniska lösningar, arbetssätt och plattformens fortsatta utveckling.

Du kommer bland annat att:

Designa, implementera och vidareutveckla lösningar i Azure och den hybrida infrastrukturen.
Arbeta hands-on med bland annat Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity och Security.
Utveckla automation och Infrastructure as Code för repeterbara och standardiserade leveranser.
Arbeta med Active Directory, Entra ID och Conditional Access i en komplex hybridmiljö.
Felsöka avancerade tekniska problem och driva lösningar från analys till genomförande.
Bidra till plattformsmönster, tekniska standarder, arkitektur och långsiktiga vägval.
Arbeta med governance, loggning, säkerhetsstyrning och kostnadsoptimering.
Ta ett tekniskt ledarskap och bidra till teamets gemensamma kompetens och utveckling.

DIN PROFIL

Vi söker dig med gedigen erfarenhet av IT-infrastruktur och av förflyttningen från traditionell on-prem till Azure och hybrid cloud. Kanske började du inom Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualisering och traditionell serverdrift. Med tiden har Azure blivit en allt större del av ditt ansvar och du har arbetat med migreringar, hybridlösningar, identitet, nätverk, säkerhet och automation.

I dag kan du se helheten och bidra till tekniska vägval, men vill fortfarande arbeta nära tekniken. Det viktiga är inte vilka titlar du har haft, utan att du förstår resan eftersom du själv har gjort den.

För rollen behöver du ha:

Flerårig erfarenhet av Azure i komplexa produktionsmiljöer.
Gedigen hands-on erfarenhet av hybrid Azure/on-prem.
God kompetens inom nätverk, identitet och säkerhet.
Erfarenhet av automation och Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform.
Erfarenhet av Active Directory, Entra ID, Conditional Access och PowerShell.
Förmåga att felsöka avancerade problem, genomföra lösningar och ta tekniskt ansvar.
Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure Virtual Desktop, Application Gateway, Application Proxy, Linux, DNS samt PKI och certifikathantering. Relevanta Azure-certifieringar är också meriterande.

Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och trygg i din tekniska kompetens. Du tycker om att förstå hur saker fungerar på djupet och utmanar gärna befintliga lösningar när du ser en bättre väg framåt. Samtidigt är du prestigelös, delar med dig av din kunskap och skapar framdrift tillsammans med andra.

Tjänsten kan vara placerad i Göteborg eller Stockholm. Akademiska Hus erbjuder ett flexibelt arbetssätt där utgångspunkten är att du arbetar ungefär hälften av tiden på kontoret. Upplägget planeras tillsammans med närmaste chef utifrån uppdraget. För den som vill finns möjlighet att resa mellan Göteborg och Stockholm för att träffa kollegorna på den andra orten.

VILL DU VETA MER?

Har du frågor eller funderingar? Kontakta gärna rekryteringskonsult Johanna Värmfors på johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com eller +46 730 821 230, alternativt Artan Bitiqi på artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com eller +46 723 61 28 44.

OM AKADEMISKA HUS

Akademiska Hus är ett av Sveriges största fastighetsbolag och ägs av svenska staten. Tillsammans med universitet och högskolor utvecklar och förvaltar vi kunskapsmiljöer som bidrar till forskning, utbildning och innovation över hela Sverige.Våra fastigheter rymmer allt från undervisningslokaler och kontor till avancerade laboratorier och forskningsmiljöer. Bakom verksamheten finns en omfattande digital och teknisk infrastruktur som är avgörande för att våra miljöer ska fungera och fortsätta utvecklas.

Hos Akademiska Hus får du arbeta i en organisation med ett långsiktigt perspektiv och samtidigt vara en del av en pågående teknisk utveckling. Här finns både komplexiteten i en stor IT-miljö och möjligheten att påverka hur framtidens lösningar ska utformas.

new_jobs.title: Delivery Solutions Architect
new_jobs.description:
CSQ227R121

Locations - Sweden, Denmark, Finland (Hybrid/Remote)

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems with the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you are a trusted technical advisor to key customers, providing expert guidance that translates data, analytics and AI challenges into high-impact business value. You help design, implement, and scale data and AI solutions, focusing on architecture, operational excellence, and customer enablement. Internally, you will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks Platform in your customers.

Delivery Solutions Architects (DSAs) Are Trusted Technical Advisors Embedded Within The Customer Organization, Providing Expert Guidance That Translates Data And AI Challenges Into High-impact Business Value. They Help You Design, Implement, And Scale Data And AI Solutions, Focusing On Architecture, Operational Excellence, And Team Enablement. DSAs Focus On

Designing secure, scalable architecture
Aligning people, processes, and technology
Establishing trusted advisor relationships
Leveraging the broader ecosystem of Databricks experts

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. Technically, the expectations are that you become the post-sales technical lead and trusted advisor across all Databricks products for the customer’s top priority use cases. This requires you to use your technical skills and credibility to engage and communicate with technical/technical leadership stakeholders in our customer organizations, do architecture reviews, help with performance and cost optimizations, demonstrate new capabilities, remove blockers, etc. In parallel, it is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving onboarding plans.

While not a hands-on-keyboard role, this is a highly technical position where architectural skills in fields such as Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Data Warehousing or Data Science are essential.

You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.

The Impact You Will Have

Be the Databricks Architect working with customer technical teams working on use cases/data products, from development to go-live, addressing any technical challenges and blockers and providing guidance, best practices and enablement
Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
Be the internal point of contact for any questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, often for multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to expert-level technical teams to address the tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
Create and execute a point-of-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs, presenting them to the customers when applicable for their ongoing developments
internal and external updates - KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, risks and blockers, product adoption and use case progression - to your Field Engineering leadership

What We Look For

Programming experience in PySpark, Python and Databricks (or similar data platform)
Understanding and hands-on experience of solution architecture-related distributed data and analytics systems
5+ years of experience where you have been accountable for delivery of projects in Data, Analytics or AI and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting roles
Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
Technical program coordination including account and stakeholder management
Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer technical stakeholders
Track record of overachievement against quota, Goals or similar objective targets
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
Can travel up to 30%

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

new_jobs.title: Integration Architect
new_jobs.description:
Ta chansen och kom in som Integration Architect hos oss där du får samarbeta med andra experter inom integration, data, AI och cloud. Tillsammans formar vi framtidens integrationslandskap – där smarta arkitekturella val möjliggör innovation, effektivitet och hållbarhet.

Vår Connectivity-enhet har närmare 60 integrationsexperter
med över 20 års erfarenhet av integration och processautomation. Vi bygger robusta, skalbara och framtidssäkra lösningar med modern teknik inom API-design, molnintegration och DevOps – för snabb affärsnytta och effektiva kopplingar mellan system och dataflöden.

Din roll som Integration Architect

Som Integration Architect på Solita ansvarar du för att forma den tekniska visionen kring hur system kommunicerar och integrerar på ett säkert, skalbart och hållbart sätt. Du designar och definierar den övergripande integrationsstrategin och -arkitekturen, väljer rätt teknologi och mönster, samt ser till att lösningarna stödjer kundens långsiktiga affärs- och IT-strategier.

Du gillar att ta helhetsansvar för integrationsarkitekturen i kundprojekt - från utvärdering av alternativ och beslut om vilka komponenter och verktyg som ska ingå, till att designa integrationsarkitekturen ovanpå vald plattform. Du leder ofta ett team av integrationsspecialister som du guidar under implementeringsfasen. I din roll som arkitekt samarbetar du nära utvecklingsteam, plattformsägare och affärssidan för att balansera teknisk kvalitet med affärsnytta.

Vi ser att du har erfarenhet av:

Integrationsarkitektur och -design i komplexa miljöer.
Molnbaserade integrationsplattformar (t.ex. Azure, Boomi, Workato) och moderna integrationsmönster (API-first, eventdriven arkitektur, mikrotjänster).
Att kommunicera arkitekturval tydligt till både tekniska och icke-tekniska intressenter.
Pre-sales och aktivt samarbete för att skapa lösningar i enlighet med kund- och affärsbehov.

Vi jobbar främst med molnbaserade plattforms- och integrationslösningar och har ett starkt samarbete med flera tech partners såsom exempelvis Azure (Integration Services)
, Boomi
och Workato
. Vi ser gärna att du jobbat med en eller flera av dessa tekniker för att möta våra kund- och projektbehov. Det är även meriterande om du har kunskap inom DevOps, IaC, infrastruktur och nätverk.

Träffa en Solitan

Axel Lundh
jobbar som Integration Architect hos oss med ansvar för att designa och bygga integrationsplattformar i Azure. Hans arbete fokuserar på att omsätta verksamhetskrav till robusta tekniska lösningar, samt skapa förutsättningar för effektiva och välfungerande utvecklingsteam.

"I rollen leder jag det tekniska arbetet inom mina projekt och definierar arkitektur, principer och ramverk som styr hur integrationer och applikationer utformas. Jag utvecklar och förvaltar plattformskomponenter, CI/CD-pipelines, säkerhetslösningar och infrastrukturlager med hjälp av teknologier som Azure DevOps, Terraform, Bicep och C#. Jag arbetar nära utvecklingsteamen för att ge tekniskt stöd, säkerställa god kvalitet i leveransen och driva förbättringar i både arbetssätt och lösningsdesign."

Vill du läsa mer om våra medarbetare på Connectivity berättar Rickard här
om sin resa hittills på Solita, samt Andrei
som haft möjlighet att bära flera hattar som både SDM, arkitekt och kravställare i ett större projekt de senaste 3 åren.

Att arbeta med AI som Integration Architect

AI är en naturlig del av hur vi arbetar;
De flesta av oss använder AI-verktyg som Copilot eller vår interna LLM-plattform dagligen - för att skriva och granska kod, testa idéer eller helt enkelt komma snabbare igenom rutinuppgifter.
Vi utforskar hur AI kan stötta integrationsarbetet. Det kan exempelvis vara att AI-agenter gör om kravspecifikationer till fungerande kod, orkestrerade flöden där agenter samlar in krav, tar fram färdiga specifikationer och skapar en pull request.
Vi hjälper även våra kunder att komma igång med AI på ett sätt som passar deras verksamhet och behov.

Det viktigaste för oss är nyfikenhet och en vilja att testa nya arbetssätt för att se var AI kan skapa verkligt värde. På sikt ser vi AI som en medutvecklare, inte en ersättare av integrationshantverket. Snarare något som gör oss snabbare och bättre i varje steg av utvecklingsprocessen.

Hur är det att jobba på Solita?

Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter en kultur med låg hierarki, hög entusiasm och värdeorienterat arbete
. Oavsett kund, projekt eller bransch har du alltid tillgång till ett stort nätverk av fantastiskt kunniga och nyfikna kollegor som gärna stöttar och delar med sig av sin kunskap. Därtill kan du ständigt lära dig nytt
genom våra kompetensnätverk, mentorskapsprogram, info sessions och möjligheten att ta olika certifieringar.

Vill du utmana dig själv, tänka nytt och leverera teknisk spetskompetens som håller långsiktigt? Du jobbar självständigt med stöd från kollegor som brinner för det vi gör och lever våra värdeord – passion, courage, easy-going och caring – i en miljö där samarbete, trygghet och människan står i centrum.

Här
kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här
kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar.

Som anställd hos Solita får du även ta del av förmåner såsom; fast lön
oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling, sjukvårdsförsäkring
via Skandia, 5000 kr i friskvårdsbidrag
, 30 semesterdagar
, after works, hobbyaktiviteter och fredagsfrukostar.

Intresserad?

Låter det som en spännande utmaning? Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt integrationsteam! Om du har några frågor, hör gärna av dig till: People Lead och rekryterande chef Sam Odeh
(sam.odeh(at)solita.se); eller Talent Acquisition Specialist och rekryteringsansvarig Kajsa Törnroos
(kajsa.tornroos(at)solita.se).

Hur ser processen ut?

I rekryteringsprocessen tror vi på en gedigen och effektiv process. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Om vi ser en potentiell matchning, bjuder vi in dig till ett första möte för att lära känna dig och berätta mer om vår kultur och våra värderingar på Solita. I andra intervjun fokuserar vi på din tekniska kompetens och din erfarenhet. Om allt går bra tar vi oss vidare till sista steget där vi presenterar ett erbjudande och välkomnar dig som ny Solitan!

Din arbetsplats kan vara belägen i Stockholm, Göteborg eller Malmö.

Under juli månad kan vår återkoppling dröja något längre än vanligt då vi njuter av sommarledigheter. Vi hör av oss senast i augusti. Tack för ditt tålamod och önskar dig en riktigt fin sommar!

Jag utvecklar och förvaltar plattformskomponenter, CI/CD-pipelines, säkerhetslösningar och infrastrukturlager med hjälp av teknologier som Azure DevOps, Terraform, Bicep och C#. Jag arbetar nära utvecklingsteamen för att ge tekniskt stöd, säkerställa god kvalitet i leveransen och driva förbättringar i både arbetssätt och lösningsdesign."

Vill du läsa mer om våra medarbetare på Connectivity berättar Rickard här
om sin resa hittills på Solita, samt Andrei
som haft möjlighet att bära flera hattar som både SDM, arkitekt och kravställare i ett större projekt de senaste 3 åren.

Att arbeta med AI som Integration Architect

AI är en naturlig del av hur vi arbetar;
De flesta av oss använder AI-verktyg som Copilot eller vår interna LLM-plattform dagligen - för att skriva och granska kod, testa idéer eller helt enkelt komma snabbare igenom rutinuppgifter.
Vi utforskar hur AI kan stötta integrationsarbetet. Det kan exempelvis vara att AI-agenter gör om kravspecifikationer till fungerande kod, orkestrerade flöden där agenter samlar in krav, tar fram färdiga specifikationer och skapar en pull request.
Vi hjälper även våra kunder att komma igång med AI på ett sätt som passar deras verksamhet och behov.

Det viktigaste för oss är nyfikenhet och en vilja att testa nya arbetssätt för att se var AI kan skapa verkligt värde. På sikt ser vi AI som en medutvecklare, inte en ersättare av integrationshantverket. Snarare något som gör oss snabbare och bättre i varje steg av utvecklingsprocessen.

Hur är det att jobba på Solita?

Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter en kultur med låg hierarki, hög entusiasm och värdeorienterat arbete
. Oavsett kund, projekt eller bransch har du alltid tillgång till ett stort nätverk av fantastiskt kunniga och nyfikna kollegor som gärna stöttar och delar med sig av sin kunskap. Därtill kan du ständigt lära dig nytt
genom våra kompetensnätverk, mentorskapsprogram, info sessions och möjligheten att ta olika certifieringar.

Vill du utmana dig själv, tänka nytt och leverera teknisk spetskompetens som håller långsiktigt? Du jobbar självständigt med stöd från kollegor som brinner för det vi gör och lever våra värdeord – passion, courage, easy-going och caring – i en miljö där samarbete, trygghet och människan står i centrum.

Här
kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här
kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar.

Som anställd hos Solita får du även ta del av förmåner såsom; fast lön
oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling, sjukvårdsförsäkring
via Skandia, 5000 kr i friskvårdsbidrag
, 30 semesterdagar
, after works, hobbyaktiviteter och fredagsfrukostar.

Intresserad?

Låter det som en spännande utmaning? Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt integrationsteam! Om du har några frågor, hör gärna av dig till: People Lead och rekryterande chef Sam Odeh
(sam.odeh(at)solita.se); eller Talent Acquisition Specialist och rekryteringsansvarig Kajsa Törnroos
(kajsa.tornroos(at)solita.se).

Hur ser processen ut?

I rekryteringsprocessen tror vi på en gedigen och effektiv process. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Om vi ser en potentiell matchning, bjuder vi in dig till ett första möte för att lära känna dig och berätta mer om vår kultur och våra värderingar på Solita. I andra intervjun fokuserar vi på din tekniska kompetens och din erfarenhet. Om allt går bra tar vi oss vidare till sista steget där vi presenterar ett erbjudande och välkomnar dig som ny Solitan!

Din arbetsplats kan vara belägen i Stockholm, Göteborg eller Malmö.

Under juli månad kan vår återkoppling dröja något längre än vanligt då vi njuter av sommarledigheter. Vi hör av oss senast i augusti. Tack för ditt tålamod och önskar dig en riktigt fin sommar!

new_jobs.description:

Du arbetar nära kundens verksamhet för att omsätta affärsbehov till effektiva och säkra lösningar baserade på Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM), Power Platform, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Services och Microsofts agentplattformar.
En viktig del av rollen är att hjälpa kunder att etablera och utveckla AI-funktionalitet genom Copilot Studio, AI-agenter, generativ AI och automatiserade processer samtidigt som du säkerställer governance, säkerhet, identitetshantering och efterlevnad av organisationens regelverk. Du blir en nyckelperson i implementations- och förvaltningsprojekt där du hjälper kunder att digitalisera, automatisera och AI-förstärka sina verksamhetsprocesser med hjälp av Microsofts ekosystem och Power Platform.
I rollen kommer du bland annat:

Leda workshops, kravinsamling och verksamhetsanalyser för att identifiera hur AI-agenter, Copilot-lösningar och generativ AI kan skapa affärsvärde och stödja verksamhetsprocesser.
Designa AI- och agentarkitekturer baserade på Microsofts plattform, inklusive Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Dynamics 365, Power Platform och Dataverse.
Identifiera och definiera användningsfall för AI-agenter samt omsätta affärsbehov till lösningsarkitekturer med fokus på automatisering, beslutsstöd, självbetjäning och produktivitet.
Ansvara för den tekniska lösningsdesignen av AI-agenter, inklusive orkestrering mellan agenter, integrationsmönster, datakällor, kunskapsbaser, RAG-lösningar (Retrieval Augmented Generation), agentinstruktioner och eskaleringsmekanismer.

Leda implementation och kvalitetssäkring av lösningar genom nära samarbete med utvecklare, verksamhetsexperter och lösningsarkitekter inom Dynamics 365 och Power Platform.
Driva innovation och rådgivning kring nya möjligheter inom agentbaserad AI, Copilot Studio, Azure AI och Microsofts AI-plattformar.
Stötta kunder i deras AI-resa genom utbildning, förändringsledning, arkitekturrådgivning och etablering av best practices för AI och agentutveckling.

Vi söker dig med:

Mycket goda kunskaper i konfigurering av Dynamics 365 CE/CRM och/eller Power Platform-verktygen, exempelvis Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse och Power BI.
2-4 års erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 och/eller Power Platform, exempelvis som konsult, systemansvarig eller superuser.
Praktisk erfarenhet av att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla AI-agenter och Copilot-lösningar med hjälp av Copilot Studio, Azure AI och Microsofts AI-plattformar. Förståelse för agentarkitektur, generativ AI, orkestrering, integrationsmönster och ansvarsfull AI.
God verksamhetsförståelse inom områden som försäljning, kundservice, marknadsföring eller ekonomi.
Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.

Vi är ett ledande nordiskt IT-bolag som stärker våra kunders IT-förmåga i en allt mer komplex digital värld. Med bred och djup kompetens hjälper vi organisationer att skapa stabila, säkra och moderna lösningar från applikationsutveckling och integration till infrastruktur, drift och säkerhet. Vi tar ett helhetsansvar för IT och arbetar långsiktigt, både med våra kunder och med varandra. Hos oss är gemenskap, engagemang och utveckling en självklar del av vardagen. När vi trivs och växer tillsammans skapar vi också större värde.
