new_jobs.description:
Description

Looking to be part of a team building hyper-scale database services in the cloud? Do you want to revolutionize the way people manage vast volumes of data in the cloud where you have direct and immediate impact on hundreds of thousands of users who use AWS database services?

Aurora is a distributed, fault-tolerant database service, leveraging a self-healing storage system which performs up to five times faster than standard MySQL databases and three times faster than standard PostgreSQL databases.

Aurora is one of the fastest-growing AWS services, with business and engineering decisions having a widespread impact across many of the world's fastest growing businesses! Our customers depend on the performance of our services to scale and support their mission-critical workloads.

Operating much like a start-up, we have a very flat organizational structure and a casual office vibe, but leverage all the resources and stability of being the largest cloud provider.

We are looking for Software Development Engineers who have built software and shipped products. You should be passionate about optimizing the software development experience at a very large scale, using your strong technical skills and motivation to achieve results. You are naturally enthusiastic about learning new technologies and industry trends and are excited by the idea of solving hard technical challenges.

Aurora is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Come, join us in reinventing database systems for the cloud!

Key job responsibilities

These are core systems development positions where you will grow to own the design and development of significant system software components critical to our industry leading database services architected for the cloud. You will be part of the team that architects, designs, and implements highly scalable distributed database systems that provide availability, reliability and performance guarantees. This is a hands-on position where you will be asked to do everything from building rock-solid components to mentoring other engineers. You need to be not only a top software developer with a good track record of delivering, but also excel in communication, leadership and customer focus. This is a unique and rare opportunity to get in on the ground floor within a fast-growing business and help shape the technology and the product.

An AWS Senior Software Development Engineer on the Aurora Developer Experience team drives the architecture, design, and implementation of high-performance, fault-tolerant database services. They lead cross-organizational projects, mentor engineers, and own the full software development lifecycle to improve customer experience at scale.

About The Team

The Amazon Aurora Control Plane team builds and manages the essential service components, APIs, and workflows that orchestrate, scale, and secure Aurora’s distributed database infrastructure. Operating like a startup within AWS, the team focuses on reliability, high availability, and performance for cloud-native databases.

About The Team & Role

Focus Area: The team focuses on enhancing developer experience, operational ownership, and creating intelligent tools to make Aurora faster.

Culture: It is described as having a flat structure with a "startup-like" environment, high-ownership, and a collaborative, fast-paced atmosphere.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
Experience in professional, non-internship software development
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

new_jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
new_jobs.location: Fredericia, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
new_jobs.description:
I Domestic Payment Capturing har vi ansvaret for brugeroplevelsen og de services, der gør det muligt at oprette indlandsbetalinger sikkert, stabilt og effektivt for både privat og erhverv.

Det er et område med stor betydning for både brugere, banker og forretning og med mange spændende tekniske og domænemæssige problemstillinger.

Rollen: Byg robuste services med fokus på både kode, brugere og drift

Som Senior Backend Developer bliver du en del af teamet bag oprettelse af indlandsbetalinger. Du kommer til at udvikle API’er, arbejde med test, vedligeholde eksisterende kode og bidrage til nyudvikling af moderne services i et agilt setup.

Du indgår i en rolle, hvor du både løser opgaver på egen hånd og samarbejder tæt med andre. Du er med til at planlægge og eksekvere opgaver i sprint, bryde større problemstillinger ned i mindre leverancer og skabe fremdrift på en måde, hvor teamet kan følge med, bidrage og bygge videre.

En vigtig del af rollen er at bidrage til høj kvalitet gennem clean code, automatisering af test og drift samt en god forståelse for security, compliance, observability og robusthed. Du er også med til at udvikle teamets arbejde med Domain Driven Design, Event Driven Design og moderne servicearkitektur.

Hvordan succes ser ud efter 6–12 måneder

Efter 6–12 måneder har du opbygget en solid forståelse for betalingsdomænet og kan finde rundt i centrale data, flows og afhængigheder:

Du leverer på udviklingsopgaver og bidrager i refinement, reviews, retrospectives og teamets løbende prioriteringer.
Du hjælper med at omsætte komplekse behov til tekniske løsninger, der kan udvikles, testes og releases sikkert.
Du gør risici, afhængigheder og usikkerheder synlige i tide og bidrager med forslag til, hvordan teamet kan håndtere dem.
Du bidrager også til teamets arbejde med DDD og moderne serviceudvikling – både gennem kode, sparring, reviews og konkrete forbedringsforslag.

Succes handler ikke om at kende alt fra start, men om at lære domænet, dele viden og skabe værdi sammen med teamet.

Teamet: Et engageret fagligt fællesskab, hvor viden deles åbent

Du bliver en del af Domestic Payment Capturing, et team på 14 personer med høj faglighed og dyb domæneviden: en Product Owner, to forretningskonsulenter, ti softwareudviklere og en manager.

Vi arbejder i et agilt setup inspireret af Scrum med to-ugers sprint, daglige standups og faste ceremonier. Hverdagen er præget af tæt samarbejde, åben sparring og en kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, når opgaverne bliver komplekse. Det er helt forventeligt at stille spørgsmål, dele synspunkter og udfordre løsninger på en respektfuld måde – både i hverdagen og i forbindelse med reviews og retrospectives.

Som seniorprofil bidrager du ikke kun med kode, men også med ro, overblik og faglig sparring. Du kommunikerer tekniske emner klart til både udviklere, forretningskolleger og andre interessenter, og du hjælper med at skabe en arbejdsform, hvor flere kan bidrage og løfte nye opgaver.

Teamet har p.t. faste hjemmearbejdsdage tirsdag og fredag og arbejder fleksibelt, når hverdagen kræver det.

Profilen vi søger: Solid backend-erfaring og lyst til at udvikle andre

Du har mindst fem års professionel erfaring som softwareudvikler og en relevant baggrund som eksempelvis datalog, softwareingeniør eller datamatiker.
Du har solid erfaring med Spring Boot eller andet OOP som C#/.NET, Node.js eller lignend.
Du har praktisk erfaring med API-design, test og værktøjer som Postman eller Insomnia.
Du arbejder med CI/CD, automatisering og kvalitet som en naturlig del af udviklingsprocessen.
Derudover ser vi, at du har arbejdet med microservices, observability og drift af services i et komplekst miljø - og måske også haft de første erfaringer med Agentic AI.

Som person er du nysgerrig, omhyggelig og motiveret af at skabe løsninger, der fungerer i praksis. Du trives med at forstå både teknik, brugerbehov og forretningsmæssig kontekst, og du deler gerne din viden, så andre kan bygge videre på den. Du behøver ikke kunne alt på forhånd, men du skal have lyst til at lære, stille gode spørgsmål og bidrage til fælles tekniske valg.

Udviklingsmuligheder: Fordyb dig i komplekse systemer og moderne arkitektur

Rollen giver dig mulighed for at udvikle dig i et komplekst betalingsdomæne med store datamængder, høj samfundsmæssig relevans og tydelige krav til kvalitet, sikkerhed og stabilitet.

Du får mulighed for at tage ansvar for egne services og produkter og fordybe dig fagligt inden for moderne backendudvikling, cloud, eventbaseret arkitektur, DDD, observability og automatisering.

Du får også mulighed for at påvirke teamets tekniske retning og bidrage til best practices i et område med mange nye opgaver og høj ledelsesmæssig opmærksomhed.

Klar til at være med til at forme indlandsbetalinger?

Har du lyst til at bruge din backend-erfaring til at bygge robuste services, dele viden og bidrage til et team, der lykkes sammen, vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Velkommen til Bankdata

Bankdata bygger software til finanssektoren. Vi er næsten 1000 kolleger på holdet, og vi udvikler digitale produkter, platforme og infrastruktur, som ca. hver tredje dansker, 200.000 virksomheder og flere tusinde bankansatte bruger hver dag.

Vi tror på struktureret personlig udvikling, et solidt kollegialt fællesskab og at ambitiøse medarbejdere med fleksible og bæredygtige arbejdsliv præsterer bedre. Bliv klogere på arbejdslivet i Bankdata her
.

Hos Bankdata arbejder vi målrettet med at fremme mangfoldighed og diversitet blandt vores medarbejdere, og vi opfordrer derfor alle uanset kønsidentitet, alder og kulturel baggrund til at søge job hos os.

Bankdata er en af Danmarks vigtigste teknologivirksomheder. Vi går på arbejde for at finde teknologiske svar på finanssektorens forretningsproblemer. For at udvikle og bygge fremtidens digitale bank.

build the financial modelling foundation that powers real advisory conversations

Java‑based backend with strong domain‑driven design principles

Increasingly AI‑augmented workflows we invest actively in AI tooling and expect developers to help shape how we use it

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI in semiconductor manufacturing and directly contribute to Micron's vision of autonomous, data-driven operations worldwide.

Design, architect, and build end-to-end AI products, including data ingestion pipelines, feature engineering, model training and inference, APIs, web applications, and observability frameworks.

Optimize AI application performance and cost through caching, batching, GPU utilization, model quantization, and inference optimization strategies.

Track record of delivering solutions in complex cross-functional environments spanning software engineering, data science, robotics, manufacturing, automation, and infrastructure teams.
Experience designing and deploying scalable AI applications, APIs, and data-driven solutions in production environments.

PALMET Bilgi Teknolojileri, yaklaşık 2,5 milyonmüşteriye hizmet veren PALMET Grubu'nun teknoloji motorudur. Doğalgaz dağıtımından enerji üretimine uzanan kritik operasyonları destekleyen kurumsal yazılım ürünleri geliştiririz. Yüksek erişilebilirlik, veri yoğunluklu işlemler ve yapay zekâ entegrasyonu gündemimizin merkezindedir.

Bu rolde katman geliştiren değil; mimari kararlar alan, sistemin bütününü sahiplenen ve ekibin teknik kalitesini yukarı taşıyan bir Senior Fullstack Software Engineer arıyoruz. Altyapı ve DevSecOps süreçleri ayrı bir ekip tarafından yönetilmektedir; bu rol geliştirdiği mikroservislerin doğru containerize edilmesinden, GitLab CI/CD pipeline'ına uyumlu teslim edilmesinden ve platform standartlarına uymaktan sorumludur.

Sorumluluklar

• Kurumsal enerji uygulamalarının uçtan uca (frontend + backend + veritabanı) tasarımı ve geliştirilmesi
• Domain-Driven Design (DDD) prensipleriyle bounded context, aggregate ve domain event modellemesi yapmak
• Microservice mimarisi kapsamında servis sınırlarını belirlemek, servisler arası iletişim (REST / gRPC / message queue) tasarlamak
• RabbitMQ / Kafka gibi mesaj kuyruğu altyapılarıyla event-driven akışlar kurmak ve yönetmek
• Redis / distributed cache stratejileri tasarlamak; cache invalidation ve consistency politikalarını uygulamak
• MinIO / S3-uyumlu nesne depolama entegrasyonu; bucket politikaları, presigned URL ve uygulama katmanı kullanımı
• Entity Framework Core ile ORM katmanı kurmak; migration yönetimi, lazy/eager loading optimizasyonu ve N+1 sorunu çözümü
• MSSQL üzerinde T-SQL, stored procedure ve sorgu optimizasyonu; index stratejisi geliştirmek
• Geliştirdiği servisleri Dockerfile standartlarına uygun containerize etmek; DevOps ekibinin belirlediği GitLab CI/CD pipeline'ına uyumlu çalışmak
• CORS politikalarını uygulama katmanında doğru yapılandırmak; reverse proxy ve API gateway arkasında çalışacak servisleri buna göre tasarlamak
• Load balancer ve reverse proxy önünde çalışacak servislerin stateless, health-check uyumlu ve graceful shutdown destekli geliştirilmesini sağlamak
• Unit / integration test yazımı; code coverage hedeflerini belirlemek ve karşılamak (xUnit, NUnit, Moq)
• RESTful API tasarımı (OpenAPI/Swagger), versiyonlama ve geriye dönük uyumluluk yönetimi
• Yapay zekâ destekli özelliklerin ürünlere entegrasyonu; log analizi, anomali tespiti ve akıllı öneri mekanizmaları geliştirmek
• Code review kültürünü sürdürmek; teknik dokümantasyon ve ADR (Architecture Decision Record) yazmak

Aranan Nitelikler

• Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümden mezun
• En az 5 yıl yazılım geliştirme deneyimi; bunun en az 2 yılı üretim ortamında fullstack projelerde
• Backend: C# / .NET 6+ — DDD, CQRS, Clean Architecture deneyimi
• ORM: Entity Framework Core — migration, performans optimizasyonu, repository pattern
• Frontend: React, Angular veya Vue.js ile üretim ölçekli SPA geliştirme deneyimi
• Mesajlaşma: RabbitMQ veya Kafka ile event-driven / async iletişim deneyimi
• Cache: Redis veya benzeri distributed cache altyapısı kullanımı
• Nesne Depolama: MinIO (S3-uyumlu) — SDK entegrasyonu, bucket yönetimi, presigned URL kullanımı
• Veritabanı: MSSQL / PostgreSQL — T-SQL, stored procedure, index ve sorgu optimizasyonu
• API & Ağ: REST API tasarımı, CORS yönetimi; reverse proxy ve API gateway arkasında çalışacak servis geliştirme
• Test: Unit ve integration test yazımı, code coverage metrikleri takibi
• Containerization: Dockerfile yazımı, image optimizasyonu, multi-stage build
• CI/CD: GitLab CI pipeline'ına uyumlu çalışma; merge request, branch stratejisi, environment değişkeni yönetimi
• Versiyon Kontrol: Git-flow, branch stratejisi, GitLab merge request süreci
• Analitik düşünce yapısı, teknik sahiplenme ve çözüm odaklılık

Tercihen

• gRPC ile servisler arası iletişim deneyimi
• Kubernetes ortamında çalışan servisler geliştirme deneyimi (Helm values, liveness/readiness probe, resource limit tanımları)
• OpenTelemetry ile distributed tracing ve structured logging deneyimi
• OAuth2 / OpenID Connect — Keycloak entegrasyonu
• On-premise LLM inference (Ollama, vLLM vb.) veya model entegrasyonu deneyimi
• Enerji, finans veya telecom gibi regulated / mission-critical sektörlerde proje deneyimi
• Teknik mentorluk veya küçük ekip yönlendirme tecrübesi

Enerji altyapısının dijital omurgasını cloud-native ve event-driven mimarilerle yeniden inşa ederken, yapay zekâ destekli yeni nesil ürünler geliştirmek isteyen mühendisleri ekibimize bekliyoruz.

.

new_jobs.description:
Regular

1. Présentation de l’ETNIC

L’ETNIC (Entreprise pour les Technologies de l’Information et de la Communication) est l’opérateur informatique de la Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles. Organisme d’intérêt public, l’ETNIC a pour mission de concevoir, développer, maintenir et faire évoluer les systèmes d’information et les infrastructures technologiques au service des administrations et établissements de la FWB.

Acteur central de la transformation numérique du secteur public francophone belge, l’ETNIC intervient dans des domaines variés tels que :

La gestion des infrastructures IT (réseaux, sécurité, data centers, cloud),
Le développement d’applications métiers sur mesure,
L’accompagnement des projets digitaux (analyse fonctionnelle, UX/UI, gestion de projet),
La cybersécurité et la protection des données,
Le support utilisateurs et la formation.

Dans un souci constant d’innovation, de performance et de service public, l’ETNIC collabore régulièrement avec des partenaires externes pour renforcer ses équipes à travers des missions de consultance IT. Ces collaborations s’inscrivent dans un cadre éthique, professionnel et orienté vers la qualité et l’impact concret des solutions livrées

2. Mission

Dans le cadre du programme ZEPHYR de l’Office de la Naissance et de l’Enfance (ONE)
, la mission d’Application Architect / Leader Technique couvre de nombreux aspects tels que l’élaboration de propositions d'architecture applicative, le développement, l'expertise technique, l'identification de solutions pour l’implémentation de systèmes complexes.

En tant qu’Application Architect / Leader technique, vous êtes responsable de l’implémentation de la solution, de la qualité du code et de la cohérence technique, des performances et des livraisons du produit. En tant que responsable du développement des applications, vous travaillez en collaboration avec les analystes fonctionnels et métiers, les testeurs, le chef de projet et les spécialistes du middleware afin de mener à bien les implémentations. Vous êtes responsable de la qualité du livrable et de la diffusion des bonnes pratiques en matière de design et de développement.

Les projets du programme ZEPHYR :

DOMES V2

Ce projet s’inscrit dans le domaine de l’accompagnement des enfants de 0 à 6 ans. Il vise à permettre aux professionnels de l’ONE de gérer le dossier de l’enfant, de l’éditer, de créer des consultations et de planifier les rendez-vous dans l’Agenda en lien avec le suivi de l’enfant.

Prénatal V1

Dans le cadre de l’accueil et du suivi médico-social de la future mère, Prénatal V1
vise à digitaliser le dossier social de la future mère
. La solution permet de soutenir les professionnels de l’ONE dans le suivi et l’accompagnement social des futures mères, tout au long de leur parcours au sein des services concernés.

e-VAX 2.0

Le projet e-VAX 2.0 vise à remplacer l’actuelle solution e-VAX CCR et à moderniser la gestion des données de vaccination. Il permettra notamment d’améliorer la collecte et l’échange des données vaccinales, de mettre en place une carte de vaccination transversale
et de renforcer le suivi de la chaîne d’approvisionnement des vaccins. La solution contribuera également au pilotage du programme de vaccination grâce à l’exploitation des données et à des fonctionnalités d’aide à la décision.

La mission s’inscrit dans un environnement Agile / SCRUM, avec une architecture orientée services et un environnement technique principalement basé sur Java et Angular.

Le stack technologique repose sur : Angular 21, JAVA8 / JEE7, Java 21, Sprint Boot, NgRx, DB2, MySQL, Flyway, …

Les outils de build sont : Apache Maven, Git/GitLab CI/CD, Nexus.

3. Activités

Conception

Créer et mettre à jour le document d’architecture logicielle.
Elaborer la conception et l’analyse technique sur base du dossier fonctionnel.
Elaborer et faire appliquer les bonnes pratiques de développement : clean code, principes SOLID, DRY, ….

Réalisation

Collaborer en tant qu’expert technique, avec son équipe de développeurs.
Développer des modules applicatifs.
Optimiser le code en fonction de la gestion mémoire et des temps réponse.
Organiser le refactoring en simplifiant le code existant.
Organiser les revues de code.
Valider le développement et les tests unitaires.
Réaliser la maintenance corrective et évolutive.

Déploiement

Valider le déploiement et la livraison de la solution.
Veiller au bon comportement de l’application dans les différents environnements d’exécution.

Qualité

Veiller à la qualité des développements réalisés par l’équipe en lien avec les standards d’entreprise.
Appliquer et vérifier l’application des standards méthodologiques et technologiques définis par l’ETNIC.
Veiller au respect des délais.
Adopter les bonnes pratiques de réduction de la dette technologique (clean code, upgrade de librairies, frameworks…)
Assurer du coaching, du mentorat envers l’équipe de développeurs sous sa responsabilité technologique.

Communication

Communiquer avec les différents intervenants de la réalisation des lots de travaux et de donner un feedback régulier à son team leader sur les activités qui lui sont assignées.
Assister le team leader dans la qualification et l’évaluation des lots de travaux.

Das bietet dir die Stelle

Als Business Application Manager:in Integration Platform verantwortest du den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Integrationslandschaft über Systemgrenzen hinweg (SAP, D365, FSM und weitere Applikationen)
Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreibst unsere neue Azure-Integrationsplattform mit Technologien wie API-Management, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid und Function Apps

Du übernimmst die fachliche und technische Verantwortung für Schnittstellen und Integrationsthemen entlang des gesamten Lebenszyklus und koordinierst als zentrale Ansprechperson die Zusammenarbeit mit Applikationsverantwortlichen, Architektur, Security sowie externen Partnern

Du verfügst über eine höhere Ausbildung in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung und bringst ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für technische Zusammenhänge mit
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau, Betrieb und der Weiterentwicklung komplexer System- und Integrationslandschaften ermöglicht es dir, auch anspruchsvolle Herausforderungen erfolgreich zu meistern
Im Azure Integration Stack verfügst du über fundierte Kenntnisse in Technologien wie Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API-Management sowie Service Bus und Event Grid
Erfahrungen in der Softwareentwicklung mit Python und/oder C# sowie mit modernen DevOps-Werkzeugen, CI/CD-Pipelines und Code-Repositorys ergänzen dein Profil
Idealerweise konntest du bereits Kenntnisse in SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 oder FSM sammeln und verstehst die Anforderungen moderner Unternehmensanwendungen
Du analysierst komplexe Zusammenhänge, denkst vernetzt und entwickelst daraus nachhaltige Lösungen
Du vertrittst deine Position überzeugend und kannst dich durchsetzen
Du fühlst dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT wohl und verstehst es, unterschiedliche Stakeholder für gemeinsame Lösungen an einen Tisch zu bringen
Für diese Rolle bringst du sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit

Noch nicht überzeugt? V-ZUG bietet dir mehr als nur einen Job

Als Teil der V-ZUG Familie profitierst du von zeitgemässen Anstellungsbedingungen, vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, geeigneter Infrastruktur sowie zahlreichen Angeboten und Dienstleistungen für dein persönliches Wohlbefinden.

Du arbeitest dort, wo die Perfektion unserer Produkte tagtäglich spürbar ist – von der Produktentwicklung über die Produktion bis hin zum Vertrieb. Zudem profitierst du von der direkten Verkehrsanbindung für Bus, Bahn und Auto, einem Mobilitätsbeitrag und vergünstigten Parkplätzen. Auch das Vergnügen kommt nicht zu kurz: So geniesst du im eigenen Personalrestaurant ausgewogene Menüs oder entspannst bei einer Massage im Sitzen, beides zu vergünstigten Preisen.

Wir fördern dein Wohlbefinden und deinen optimalen Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Freizeit. Innerhalb regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen und entsprechend den Anforderungen der Arbeitsaufgaben hast du als Mitarbeiter:in der V-ZUG grösstmögliche Flexibilität. Egal, ob im Teilzeitmodell, Homeoffice oder Jobsharing – du arbeitest wann, wo und wie du am produktivsten bist.

Deine individuelle Entwicklung ist uns wichtig. Wir helfen dir dabei, deine Karriere durch kontinuierliche Aus- und Weiterbildungen, inspirierende Mentorinnen und Mentoren und eine Vielzahl an geeigneten Lernressourcen zu perfektionieren. Weiter bestehen zahlreiche Aktivitäten für ein unfallfreies und gesundes Arbeitsumfeld. So bleibst du als Profi rundum fit – heute und morgen.

Wir leben durchs Band den Grundsatz der Gleichstellung. Neben einer marktgerechten und fairen Entlöhnung trumpfen wir mit überdurchschnittlichen Sozialleistungen. Da wir auf einen Koordinationsabzug verzichten, profitieren auch Mitarbeitende mit Teilzeitarbeit von unserer Vorsorgelösung.

Eine weitere Selbstverständlichkeit ist für uns die vergünstigte Abgabe von V-ZUG Produkten an dich und deine Familienangehörigen.

Ausserdem stehen dir für deinen aktiven Ausgleich zur Arbeit vielfältige und attraktive Freizeitangebote zur Verfügung, bei welchen du von mehreren Vergünstigungen profitierst.

Als Arbeitgeberin schaffen wir eine wertschätzende Arbeitskultur, welche Neugier, neue Herangehensweisen sowie fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch das Erlernen neuer Kompetenzen fördert. Bei V-ZUG hast du die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft eines traditionsreichen Unternehmens voranzutreiben. Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dein volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Gemeinsam leisten wir täglich einen Beitrag für unsere Vision „Wir bringen Leichtigkeit in Ihr Zuhause und Kreativität in Ihre Küche“. Darauf sind wir stolz.

Wir stehen für eine bunte V-ZUG ein, indem wir Rahmenbedingungen schaffen, um von der existierenden Diversität im Unternehmen gegenseitig profitieren zu können. Was uns alle verbindet, ist der Teamgeist und die Passion für die Marke V-ZUG. Wir arbeiten eng und kollaborativ zusammen, vertrauen uns gegenseitig und begegnen unseren Mitmenschen mit Respekt und Interesse. Wir akzeptieren keinerlei Diskriminierung und sind überzeugt: Inklusion und Diversität machen unser Unternehmen stark und attraktiv. Jeder Einzelne und jede Einzelne trägt dazu bei, das „wir“ voranzubringen.

Als Arbeitgeberin verstehen wir es als Pflicht, die Mitarbeitenden für die Nachhaltigkeit zu sensibilisieren. So lancierten wir unter anderem ein Training zum Thema „Nachhaltigkeit und Ressourcenknappheit“ und starteten die V-ACT Challenge, bei welcher wir auf spielerische und aktivierende Art etwas Gutes für die Umwelt tun konnten. Darüber hinaus wurden sogenannte Awareness-Ambassadors in den Teams ernannt, welche monatliche Schwerpunktthemen vermitteln. Solche Initiativen sind nicht zuletzt eine hervorragende Gelegenheit für unsere Mitarbeitenden, eigene Anregungen für mehr Nachhaltigkeit bei V-ZUG einzubringen.

Angekommen! Wir prüfen deine Online-Bewerbung und melden uns nach deren Prüfung sofort bei dir.
Deine Bewerbung überzeugt! Nun möchten wir dich gerne kennenlernen. Du erhältst eine Einladung zum Online-Interview.

Shape the Future of Data & AI at Damen

At Damen Shipyards Group, we are accelerating the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across our global organization. From shipbuilding and engineering to procurement, finance, services, and operations, AI is becoming a key enabler of how we work, innovate, and create value.

To support this ambition, we are establishing the AI Value Lab
, a dedicated team focused on identifying, developing, validating, and scaling AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business impact. We are investing in people, platforms, and capabilities that help transform promising AI technologies into practical business outcomes.

We are not looking for someone who simply configures tools.

We are looking for someone who loves understanding how AI works beneath the surface, enjoys experimenting with new models and technologies, and gets excited about turning ideas into working solutions. You may come from software development, automation, AI engineering, digital transformation, product development, data science, or a similar environment where curiosity, innovation, and hands-on problem solving are part of your daily work.

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a global maritime leader and contribute directly to Damen's ambition of becoming a more Human-Led and Data-Powered organization.

The Role

As an AI Solution Developer, you will serve as the technical explorer and hands-on builder within the AI Value Lab. You will rapidly translate business opportunities into proof-of-concepts, prototypes, AI agents, automations, and scalable solutions that improve how people work and make decisions.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, Data & AI specialists, AI Ambassadors, developers, and technology teams to identify opportunities, test emerging technologies, and transform successful experiments into reliable business solutions.

The role requires a balance between technical curiosity, practical problem solving, experimentation, business understanding, and solution delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Build AI Solutions

Translate business challenges into Proof of Concepts (PoCs), prototypes, and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs)
Design, develop, and maintain AI-powered applications, copilots, intelligent agents, and automation solutions
Build solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI Services, and related technologies
Create integrations between AI solutions, business systems, APIs, and data sources
Support the transition of successful prototypes into production-ready business solutions
Continuously improve solution performance, reliability, and user experience

Explore & Experiment

Evaluate emerging AI models, tools, frameworks, and technologies
Test new development approaches including GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and similar platforms
Experiment with prompt engineering, agent orchestration, workflow automation, and knowledge integration
Identify innovative AI use cases and opportunities across the business
Contribute to the development of AI best practices, standards, and methodologies

Collaborate & Enable Adoption

Work directly with business stakeholders to understand challenges and opportunities
Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Create demonstrations, training materials, and documentation to support adoption
Support the measurement and monitoring of business value generated by AI initiatives
Promote responsible, secure, and governed use of AI technologies

Experience

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Science, Business Analytics, Digital Innovation, or a related field
3-6 years of experience in solution development, automation, software engineering, business applications, or digital transformation
At least 2 years of hands-on experience working with AI technologies or AI-enabled solutions
Experience delivering business applications, automation solutions, or digital products in a professional environment
Experience collaborating with business stakeholders to solve complex business problems
Experience working in fast-moving, innovation-focused environments is highly desirable

Technical Expertise

Microsoft Copilot Studio
Power Platform and Power Automate
Azure AI Services
AI Agents and Agent Orchestration
Prompt Engineering
GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar AI-assisted development platforms
Python, JavaScript, or similar scripting languages
APIs, Connectors, and Systems Integration
Workflow Automation
Business Application Development
AI Solution Design and Prototyping

Personal Attributes

Naturally curious about Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Hands-on builder with a passion for experimenting and learning
Comfortable working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving technologies
Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias towards action
Strong communicator who can bridge business and technology
Results-oriented and focused on delivering measurable business value
Continuously learning and exploring new tools, models, and techniques
Thrives in environments where innovation, ownership, and initiative are encouraged

Why Join Damen?

At Damen, you will help shape how AI is adopted across a global organization operating in shipbuilding, engineering, services, and maritime innovation. You will have the opportunity to work on real business challenges while exploring some of the most exciting developments in artificial intelligence.

As part of the AI Value Lab, you will collaborate with AI specialists, business leaders, and technology experts to create solutions that improve productivity, decision-making, and operational excellence across Damen. You will be empowered to experiment, innovate, and build solutions that generate tangible business impact.

If you're the type of person who tests new AI models for fun, builds side projects to learn how things work, automates repetitive tasks because you can, and believes the best way to understand AI is to build with it, this role was created for you.

new_jobs.title: Senior Unity Developer - Core Game Tech (f/m/d)
new_jobs.description:
We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come.

Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

Senior Unity Developer - Core Game Tech (f/m/d)

We are looking for a Senior Unity Developer to join our Core Game Tech (CGT) Team — the small, senior team behind the technology that every Kolibri game runs on.

Our work spans consulting game teams on technical decisions, investigating problems where nobody has defined the requirements yet, and building the systems and integrations that the games depend on. That ranges from compliance features and third-party SDKs to shared systems, standardization and keeping our engine and tooling current.

You'll work in a small specialized team alongside technical decision makers to have strong impact on all the games across our portfolio.

If you like being the person who takes on the technical problems other teams can't, and you don't shy away from constantly diving into new unknowns, learning new skills and driving topics forward, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Design and build the shared systems multiple live games with dynamic events and scheduled content for millions of users run on
Drive third-party integrations and keep the portfolio current: evaluate and integrate SDKs, drive SDK and Unity version upgrades, and understand the impact across every game before it lands
Advise game teams as their technical counterpart, driving standardization and winning adoption of shared solutions on the strength of the work and the argument
Deliver compliance and privacy features across the portfolio, such as age assurance APIs, CMP implementations and GDPR data deletion flows
Investigate open-ended technical problems and turn regulations, vendor changes and internal needs into concrete technical requirements

Required Skills

(Ideally 5+ years of professional) Software development experience in C# and Unity3D. Experience in non-gaming contexts is also relevant; we value your expertise, so do not hesitate to apply
You have a wide understanding of how Unity works, you are familiar with native implementations, understand backend interactions, and performance investigations are your bread and butter. The most important skill is to be able to jump into the unknown and get familiar
Strong written and spoken communication, and the credibility to make teams you don't sit with want to adopt your solutions
Experience building libraries, packages, APIs or tooling that other developers consume, and an instinct for what makes them adoptable
Ability to plan, communicate, and execute technical solutions in a way that is both understandable for other developers as well as non technical stakeholders
Ability to derive requirements yourself from ambiguous or external sources — regulation, platform policy, vendor documentation — rather than working from a written spec
A genuine appetite for constantly learning new areas of the stack

Desirable Skills

Experience debugging below the C# layer into Android and iOS platform code, and profiling performance on mobile
Exposure to compliance, privacy or platform policy work — GDPR, CMP, age assurance, ATT or similar
Familiarity with reactive or async programming and dependency injection frameworks, e.g. UniRx, Zenject, UniTask
A passion for games and an understanding of the mobile market, like F2P and LiveOps
Strong familiarity with using LLMs in different areas of game development to support your efforts and achieve stronger results
Familiarity with Firebase Crashlytics and an understanding of ANRs

Kolibri Games is an equal opportunity employer. We come from 40 different countries and many different backgrounds. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, physical appearance or disability.

We are an international studio, so don’t forget to send in your application in English. Although it is not mandatory, we always appreciate a cover letter stating your motivation to join us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Your Benefits – We’re game to support you

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - Menu
new_jobs.description:
Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI.

Your new role

In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘ Menu’ team, which is part of the wider ‘ Order’ engineering group.

The Menu team owns and operates all of the systems involved with managing, publishing and accessing billions of menu records. Menus change in real time and their accuracy is essential for the proper operation of our customer’s businesses. Consequently, the Menu team’s scope includes some of the most sophisticated and performance sensitive parts of Olo’s infrastructure. A deep understanding of garbage collection, network latency, and database internals comes with the territory. If you are looking for a challenge, you will find it here.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Demonstrate a solid understanding of the Menu team's domain and technology stack, contributing to discussions and development decisions with growing independence.
Handle small-to-medium features independently and begin taking ownership of moderately complex tasks with some guidance.
Write clean, maintainable code and actively participate in peer code reviews, providing constructive feedback and adhering to coding standards.
Collaborate closely with Product to refine requirements, helping to shape solutions that meet business needs effectively.
Focus on delivering high-quality software solutions within established timelines, emphasising best practices in software development.
Engage in troubleshooting and debugging efforts, showing an ability to resolve common and moderately complex issues with minimal support.
Assist in the deployment and monitoring of services, learning how to manage and troubleshoot issues in production environments.
Contribute to building and maintaining reliable distributed systems, implementing resilience mechanisms as appropriate.
Participate actively in team ceremonies and demonstrate initiative by taking ownership of tasks and helping to unblock others when possible.
Engage in continuous learning and self-improvement by exploring new technologies and best practices relevant to the team's work.
Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot extensively as part of your daily workflow, and grow your skills through hands-on AI training designed to help you become highly effective with modern AI coding agents and IDEs.
Demonstrate ownership of the team's delivery pipeline, ensuring that code quality, testing standards, and deployment practices are continuously optimised.
Active participation in on-call duties is required, with specific responsibilities determined by your assigned team and area of expertise.

What Will Set You Up For Success

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience in software engineering.
Proficient in the .Net/C# ecosystem and capable of independently implementing moderately complex features and algorithms.
Experience using version control tools (e.g., GitHub) and participating in continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, TeamCity).
Proficient in writing and maintaining unit and integration tests, demonstrating an understanding of test-driven development (TDD) principles (e.g., NUnit, Jest).
Deeper understanding of distributed systems, including building scalable and resilient services (e.g., Redis, Kafka, AWS infrastructure).
Show strong problem-solving skills and collaborate effectively with team members, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver solutions that align with business objectives.

About Olo

Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. Learn more at olo.com.

Digital Developer

Location: London Bridge

Hybrid, 2 days per week on-site

Full time, 37.5 hours per week, Monday-Friday

Permanent

We are seeking a talented and experienced Sitecore Developer to join our Digital IT team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the development, maintenance, enhancement, and optimisation of enterprise-level websites and digital platforms built on the Sitecore Experience Platform (XP) and associated Microsoft technologies.

Working closely with Digital Product Owners, UX Designers, Digital Marketing teams, and technical stakeholders, you will deliver scalable, high-performing digital solutions that provide exceptional customer experiences while supporting business objectives.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both project-based development and ongoing support of business-critical digital platforms.

Above all else, we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life. It’s this guiding vision that influences everything we do at HCA UK. From the CEO to the colleagues on the floor we all have a part to play in delivering exceptional care to our patients. Others may think this is just a role in Digital IT, but to us, you’ll be part of a wider team with a unique sense of purpose, one that helps improve lives on a daily basis.

What You’ll Do

Design, develop and maintain websites and digital applications using Sitecore.
Build reusable Sitecore components, templates, rendering items and workflows.
Develop custom integrations between Sitecore and third-party systems, APIs, CRM platforms and Microsoft services.
Participate in the full software development lifecycle from requirements gathering through QA, deployment and support.
Provide ongoing support, troubleshooting, upgrades and enhancements for existing Sitecore environments.
Collaborate with UX, Digital Marketing and technical teams to deliver personalised digital experiences and continuous platform improvements.

What You’ll Bring

Proven experience developing solutions/forms using Sitecore XP/AI/XM.
Strong knowledge of C#, ASP.NET MVC, .NET Framework and/or .NET Core.
Experience developing at the Sitecore component level on both the Microsoft stack and the NextJS stack.
Experience developing RESTful APIs, system integrations and working with SQL Server.
Experience using modern development pipeline practices including GitHub, Git actions, CI/CD, peer review and DevSecOps tooling.

Why HCA UK?

Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. Being part of a large multisite, established healthcare group we can offer you unrivalled opportunities for career progression through internal and external courses, as well as working conditions that prioritise both your mental and physical wellbeing.

Benefits

By caring for our employees, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients. That's why we offer a host of flexible benefits that reflect the invaluable contribution they make every day. As a Digital Developer
you'll be eligible for:

25 days holiday each year (plus bank holidays) increasing with service, with option to buy or sell leave to suit you
Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
Group Life Assurance from day one
Critical illness cover
Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you
Discounts with over 800 major retailers

Culture and values

At HCA UK we believe exceptional care starts with our people. We celebrate the unique perspectives and different experiences each of us bring as we know that when you feel seen, heard and supported you can be at your best for our patients, and each other.

Our Mission Is Simple, Above All Else We’re Committed To The Care And Improvement Of Human Life, a Clear Statement That Extends To Both Our Patients And Colleagues. To Achieve This, We Live And Breathe Four Core Values

Unique and Individual: We recognise and value everyone as unique and individual
Kindness and compassion: We treat people with kindness and compassion
Honesty, integrity and fairness: We act with absolute honesty, integrity and fairness
Loyalty, respect and dignity: We trust and treat one another as valued members of the HCA UK family with loyalty, respect and dignity

Reasonable adjustments

We believe everyone should feel comfortable to bring their full self to work and be afforded the same opportunities. As a Disability Confident committed organisation, we’re happy to discuss flexible working arrangements to suit your needs as well as offer reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process, and in the workplace, to anyone that needs them.

new_jobs.description:
Join TRG Screen: Building World-Class Teams. One Expert at a Time.

Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team at the forefront of subscription spend management innovation?

At TRG Screen, we're not just redefining how organizations manage their subscription expenses – we're shaping the future of the industry. With cutting-edge solutions and a commitment to excellence, we empower businesses around the globe to optimize their subscription investments and drive sustainable growth.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize subscription management and make a meaningful impact on the way businesses access and utilize critical information. At TRG Screen, your talent and ambition will find a home, where opportunities for growth and advancement abound.

About TRG Screen

TRG Screen is the leading provider of market data and subscription management technology and automation solutions, tailored to the unique needs of financial institutions and legal firms. Our integrated suite of solutions includes market data and subscription spend management, usage management, compliance reporting, and comprehensive managed services, which hundreds of clients worldwide use to remove cumbersome and inaccurate manual processes and gain control over market data and subscription costs at scale. For more than 25 years, TRG Screen has enabled businesses who rely on market data to monitor and strategically manage spending and usage of data and information services, including market data, research, software licenses, consulting and other necessary corporate expenses. TRG Screen solutions give decisionmakers full transparency into subscription spend and usage, enabling them to proactively manage subscription costs at scale, conduct more informed vendor negotiations, improve governance, and avoid unnecessary spending on these mission-critical business services. TRG Screen is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Europe and Asia, as well as a 24x7 client support center in Bangalore, India.

TRG Screen is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s largest and most respected private equity firms.

The Role

Location: Belfast, Northern Ireland

Reporting to the Director of Software Engineering, the Manager of Software Engineering will lead globally distributed engineering teams at TRG Screen, building a high-performance culture of operational excellence while scaling engineering operations to meet evolving business goals.

This role is responsible for translating engineering strategy into execution—optimizing development processes, providing technical leadership to guide platform modernization, and delivering secure, reliable, scalable solutions. The Manager will own team-level KPI tracking, champion AI-powered code-generation tools to elevate productivity and fuel continuous improvement, and serve as a key connector between engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

This is a people-first leadership role for someone who has grown beyond hands-on delivery but remains technically credible—capable of conducting meaningful code reviews, mentoring engineers at every level, and shaping a culture of engineering excellence across distributed teams.

Responsibilities

People leadership – Coach and develop direct reports through 1:1s, timely feedback, and career planning. Own performance management end-to-end, contribute to hiring, and enable Technical Leads to focus on their highest-leverage technical work.
Delivery – Set clear direction and realistic timelines, manage the roadmap with Product and Design, and proactively handle risks, blockers, and dependencies and escalate as needed to DOE. Own team delivery health metrics (print velocity, bug metrics) and provide visibility to DOE.
Process – Champion Agile practices, ceremonies, and ensure the team has space to act on improvements. Lead incident management and champion a blameless culture.
Technology – Engage in technical discussions at team level, ensure designs are properly evaluated, and keep team decisions consistent with TRG Screen’s architectural principles and engineering strategy.
AI governance – Actively drive AI adoption within the team, build capability and measure uptake. Hold the team accountable for AI code quality and own AI feature delivery. Ensure AI is used responsibly and in line with TRG Screen’s AI governance standards.
Security & communication – Treat secure coding and supply-chain hygiene as standard work. Foster a culture of clear communication, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback across the team and stakeholders.

Required

Skills and Qualifications

5 years of relevant industry experience building production-grade software solutions using an enterprise-grade stack. C# / .NET experience is preferred, though candidates with a strong background in comparable languages such as Java or Go are welcome to apply.
2+ years of people-management experience, with a proven ability to coach and develop engineers at varying levels.
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Continuous Delivery, developer velocity, and DevOps concepts.
Demonstrable experience managing team performance – setting expectations, conducting reviews, and supporting career growth.
Track record of managing delivery – planning, tracking, and communicating progress clearly to stakeholders at multiple levels.
Comfortable engaging in technical discussions at team level; able to represent and be accountable for the team’s technical output.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to tailor communication to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working in cross-functional environments alongside Product Management, Design, and Client Success.

Preferred

Background in financial services, market data, or a regulated technology environment.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tooling.
Familiarity with AI developer tooling (e.g. Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and experience driving adoption responsibly within an engineering team.
Exposure to cloud platforms, with AWS preferred.
Experience participating in security reviews, DDQs, or ISO 27001 audit processes.
Experience leading or contributing to technology modernisation programmes – including legacy migration, re-platforming, or the introduction of modern engineering practices into established codebases.

Leadership Qualities

People-first mindset – genuine investment in the growth and wellbeing of the team.
Clear decision-maker who takes ownership and learns from mistakes without defensiveness.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity; able to act responsibly without the full picture.
Economic thinker – able to frame trade-offs clearly and make pragmatic, business-aligned decisions.
Proactive problem solver who anticipates issues before they escalate.
Builds trust quickly across functions and levels; communicates with candour and respect.

Join TRG Screen and unlock your potential in an environment where innovation thrives, opportunities abound, and your contributions make a difference. We are an equal opportunities employer. We recognise and value the power of diversity in our workplace and are committed to being an employer of choice for everyone. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds. All applications for employment are considered strictly on the basis of merit.

At TRG Screen, we understand that diverse and inclusive teams are not just beneficial, they are essential to our success. We recognize that embracing diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fosters innovation, enhances problem-solving capabilities, and drives better business outcomes. By cultivating a culture of inclusion where every voice is heard and valued, we empower our world class teams to thrive, excel, and drive positive change.

We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.

Privacy Notice for Applicants

TRG Screen is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. Information you provide during the recruitment process will be collected, processed, and stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We encourage all applicants to review our Privacy Policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal data throughout the recruitment process. Our Privacy Policy is available at: www.trgscreen.com/privacy-policy.

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood our Privacy Policy.

Job description
Role Type: Hybrid working
The Team

The Audit Technology team at KPMG is driving innovation at the intersection of auditing and advanced technological solutions, reshaping the future of audit delivery. By combining expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, and Software Development, the team is revolutionising the auditing process to deliver smarter, faster, and more reliable outcomes.

Our mission is to design and implement robust, intelligent, and scalable technologies that not only streamline workflows but also enhance audit quality and generate actionable insights for auditors and clients. Through harnessing the power of cutting-edge tools, we aim to transform traditional audit practices into dynamic, forward-thinking processes that are built for the complexities of the modern business environment.

Our team, supported by KPMG’s global network, serves as the driving force behind this transformative journey. Focused on innovation, this team is dedicated to engineering solutions today that anticipate the challenges and opportunities of tomorrow, ensuring that audit services remain at the forefront of technological progression.

The Role

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in transforming advanced AI concepts into impactful, production-ready solutions within the Audit Technology team. You will lead a dedicated AI engineering squad, working closely with data scientists, data engineers, software developers, cloud architects, and audit professionals to build and scale AI-driven systems that enhance audit quality, efficiency, and insight generation.

From developing robust proof-of-concepts to deploying enterprise-grade solutions, you will apply your expertise in AI engineering, cloud platforms, and technologies such as Generative AI, Azure, Databricks to embed intelligence into critical audit workflows and products.

In addition to technical leadership, you will shape the growth of the team—mentoring engineers, promoting best practices, and fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. You will stay at the forefront of AI engineering trends, advocate for modern development methodologies, and drive knowledge-sharing across both the technology and audit domains.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Mentorship: Lead a high-performing AI engineering team comprising software engineers and AI practitioners. Provide hands-on technical direction, foster career growth, and cultivate a collaborative culture that emphasizes engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Scalable AI Engineering: Drive the design, development, and deployment of production-grade AI systems tailored to audit applications. Ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and maintainable by applying strong software engineering principles, MLOps practices, and cloud-native development.
End-to-End AI Solution Delivery: Oversee the full lifecycle of AI product engineering—from architectural design and prototyping to CI/CD-enabled deployment—using modern platforms and tools such as Azure ML, Databricks, MLflow, LangChain and LangGraph. Champion automation, testing, and observability across pipelines.
Operational Excellence: Define reusable development patterns, enforce coding standards, and promote MLOps best practices that support version control, performance optimisation, and maintainability.
Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Partner closely with data scientists, product managers, platform engineers, and QA teams to align on technical requirements, delivery timelines, and integration plans. Ensure AI capabilities are well-embedded within core audit platforms and services.
AI Governance & Risk Management: Implement engineering controls to support responsible AI use, including model monitoring, explainability, security, and auditability. Contribute to the operationalisation of AI governance frameworks to ensure regulatory and ethical compliance.
Capability Building & Knowledge Sharing: Drive initiatives to enhance internal capabilities, empowering team members and the broader Audit Technology function with the skills and knowledge to adopt and adapt AI innovations effectively.

Requirements

Bachelor (preferably master or PhD) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent professional experience.
Strong knowledge of generative AI, machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing and other relevant AI fields.
Proven track record of designing, developing, and deploying AI systems in production environments.
Proficient in Python and key ML libraries (e.g. PyTorch, PySpark, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers).
Hands-on experience with modern data platforms and AI tooling such as Azure ML, Databricks, MLflow, LangChain, LangGraph.
Proven experience with modern engineering practices Git, version control, unit testing and containerisation.
Familiarity with agile work methodologies and tools like Jira and Confluence.
Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Advanced certifications in AI, machine learning, cloud computing or data engineering are highly advantageous.
Professional accounting qualification preferred, however not a requirement.

Why Audit at KPMG?

Audit is the largest of our UK practices. Some of the world’s biggest companies rely on us to provide independent insight, challenge and expertise, so the work we undertake affects investment decisions, inspires confidence in public sector expenditure and supports our economic growth. Today, more than ever in disruptive times, audit is a function needed by society, and in the future, so we can capitalise, and grow. As part of the Audit team, you’ll be helping to build the confidence and trust that business and society need to thrive. We want to lead the conversation when it comes to shaping the future of the profession. And given the scale and variety of our audit engagements in both the UK and globally, we are well placed to create change. If you share our commitment to achieving excellence and working to the highest audit standards, are a natural collaborator who values different perspectives and relishes the opportunity to develop and progress - then KPMG could be the place where you can thrive.

new_jobs.title: AI First Developer
new_jobs.description:
About Smartcat

Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.

We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM

We are building the future of software development — AI-First is the new standard
. You won’t be “experimenting”; you’ll be delivering. Fast. Smart. Relentless. Join the core team that will prove AI-driven engineering is the only way forward. If you love challenges, own your outcomes, and are obsessed with delivery, you’ll thrive here.

MISSION

As an AI-First Engineer, your mission is to deliver production-quality features at a speed and scale that traditional teams cannot match. You will apply AI aggressively across every stage
of the development lifecycle — from requirements and design to coding, testing, and release — and establish a new engineering benchmark for the company.

OUTCOMES

Consistently deliver high-quality, production-grade features faster than traditional teams.
Build and optimize AI-first workflows that integrate AI across all development stages.
Raise the bar for speed, quality, and ownership in product delivery.
Be a core contributor to the new engineering culture built on AI-First principles.

How You’ll Ramp

By Day 30:

Deeply understand our AWS, .NET, Python, MongoDB tech stack and delivery model.
Start shipping real features using AI at every stage: coding, testing, documenting, releasing.
Contribute to improving workflows for even faster delivery.

By Day 60:

Independently own the full lifecycle of feature delivery through AI-first methods.
Identify and drive improvements in velocity, automation, and team efficiency.
Partner with Product and Tech Leads to aggressively accelerate time-to-market.

By Day 90:

Deliver features faster and with higher quality than baseline teams.
Actively mentor others on using AI as a multiplier across development.
Become a key driver of the AI-First engineering standard inside the company.

WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED:

Proven track record
of delivering production-grade products using AI-driven approach.
Mastery in using AI tools
(Copilot/Cursor/WindSurf (etc, you choose), GPT APIs, LLMs) across the entire development lifecycle — design, code generation, testing, documentation, and release.
Strong technical foundation in AWS, .NET, Python, and MongoDB.
Obsessed with delivery: you ship, you improve, you own the outcome.
Comfortable moving fast, taking ownership, and constantly pushing for better, faster, smarter execution.

Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far

A global, connected team
We’re a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you’re based, you’ll be part of a highly collaborative, globally-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact.
Be part of an AI Native Organization
We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.
Innovating a $100 Billion industry
Smartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.
Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together
We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here.
Smartcat Culture Code: Where Diversity Meets High Performance
At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

We're looking for a mid-level OutSystems Developer to join a support and evolutive development team, keeping a live platform running smoothly while continuously improving it. This isn't greenfield build work - it's about owning a production application, fixing what breaks fast, and shipping enhancements that make it better over time.

You'll work closely with business and IT teams, balancing incident response with planned development, and making sure both get the attention they deserve.

What you'll do

Diagnose and resolve incidents and bugs in existing OutSystems applications, keeping downtime and business impact to a minimum
Design and build new features and enhancements (evolutive development) based on business requirements
Perform root-cause analysis on recurring issues and propose fixes that prevent them from coming back
Monitor application performance and health, and act on issues before they become incidents
Maintain and improve technical documentation, including architecture notes and support runbooks
Participate in code reviews and apply OutSystems best practices for performance, security, and maintainability
Manage integrations with external systems (REST/SOAP APIs, databases, third-party services)
Work within SLA-driven support processes, prioritising tickets by severity and business impact

What you bring

2-4 years of hands-on OutSystems development experience (Reactive and/or Traditional Web apps)
Solid understanding of the OutSystems platform: Service Studio, Integration Studio, Lifetime
Experience supporting live applications: triaging incidents, debugging in production-like environments, and working under SLAs
Working knowledge of REST/SOAP web services, SQL, and relational databases
Understanding of OutSystems architecture principles and performance best practices (query optimisation, aggregate usage, screen performance)
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum ways of working
Good English communication skills, written and spoken
A methodical, problem-solving mindset: comfortable moving between "fix it now" and "build it right"

OutSystems certification (Associate or Professional level)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines for OutSystems (e.g. OutSystems Pipelines, Azure DevOps)
Exposure to ITIL-based support processes
Experience in various industries

What the project looks like

Mixed workload: reactive support (incidents, bug fixes) plus planned evolutive development (new features, improvements)
Direct engagement with stakeholders, not just internal teams

Room to bring your own ideas on how to make the application better, not just keep it alive
